43float distanceSquared(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by) {
44 const float dx = ax - bx;
45 const float dy = ay - by;
46 return dx * dx + dy * dy;
47}

49float weaponRangeDamageFactor(const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition, float distance) {
50 if (definition.minimumDamageFactor >= 1.0f || distance <= definition.falloffStart ||
51 definition.range <= definition.falloffStart) return 1.0f;
52 const float progress = std::clamp((distance - definition.falloffStart) /
53 (definition.range - definition.falloffStart),
54 0.0f, 1.0f);
55 return 1.0f + (definition.minimumDamageFactor - 1.0f) * progress;
56}

58float weaponTargetPreference(const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition, const TagSet* tags) {
59 if (tags == nullptr) return 1.0f;
60 return std::any_of(definition.preferredTargetTags.begin(), definition.preferredTargetTags.end(),
61 [&](const auto& tag) { return tags->contains(tag); })
62 ? definition.preferredTargetBonus : 1.0f;
63}

65float deterministicShotRandom(SubjectRef subject, std::uint64_t sequence, std::uint64_t stream) {
66 std::uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ULL;
67 for (const unsigned char character : subject.format()) {
68 hash ^= character;
69 hash *= 1099511628211ULL;
70 }
71 hash ^= sequence + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (stream << 6U) + (stream >> 2U);
72 hash ^= hash >> 30U; hash *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
73 hash ^= hash >> 27U; hash *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
74 hash ^= hash >> 31U;
75 return static_cast<float>((hash >> 40U) & 0xffffffU) / 16777216.0f;
76}

78struct ShotPlacement {
79 bool missed = false;
80 WorldPosition point;
81};
82
83ShotPlacement placeShot(SubjectRef subject, std::uint64_t sequence,
84 const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition, WorldPosition intended) {
85 ShotPlacement result{deterministicShotRandom(subject, sequence, 0) >= definition.accuracy, intended};
86 if (!result.missed || definition.scatterRadius <= 0.0f) return result;
87 const float angle = deterministicShotRandom(subject, sequence, 1) * 2.0f *
88 static_cast<float>(std::numbers::pi);
89 const float radius = std::sqrt(deterministicShotRandom(subject, sequence, 2)) * definition.scatterRadius;
90 result.point.x += std::cos(angle) * radius;
91 result.point.y += std::sin(angle) * radius;
92 return result;
93}

149float visibleHostileThreatAt(Faction& viewer, WorldPosition point) {
150 const auto visible = [&](SubjectRef subject) {
151 if (!viewer.intel()->enabled) return true;
152 const auto found = std::find_if(viewer.intel()->contacts.begin(), viewer.intel()->contacts.end(),
153 [&](const auto& contact) { return contact.subject == subject; });
154 return found != viewer.intel()->contacts.end() && found->visible && found->detected;
155 };
156 const auto contribution = [&](const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition, WorldPosition source) {
157 if (definition.range <= 0.0f) return 0.0f;
158 const float distance = std::hypot(source.x - point.x, source.y - point.y);
159 if (distance > definition.range) return 0.0f;
160 return std::max(0.0f, definition.damage) / std::max(0.05f, definition.cooldown) *
161 (0.1f + 1.0f - distance / definition.range);
162 };
163 float threat = 0.0f;
164 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Weapon,
165 Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
166 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
167 auto [identity, motion, faction, weaponLink, durability, containment] = *it;
168 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() ||
169 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve()), &viewer) ||
170 !visible(identity->subject))
171 continue;
172 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
173 const auto* definition = weaponEntity == nullptr ? nullptr : weaponEntity->definition()->def;
174 if (definition != nullptr) threat += contribution(*definition, {motion->x, motion->y});
175 }
176 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
177 Building::Weapon, Building::Integrity, Building::Construction>();
178 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
179 auto [identity, placement, faction, weaponLink, integrity, construction] = *it;
180 if (!integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f ||
181 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve()), &viewer) ||
182 !visible(identity->subject))
183 continue;
184 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
185 const auto* definition = weaponEntity == nullptr ? nullptr : weaponEntity->definition()->def;
186 if (definition != nullptr)
187 threat += contribution(*definition, {placement->worldX, placement->worldY});
188 }
189 return threat;
190}

212Result<int> VeterancySystem::award(Unit& unit, float experience) {
213 auto veterancy = unit.veterancy();
214 auto durability = unit.durability();
215 auto combatPolicy = unit.combat();
216 if (!durability->alive || !std::isfinite(experience) || experience <= 0.0f)
217 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
218 "RTS veterancy award requires a live unit and positive finite experience",
219 "experience");
220 if (veterancy->veteranThreshold <= 0.0f)
221 return Result<int>::success(0, Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
222 if (!std::isfinite(veterancy->experience) || veterancy->experience < 0.0f ||
223 !std::isfinite(veterancy->veteranThreshold) || !std::isfinite(veterancy->eliteThreshold) ||
224 veterancy->eliteThreshold <= veterancy->veteranThreshold ||
225 !std::isfinite(veterancy->veteranDamageFactor) ||
226 !std::isfinite(veterancy->eliteDamageFactor) ||
227 !std::isfinite(veterancy->veteranHealthFactor) ||
228 !std::isfinite(veterancy->eliteHealthFactor) ||
229 veterancy->veteranDamageFactor < 1.0f ||
230 veterancy->eliteDamageFactor < veterancy->veteranDamageFactor ||
231 veterancy->veteranHealthFactor < 1.0f ||
232 veterancy->eliteHealthFactor < veterancy->veteranHealthFactor ||
233 veterancy->level < 0 || veterancy->level > 2)
234 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
235 "RTS veterancy thresholds and factors are inconsistent", "unit.veterancy");
236 veterancy->experience += experience;
237 const int oldLevel = veterancy->level;
238 if (veterancy->eliteThreshold > 0.0f && veterancy->experience >= veterancy->eliteThreshold)
239 veterancy->level = 2;
240 else if (veterancy->experience >= veterancy->veteranThreshold)
241 veterancy->level = 1;
242 if (veterancy->level == oldLevel)
243 return Result<int>::success(0, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
244 const auto damageAt = [&](int level) {
245 return level >= 2 ? veterancy->eliteDamageFactor
246 : level >= 1 ? veterancy->veteranDamageFactor : 1.0f;
247 };
248 const auto healthAt = [&](int level) {
249 return level >= 2 ? veterancy->eliteHealthFactor
250 : level >= 1 ? veterancy->veteranHealthFactor : 1.0f;
251 };
252 combatPolicy->upgradeDamageFactor *= damageAt(veterancy->level) / damageAt(oldLevel);
253 const double healthRatio = static_cast<double>(healthAt(veterancy->level) / healthAt(oldLevel));
254 durability->state.maxHealth *= healthRatio;
255 durability->state.health = std::min(durability->state.maxHealth,
256 durability->state.health * healthRatio);
257 return Result<int>::success(veterancy->level - oldLevel, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
258}

260bool FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(Faction* left, Faction* right) noexcept {
261 if (left == nullptr || right == nullptr) return false;
262 if (left == right) return true;
263 auto matches = ecs::View<Match, Match::Participants>();
264 for (auto it = matches.begin(); it != matches.end(); ++it) {
265 auto [participants] = *it;
266 const Match::Participants::Entry* leftEntry = nullptr;
267 const Match::Participants::Entry* rightEntry = nullptr;
268 for (const auto& entry : participants->entries) {
269 if (entry.eliminated) continue;
270 if (entry.faction.resolve() == left) leftEntry = &entry;
271 if (entry.faction.resolve() == right) rightEntry = &entry;
272 }
273 if (leftEntry != nullptr && rightEntry != nullptr)
274 return leftEntry->team == rightEntry->team;
275 }
276 return false;
277}

283bool FactionIntelSystem::isTargetable(Faction* viewer, SubjectRef subject) noexcept {
284 if (viewer == nullptr || !subject.isValid()) return false;
285 const auto intel = viewer->intel();
286 if (!intel->enabled) return true;
287 const auto found = std::find_if(intel->contacts.begin(), intel->contacts.end(),
288 [&](const auto& contact) { return contact.subject == subject; });
289 return found != intel->contacts.end() && found->subject == subject &&
290 found->visible && found->detected;
291}

397Result<void> FormationSpec::validate() const {
398 if (!std::isfinite(spacing) || spacing <= 0.0f)
399 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "formation spacing must be finite and positive",
400 "spacing");
401 if (columns < 0)
402 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "formation columns must be non-negative", "columns");
403 switch (kind) {
404 case FormationKind::Line:
405 case FormationKind::Grid:
406 case FormationKind::Wedge: return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
407 }
408 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "formation kind is invalid", "kind");
409}

411Result<std::vector<WorldPosition>> FormationPlanner::plan(std::size_t count, WorldPosition anchor,
412 const FormationSpec& spec) {
413 auto valid = spec.validate();
414 if (!valid) return failureFrom<std::vector<WorldPosition>>(valid.status());
415 if (!finitePosition(anchor))
416 return failure<std::vector<WorldPosition>>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "formation anchor must be finite",
417 "anchor");
418
419 std::vector<WorldPosition> result;
420 result.reserve(count);
421 if (count == 0)
422 return Result<std::vector<WorldPosition>>::success(std::move(result), Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
423
424 const float spacing = spec.spacing;
425 switch (spec.kind) {
426 case FormationKind::Line: {
427 const float center = static_cast<float>(count - 1) * 0.5f;
428 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
429 result.push_back({anchor.x + (static_cast<float>(index) - center) * spacing, anchor.y});
430 }
431 break;
432 }
433 case FormationKind::Grid: {
434 const std::size_t columns =
435 spec.columns > 0 ? static_cast<std::size_t>(spec.columns)
436 : static_cast<std::size_t>(std::ceil(std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(count))));
437 if (columns == 0)
438 return failure<std::vector<WorldPosition>>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
439 "grid formation computed zero columns", "columns");
440 const std::size_t rows = (count + columns - 1) / columns;
441 const float columnCenter = static_cast<float>(columns - 1) * 0.5f;
442 const float rowCenter = static_cast<float>(rows - 1) * 0.5f;
443 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
444 const std::size_t row = index / columns;
445 const std::size_t column = index % columns;
446 result.push_back({anchor.x + (static_cast<float>(column) - columnCenter) * spacing,
447 anchor.y + (static_cast<float>(row) - rowCenter) * spacing});
448 }
449 break;
450 }
451 case FormationKind::Wedge: {
452 std::size_t row = 0;
453 std::size_t rowStart = 0;
454 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
455 while (index >= rowStart + row + 1) {
456 rowStart += row + 1;
457 ++row;
458 }
459 const std::size_t slot = index - rowStart;
460 const float rowCenter = static_cast<float>(row) * 0.5f;
461 result.push_back({anchor.x + (static_cast<float>(slot) - rowCenter) * spacing,
462 anchor.y + static_cast<float>(row) * spacing});
463 }
464 break;
465 }
466 }
467 return Result<std::vector<WorldPosition>>::success(std::move(result), Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
468}
469
470Result<void> BuildInfluenceSystem::validate(Faction& faction, WorldPosition position,
471 LogicalId definition, const PlacementValidation& placement,
472 bool requireInfluence) {
473 if (!std::isfinite(position.x) || !std::isfinite(position.y) || !definition.isValid() || !placement)
474 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
475 "RTS building placement requires finite position, definition and provider",
476 "placement");
477 if (requireInfluence) {
478 bool covered = false;
479 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
480 Building::Construction, Building::Integrity,
481 Building::Infrastructure>();
482 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
483 auto [source, owner, construction, integrity, infrastructure] = *it;
484 if (!source->placed || construction->progress < 1.0f || !integrity->alive || !infrastructure->powered ||
485 infrastructure->buildInfluenceRadius <= 0.0f ||
486 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(owner->link.resolve()), &faction))
487 continue;
488 const float dx = source->worldX - position.x;
489 const float dy = source->worldY - position.y;
490 const float radius = infrastructure->buildInfluenceRadius;
491 if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= radius * radius) {
492 covered = true;
493 break;
494 }
495 }
496 if (!covered)
497 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
498 "RTS building position is outside powered allied build influence",
499 "placement.influence");
500 }
501 return placement(position, std::move(definition));
502}
503
504Result<FanOutReceipt> CommandFanOutSystem::fanOut(std::span<const ecs::EntityHandle> unitHandles,
505 const CommandSpec& command, const FormationSpec& formation) {
506 if (unitHandles.empty())
507 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS command fan-out requires at least one Unit",
508 "selection.units");
509 auto commandValid = command.validate();
510 if (!commandValid) return failureFrom<FanOutReceipt>(commandValid.status());
511
512 auto formationValid = formation.validate();
513 if (!formationValid) return failureFrom<FanOutReceipt>(formationValid.status());
514 auto targets = FormationPlanner::plan(unitHandles.size(), command.target, formation);
515 if (!targets) return failureFrom<FanOutReceipt>(targets.status());
516 auto plannedTargets = std::move(targets).takeValue();
517
518 // The explicit View is the closure proof for this command boundary: a
519 // Unit subclass is accepted by the Unit registry, while a Building root
520 // cannot enter the selected set merely because it has an Identity field.
521 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> visibleUnits;
522 {
523 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Orders>();
524 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
525 auto [identity, orders] = *it;
526 (void)orders;
527 Unit* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
528 if (unit != nullptr) visibleUnits.push_back(ecs::handle_of(unit));
529 }
530 }
531
532 std::vector<Unit*> selected;
533 selected.reserve(unitHandles.size());
534 for (const auto& handle : unitHandles) {
535 auto* entity = ecs::try_get(handle);
536 auto* unit = entity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(entity);
537 if (unit == nullptr)
538 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
539 "RTS fan-out selection contains a stale or non-Unit handle",
540 "selection.units");
541 const auto liveHandle = ecs::handle_of(unit);
542 const bool inView = std::any_of(visibleUnits.begin(), visibleUnits.end(), [&liveHandle](const auto& candidate) {
543 return sameHandle(candidate, liveHandle);
544 });
545 if (!inView)
546 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
547 "RTS Unit selection is outside the declared View closure", "selection.units");
548 selected.push_back(unit);
549 }
550
551 struct AvailableSlot { WorldPosition position{}; int index = -1; };
552 std::vector<AvailableSlot> available;
553 available.reserve(plannedTargets.size());
554 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < plannedTargets.size(); ++index)
555 available.push_back({plannedTargets[index], static_cast<int>(index)});
556 std::vector<std::size_t> assignmentOrder(selected.size());
557 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < selected.size(); ++index) assignmentOrder[index] = index;
558 std::sort(assignmentOrder.begin(), assignmentOrder.end(), [&](std::size_t left, std::size_t right) {
559 const auto leftMotion = selected[left]->motion();
560 const auto rightMotion = selected[right]->motion();
561 const float leftDistance = distanceSquared(leftMotion->x, leftMotion->y, command.target.x, command.target.y);
562 const float rightDistance = distanceSquared(rightMotion->x, rightMotion->y, command.target.x, command.target.y);
563 if (leftDistance != rightDistance) return leftDistance > rightDistance;
564 return selected[left]->identity()->self.id < selected[right]->identity()->self.id;
565 });
566 std::vector<AvailableSlot> assignedSlots(selected.size());
567 for (const std::size_t selectedIndex : assignmentOrder) {
568 const auto motion = selected[selectedIndex]->motion();
569 auto best = std::min_element(available.begin(), available.end(), [&](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
570 const float leftDistance = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, left.position.x, left.position.y);
571 const float rightDistance = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, right.position.x, right.position.y);
572 return leftDistance != rightDistance ? leftDistance < rightDistance : left.index < right.index;
573 });
574 assignedSlots[selectedIndex] = *best;
575 available.erase(best);
576 }
577
578 FanOutReceipt receipt;
579 receipt.requested = selected.size();
580 receipt.orderIds.reserve(selected.size());
581 std::vector<OrderComponent::Snapshot> previous;
582 previous.reserve(selected.size());
583 for (Unit* unit : selected) {
584 auto snapshot = unit->orders()->values.snapshotState();
585 if (!snapshot) return failureFrom<FanOutReceipt>(snapshot.status());
586 previous.push_back(std::move(snapshot).takeValue());
587 }
588 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < selected.size(); ++index) {
589 CommandSpec assigned = command;
590 assigned.target = assignedSlots[index].position;
591 auto order = assigned.append
592 ? selected[index]->orders()->values.enqueue(assigned, assignedSlots[index].index)
593 : selected[index]->orders()->values.replace(assigned, assignedSlots[index].index);
594 if (!order) {
595 const Status status = order.status();
596 for (std::size_t rollback = 0; rollback < selected.size(); ++rollback)
597 selected[rollback]->orders()->values.restoreState(previous[rollback])
598 .ignore("best-effort atomic fan-out rollback");
599 return Result<FanOutReceipt>::failure(status);
600 }
601 receipt.orderIds.push_back(std::move(order).takeValue());
602 }
603 receipt.accepted = receipt.orderIds.size();
604 return Result<FanOutReceipt>::success(std::move(receipt), Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
605}
606
607Result<std::size_t> TacticsSystem::step(const combat::DamageRuntime* damage, const SimulationStep& step) {
608 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
609 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
610 "RTS tactics step delta must be non-negative", "step.delta");
611 struct Candidate {
612 ecs::EntityHandle handle{};
613 FactionLink* faction = nullptr;
614 WorldPosition position{};
615 double health = 0.0;
616 float shield = 0.0f;
617 combat::CombatState* durability = nullptr;
618 std::string key;
619 ecs::EntityHandle activeTarget{};
620 TagSet* tags = nullptr;
621 bool airborne = false;
622 bool cloaked = false;
623 };
624 std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
625 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Combat, Unit::Durability,
626 Unit::Shield, Unit::Containment, Unit::Tags>();
627 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
628 auto [identity, motion, faction, combat, durability, shield, containment, tags] = *it;
629 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
630 candidates.push_back({identity->self, &faction->link, {motion->x, motion->y}, durability->state.health,
631 shield->value, &durability->state,
632 "u:" + std::to_string(identity->self.id) + ":" +
633 std::to_string(identity->self.generation), combat->target, &tags->values,
634 motion->airborne});
635 }
636 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
637 Building::Combat, Building::Integrity, Building::Shield, Building::Tags>();
638 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
639 auto [identity, placement, faction, combat, integrity, shield, tags] = *it;
640 if (!integrity->alive) continue;
641 candidates.push_back({identity->self, &faction->link, {placement->worldX, placement->worldY},
642 integrity->state.health, shield->value, &integrity->state,
643 "b:" + std::to_string(identity->self.id) + ":" +
644 std::to_string(identity->self.generation), combat->target, &tags->values, false});
645 }
646
647 std::size_t processed = 0;
648 auto tacticalUnits = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Faction, Unit::Combat,
649 Unit::Tactics, Unit::Weapon, Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
650 std::map<std::uint64_t, std::vector<Unit*>> groups;
651 struct EscortAssignment {
652 Unit* unit = nullptr;
653 WorldPosition center{};
654 ecs::EntityHandle protectedTarget{};
655 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> protectedMembers;
656 float protectionRange = 0.0f;
657 WorldPosition travelDirection{};
658 int screenSector = 0;
659 };
660 std::map<std::string, std::vector<EscortAssignment>> escortGroups;
661 for (auto it = tacticalUnits.begin(); it != tacticalUnits.end(); ++it) {
662 auto [identity, motion, orders, faction, combat, tactics, weaponLink, durability, containment] = *it;
663 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
664 auto* self = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
665 if (self == nullptr) continue;
666 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
667 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
668 auto order = std::move(current).takeValue();
669 if (!self->morale()->retreating || tactics->combatGroup == 0 || weaponLink->link.resolve() == nullptr ||
670 (order && order->kind == OrderKind::Attack)) {
671 tactics->retreatFireTeam = -1;
672 tactics->retreatCoverElapsed = 0.0f;
673 tactics->retreatCovering = false;
674 }
675 if (order && order->kind == OrderKind::Escort) {
676 tactics->escortTarget = order->targetEntity;
677 auto* protectedEntity = ecs::try_get(order->targetEntity);
678 WorldPosition center{};
679 FactionLink* protectedFaction = nullptr;
680 if (auto* protectedUnit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(protectedEntity)) {
681 if (protectedUnit->durability()->alive && !protectedUnit->containment()->container.isBound()) {
682 center = {protectedUnit->motion()->x, protectedUnit->motion()->y};
683 protectedFaction = &protectedUnit->faction()->link;
684 }
685 } else if (auto* protectedBuilding = dynamic_cast<Building*>(protectedEntity)) {
686 if (protectedBuilding->integrity()->alive) {
687 center = {protectedBuilding->placement()->worldX, protectedBuilding->placement()->worldY};
688 protectedFaction = &protectedBuilding->faction()->link;
689 }
690 }
691 if (protectedFaction == nullptr || !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*protectedFaction, faction->link)) {
692 auto failed = orders->values.fail(order->id, "escort target is invalid or hostile");
693 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
694 tactics->escortTarget = {};
695 tactics->guardSet = false;
696 tactics->escortInterceptTarget = {};
697 combat->target = {};
698 continue;
699 }
700 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> protectedMembers{order->targetEntity};
701 float convoyExtent = 0.0f;
702 WorldPosition travelDirection{};
703 if (auto* protectedUnit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(protectedEntity);
704 protectedUnit != nullptr && ecs::try_get(protectedUnit->supply()->convoyLeader) != nullptr) {
705 const auto leader = protectedUnit->supply()->convoyLeader;
706 std::vector<Unit*> convoy;
707 auto convoyUnits = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Supply,
708 Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
709 for (auto convoyIt = convoyUnits.begin(); convoyIt != convoyUnits.end(); ++convoyIt) {
710 auto [memberIdentity, memberMotion, memberSupply, memberDurability, memberContainment] = *convoyIt;
711 if (!memberDurability->alive || memberContainment->container.isBound() ||
712 !sameHandle(memberSupply->convoyLeader, leader)) continue;
713 if (auto* member = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(memberIdentity->self)); member != nullptr)
714 convoy.push_back(member);
715 }
716 if (convoy.size() > 1) {
717 center = {};
718 protectedMembers.clear();
719 for (Unit* member : convoy) {
720 center.x += member->motion()->x;
721 center.y += member->motion()->y;
722 protectedMembers.push_back(member->identity()->self);
723 }
724 center.x /= static_cast<float>(convoy.size());
725 center.y /= static_cast<float>(convoy.size());
726 for (Unit* member : convoy)
727 convoyExtent = std::max(convoyExtent,
728 std::hypot(member->motion()->x - center.x, member->motion()->y - center.y));
729 if (auto* convoyLeader = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(leader)); convoyLeader != nullptr) {
730 auto leaderOrder = readCurrent(convoyLeader->orders()->values);
731 if (!leaderOrder) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(leaderOrder.status());
732 if (leaderOrder.value()) {
733 travelDirection = {leaderOrder.value()->target.x - convoyLeader->motion()->x,
734 leaderOrder.value()->target.y - convoyLeader->motion()->y};
735 const float length = std::hypot(travelDirection.x, travelDirection.y);
736 if (length > 1e-5f) {
737 travelDirection.x /= length;
738 travelDirection.y /= length;
739 }
740 }
741 }
742 }
743 }
744 WorldPosition offset{tactics->escortOffsetX, tactics->escortOffsetY};
745 if (std::hypot(travelDirection.x, travelDirection.y) > 1e-5f)
746 offset = {travelDirection.x * tactics->escortOffsetX - travelDirection.y * tactics->escortOffsetY,
747 travelDirection.y * tactics->escortOffsetX + travelDirection.x * tactics->escortOffsetY};
748 int screenSector = 0;
749 if (std::hypot(travelDirection.x, travelDirection.y) > 1e-5f) {
750 if (std::abs(tactics->escortOffsetX) >= std::abs(tactics->escortOffsetY))
751 screenSector = tactics->escortOffsetX >= 0.0f ? 2 : -2;
752 else
753 screenSector = tactics->escortOffsetY >= 0.0f ? 1 : -1;
754 }
755 tactics->escortScreenSector = screenSector;
756 tactics->escortSectorMatched = false;
757 tactics->escortReinforcing = false;
758 tactics->escortReinforcementSector = 0;
759 tactics->escortRearGuard = false;
760 tactics->guardX = center.x + offset.x;
761 tactics->guardY = center.y + offset.y;
762 tactics->guardSet = true;
763 combat->guardX = center.x;
764 combat->guardY = center.y;
765 combat->guardSet = true;
766 const float protectionRange = tactics->protectionRange + convoyExtent;
767 combat->leashRange = std::max(combat->leashRange, protectionRange);
768 escortGroups[std::to_string(order->targetEntity.id) + ":" +
769 std::to_string(order->targetEntity.generation)]
770 .push_back({self, center, order->targetEntity, std::move(protectedMembers), protectionRange,
771 travelDirection, screenSector});
772 } else if (tactics->combatGroup != 0 && weaponLink->link.resolve() != nullptr &&
773 (!order || order->kind != OrderKind::Attack)) {
774 tactics->escortScreenSector = 0;
775 tactics->escortSectorMatched = false;
776 tactics->escortReinforcing = false;
777 tactics->escortReinforcementSector = 0;
778 tactics->escortRearGuard = false;
779 tactics->escortInterceptTarget = {};
780 groups[tactics->combatGroup].push_back(self);
781 }
782 }
783 for (auto& [protectedKey, escorts] : escortGroups) {
784 (void)protectedKey;
785 std::sort(escorts.begin(), escorts.end(), [](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
786 return left.unit->identity()->subject.format() < right.unit->identity()->subject.format();
787 });
788 auto* protectedUnit = escorts.empty() ? nullptr
789 : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(escorts.front().protectedTarget));
790 if (protectedUnit != nullptr && protectedUnit->morale()->retreating) {
791 WorldPosition retreatDirection{
792 protectedUnit->navigation()->plannedGoal.x - protectedUnit->motion()->x,
793 protectedUnit->navigation()->plannedGoal.y - protectedUnit->motion()->y};
794 float length = std::hypot(retreatDirection.x, retreatDirection.y);
795 if (length > 1e-5f) {
796 retreatDirection.x /= length;
797 retreatDirection.y /= length;
798 const WorldPosition side{-retreatDirection.y, retreatDirection.x};
799 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < escorts.size(); ++index) {
800 auto tactics = escorts[index].unit->tactics();
801 const float slot = static_cast<float>(index) -
802 (static_cast<float>(escorts.size()) - 1.0f) * 0.5f;
803 const float depth = std::max(1.0f,
804 std::hypot(tactics->escortOffsetX, tactics->escortOffsetY));
805 const float spacing = 1.5f;
806 tactics->guardX = escorts[index].center.x - retreatDirection.x * depth + side.x * slot * spacing;
807 tactics->guardY = escorts[index].center.y - retreatDirection.y * depth + side.y * slot * spacing;
808 tactics->escortRearGuard = true;
809 }
810 }
811 }
812 std::set<std::string> claimed;
813 for (const auto& escort : escorts) {
814 Candidate* best = nullptr;
815 bool bestDirect = false;
816 bool bestSector = false;
817 int bestThreatSector = 0;
818 float bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
819 const auto faction = escort.unit->faction();
820 const float range = escort.protectionRange;
821 auto consider = [&](Candidate& candidate, bool allowClaimed) {
822 if ((!allowClaimed && claimed.contains(candidate.key)) || candidate.faction == nullptr ||
823 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*candidate.faction, faction->link))
824 return;
825 const float distance = distanceSquared(escort.center.x, escort.center.y,
826 candidate.position.x, candidate.position.y);
827 if (distance > range * range) return;
828 const bool direct = std::any_of(escort.protectedMembers.begin(), escort.protectedMembers.end(),
829 [&](ecs::EntityHandle member) { return sameHandle(candidate.activeTarget, member); });
830 int threatSector = 0;
831 const float forwardLength = std::hypot(escort.travelDirection.x, escort.travelDirection.y);
832 if (forwardLength > 1e-5f) {
833 const float dx = candidate.position.x - escort.center.x;
834 const float dy = candidate.position.y - escort.center.y;
835 const float longitudinal = dx * escort.travelDirection.x + dy * escort.travelDirection.y;
836 const float lateral = dx * -escort.travelDirection.y + dy * escort.travelDirection.x;
837 threatSector = std::abs(longitudinal) >= std::abs(lateral)
838 ? (longitudinal >= 0.0f ? 2 : -2)
839 : (lateral >= 0.0f ? 1 : -1);
840 }
841 const bool sector = escort.screenSector == 0 || escort.screenSector == threatSector;
842 const bool preferred = best == nullptr ||
843 (direct != bestDirect ? direct > bestDirect
844 : sector != bestSector ? sector > bestSector
845 : distance != bestDistance ? distance < bestDistance : candidate.key < best->key);
846 if (preferred) {
847 best = &candidate;
848 bestDirect = direct;
849 bestSector = sector;
850 bestThreatSector = threatSector;
851 bestDistance = distance;
852 }
853 };
854 for (Candidate& candidate : candidates) consider(candidate, false);
855 if (best == nullptr)
856 for (Candidate& candidate : candidates) consider(candidate, true);
857 const SubjectRef nextIntercept = best == nullptr || best->durability == nullptr
858 ? SubjectRef{} : best->durability->subject;
859 auto tactics = escort.unit->tactics();
860 if (tactics->escortInterceptTarget.isValid() && nextIntercept.isValid() &&
861 tactics->escortInterceptTarget != nextIntercept)
862 ++tactics->escortHandoffCount;
863 tactics->escortInterceptTarget = nextIntercept;
864 escort.unit->combat()->target = best == nullptr ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : best->handle;
865 tactics->escortSectorMatched = best != nullptr && bestSector;
866 tactics->escortReinforcing = best != nullptr && escort.screenSector != 0 && !bestSector;
867 tactics->escortReinforcementSector = tactics->escortReinforcing ? bestThreatSector : 0;
868 if (best != nullptr) claimed.insert(best->key);
869 ++processed;
870 }
871 }
872 constexpr float retreatCoverInterval = 1.5f;
873 for (auto& [groupId, members] : groups) {
874 (void)groupId;
875 std::sort(members.begin(), members.end(), [](Unit* left, Unit* right) {
876 return left->identity()->subject.format() < right->identity()->subject.format();
877 });
878 std::vector<Unit*> retreating;
879 float groupElapsed = 0.0f;
880 for (Unit* member : members) {
881 auto tactics = member->tactics();
882 if (!member->morale()->retreating) {
883 tactics->retreatFireTeam = -1;
884 tactics->retreatCoverElapsed = 0.0f;
885 tactics->retreatCovering = false;
886 continue;
887 }
888 retreating.push_back(member);
889 groupElapsed = std::max(groupElapsed, tactics->retreatCoverElapsed);
890 }
891 if (retreating.size() < 2) {
892 for (Unit* member : retreating) {
893 member->tactics()->retreatFireTeam = -1;
894 member->tactics()->retreatCoverElapsed = 0.0f;
895 member->tactics()->retreatCovering = false;
896 }
897 continue;
898 }
899 groupElapsed += static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
900 const int coveringTeam = static_cast<int>(std::floor(groupElapsed / retreatCoverInterval)) % 2;
901 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < retreating.size(); ++index) {
902 auto tactics = retreating[index]->tactics();
903 tactics->retreatFireTeam = static_cast<int>(index % 2);
904 tactics->retreatCoverElapsed = groupElapsed;
905 tactics->retreatCovering = tactics->retreatFireTeam == coveringTeam;
906 }
907 }
908 // Automatic groups share one deterministic commitment ledger for the tick.
909 // This prevents separately numbered formations from independently budgeting
910 // lethal volleys against the same target. Explicit Attack orders never enter
911 // this path and therefore retain intentional focus-fire semantics.
912 std::map<std::string, double> committed;
913 auto commitShot = [&](SubjectRef source, ecs::Entity* ownFaction, WorldPosition origin,
914 const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition, const Candidate& aim,
915 float damageFactor) -> Result<void> {
916 const float launchDistance = std::hypot(aim.position.x - origin.x, aim.position.y - origin.y);
917 const double baseDamage = static_cast<double>(definition.damage) *
918 static_cast<double>(std::max(1, definition.projectile.pelletCount)) *
919 static_cast<double>(damageFactor) *
920 static_cast<double>(weaponRangeDamageFactor(definition, launchDistance));
921 const bool splash = definition.projectile.speed > 0.0f && definition.projectile.aoe > 0.0f;
922 for (Candidate& victim : candidates) {
923 if ((!splash && !sameHandle(victim.handle, aim.handle)) || victim.faction == nullptr ||
924 (!definition.friendlyFire &&
925 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(victim.faction->resolve()),
926 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ownFaction))) ||
927 (victim.airborne && !definition.targetsAir) || (!victim.airborne && !definition.targetsGround) ||
928 victim.tags == nullptr ||
929 std::any_of(definition.requiredTargetTags.begin(), definition.requiredTargetTags.end(),
930 [&](const auto& tag) { return !victim.tags->contains(tag); }) ||
931 std::any_of(definition.excludedTargetTags.begin(), definition.excludedTargetTags.end(),
932 [&](const auto& tag) { return victim.tags->contains(tag); }))
933 continue;
934 double radial = 1.0;
935 if (splash) {
936 const float distance = std::hypot(victim.position.x - aim.position.x,
937 victim.position.y - aim.position.y);
938 if (distance > definition.projectile.aoe) continue;
939 radial = std::max<double>(definition.splashMinimumDamageFactor,
940 1.0 - distance / definition.projectile.aoe);
941 }
942 const double raw = baseDamage * radial;
943 const double shieldDamage = std::min<double>(std::max(0.0f, victim.shield), raw);
944 double healthDamage = raw - shieldDamage;
945 if (damage != nullptr && victim.durability != nullptr && healthDamage > 0.0) {
946 combat::DamageRequest request;
947 request.source = source;
948 request.target = victim.durability->subject;
949 request.damageType = definition.damageType.empty() ? "damage.physical" : definition.damageType;
950 request.healthDamage = healthDamage;
951 auto previewed = damage->preview(*victim.durability, request);
952 if (!previewed) return Result<void>::failure(previewed.status());
953 healthDamage = previewed.value().healthDamage;
954 }
955 committed[victim.key] += shieldDamage + healthDamage;
956 }
957 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
958 };
959 for (auto& [groupId, members] : groups) {
960 (void)groupId;
961 std::sort(members.begin(), members.end(), [](Unit* left, Unit* right) {
962 return left->identity()->self.id < right->identity()->self.id;
963 });
964 const float volleyPhase = members.front()->tactics()->volleyReleaseRemaining;
965 for (Unit* member : members)
966 if (member->tactics()->coordinatedVolleyInterval > 0.0f)
967 member->tactics()->volleyReleaseRemaining = volleyPhase;
968 WorldPosition groupCenter{};
969 for (Unit* member : members) {
970 groupCenter.x += member->motion()->x;
971 groupCenter.y += member->motion()->y;
972 }
973 groupCenter.x /= static_cast<float>(members.size());
974 groupCenter.y /= static_cast<float>(members.size());
975 for (Unit* shooter : members) {
976 if (shooter->morale()->retreating && !shooter->tactics()->retreatCovering) {
977 shooter->combat()->target = {};
978 continue;
979 }
980 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(shooter->weapon()->link.resolve());
981 if (weaponEntity == nullptr || weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr) continue;
982 const auto& definition = *weaponEntity->definition()->def;
983 Candidate* best = nullptr;
984 float bestScore = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
985 bool bestSector = false;
986 float bestPreference = -1.0f;
987 float bestEffectiveness = -1.0f;
988 for (Candidate& candidate : candidates) {
989 if (candidate.faction == nullptr ||
990 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*candidate.faction, shooter->faction()->link) ||
991 sameHandle(candidate.handle, shooter->identity()->self) ||
992 committed[candidate.key] >= candidate.health + candidate.shield)
993 continue;
994 const float distance = distanceSquared(shooter->motion()->x, shooter->motion()->y,
995 candidate.position.x, candidate.position.y);
996 const float range = shooter->combat()->acquisitionRange > 0.0f
997 ? shooter->combat()->acquisitionRange : definition.range;
998 if (distance > range * range) continue;
999 const float shooterX = shooter->motion()->x - groupCenter.x;
1000 const float shooterY = shooter->motion()->y - groupCenter.y;
1001 const float targetX = candidate.position.x - groupCenter.x;
1002 const float targetY = candidate.position.y - groupCenter.y;
1003 const bool sector = shooter->tactics()->threatSector == 0 ||
1004 shooterX * targetX + shooterY * targetY > 0.0f;
1005 const float preference = weaponTargetPreference(definition, candidate.tags);
1006 float effectiveness = 1.0f;
1007 if (damage != nullptr && candidate.durability != nullptr && definition.damage > 0.0f) {
1008 combat::DamageRequest request;
1009 request.source = shooter->identity()->subject;
1010 request.target = candidate.durability->subject;
1011 request.damageType = definition.damageType.empty() ? "damage.physical" : definition.damageType;
1012 request.healthDamage = definition.damage;
1013 auto previewed = damage->preview(*candidate.durability, request);
1014 if (!previewed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(previewed.status());
1015 effectiveness = static_cast<float>(previewed.value().healthDamage / definition.damage);
1016 }
1017 const bool preferred = best == nullptr ||
1018 (sector != bestSector ? sector > bestSector
1019 : effectiveness != bestEffectiveness ? effectiveness > bestEffectiveness
1020 : preference != bestPreference ? preference > bestPreference
1021 : distance != bestScore ? distance < bestScore : candidate.key < best->key);
1022 if (preferred) {
1023 best = &candidate;
1024 bestScore = distance;
1025 bestSector = sector;
1026 bestPreference = preference;
1027 bestEffectiveness = effectiveness;
1028 }
1029 }
1030 if (best == nullptr) continue;
1031 shooter->combat()->target = best->handle;
1032 shooter->tactics()->fireControlEffectiveness = bestEffectiveness < 0.0f ? 1.0f : bestEffectiveness;
1033 auto committedShot = commitShot(shooter->identity()->subject, shooter->faction()->link.resolve(),
1034 {shooter->motion()->x, shooter->motion()->y}, definition, *best, 1.0f);
1035 if (!committedShot) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(committedShot.status());
1036 ++processed;
1037 }
1038 }
1039
1040 struct TurretNode {
1041 Building* building = nullptr;
1042 const weapon::WeaponDefinition* weapon = nullptr;
1043 std::string key;
1044 };
1045 std::vector<TurretNode> turrets;
1046 auto turretBuildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Orders, Building::Faction,
1047 Building::Placement, Building::Weapon, Building::Combat,
1048 Building::Integrity, Building::Construction, Building::Infrastructure,
1049 Building::Garrison>();
1050 for (auto it = turretBuildings.begin(); it != turretBuildings.end(); ++it) {
1051 auto [identity, orders, faction, placement, weaponLink, combat, integrity, construction,
1052 infrastructure, garrison] = *it;
1053 (void)orders; (void)faction; (void)placement; (void)garrison;
1054 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1055 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
1056 if (building == nullptr || !integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f ||
1057 !infrastructure->powered || combat->airDefenseNetworkRange > 0.0f || weaponEntity == nullptr ||
1058 weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr) continue;
1059 turrets.push_back({building, weaponEntity->definition()->def, identity->subject.format()});
1060 }
1061 std::sort(turrets.begin(), turrets.end(), [](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
1062 return left.key < right.key;
1063 });
1064 for (const TurretNode& turret : turrets) {
1065 Building* building = turret.building;
1066 auto current = readCurrent(building->orders()->values);
1067 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1068 if (current.value() && current.value()->kind == OrderKind::Attack) continue;
1069 const auto& definition = *turret.weapon;
1070 Candidate* best = nullptr;
1071 float bestPreference = -1.0f;
1072 float bestEffectiveness = -1.0f;
1073 float bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
1074 for (Candidate& candidate : candidates) {
1075 if (candidate.faction == nullptr ||
1076 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*candidate.faction, building->faction()->link) ||
1077 sameHandle(candidate.handle, building->identity()->self) ||
1078 committed[candidate.key] >= candidate.health + candidate.shield ||
1079 (candidate.airborne && !definition.targetsAir) || (!candidate.airborne && !definition.targetsGround) ||
1080 candidate.tags == nullptr ||
1081 std::any_of(definition.requiredTargetTags.begin(), definition.requiredTargetTags.end(),
1082 [&](const auto& tag) { return !candidate.tags->contains(tag); }) ||
1083 std::any_of(definition.excludedTargetTags.begin(), definition.excludedTargetTags.end(),
1084 [&](const auto& tag) { return candidate.tags->contains(tag); }))
1085 continue;
1086 const float range = building->combat()->acquisitionRange > 0.0f
1087 ? building->combat()->acquisitionRange : definition.range;
1088 const float distance = distanceSquared(building->placement()->worldX,
1089 building->placement()->worldY, candidate.position.x, candidate.position.y);
1090 if (distance > range * range) continue;
1091 const float preference = weaponTargetPreference(definition, candidate.tags);
1092 float effectiveness = 1.0f;
1093 if (damage != nullptr && candidate.durability != nullptr && definition.damage > 0.0f) {
1094 combat::DamageRequest request;
1095 request.source = building->identity()->subject;
1096 request.target = candidate.durability->subject;
1097 request.damageType = definition.damageType.empty() ? "damage.physical" : definition.damageType;
1098 request.healthDamage = definition.damage;
1099 auto previewed = damage->preview(*candidate.durability, request);
1100 if (!previewed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(previewed.status());
1101 effectiveness = static_cast<float>(previewed.value().healthDamage / definition.damage);
1102 }
1103 if (best == nullptr || effectiveness > bestEffectiveness ||
1104 (effectiveness == bestEffectiveness && (preference > bestPreference ||
1105 (preference == bestPreference && (distance < bestDistance ||
1106 (distance == bestDistance && candidate.key < best->key)))))) {
1107 best = &candidate;
1108 bestPreference = preference;
1109 bestEffectiveness = effectiveness;
1110 bestDistance = distance;
1111 }
1112 }
1113 building->combat()->target = best == nullptr ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : best->handle;
1114 if (best != nullptr) {
1115 const float garrisonFactor = 1.0f + building->garrison()->damageBonusPerOccupant *
1116 static_cast<float>(building->garrison()->occupants.size());
1117 auto committedShot = commitShot(building->identity()->subject, building->faction()->link.resolve(),
1118 {building->placement()->worldX, building->placement()->worldY},
1119 definition, *best, garrisonFactor);
1120 if (!committedShot) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(committedShot.status());
1121 }
1122 ++processed;
1123 }
1124
1125 struct DefenseNode {
1126 Building* building = nullptr;
1127 const weapon::WeaponDefinition* weapon = nullptr;
1128 std::string key;
1129 };
1130 std::vector<DefenseNode> defenses;
1131 auto defenseBuildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Orders,
1132 Building::Faction, Building::Weapon, Building::Combat, Building::Integrity,
1133 Building::Construction, Building::Infrastructure>();
1134 for (auto it = defenseBuildings.begin(); it != defenseBuildings.end(); ++it) {
1135 auto [identity, placement, orders, faction, weaponLink, combat, integrity, construction, infrastructure] = *it;
1136 (void)placement; (void)orders; (void)faction;
1137 combat->airDefenseNetworkRoot = {};
1138 combat->airDefenseNetworkSize = 0;
1139 if (!std::isfinite(combat->airDefenseNetworkRange) || combat->airDefenseNetworkRange < 0.0f)
1140 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1141 "RTS air-defense network range must be finite and non-negative",
1142 "building.combat.airDefenseNetworkRange");
1143 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1144 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
1145 if (building == nullptr || !integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f ||
1146 !infrastructure->powered || combat->airDefenseNetworkRange <= 0.0f || weaponEntity == nullptr ||
1147 weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr || !weaponEntity->definition()->def->targetsAir)
1148 continue;
1149 defenses.push_back({building, weaponEntity->definition()->def, identity->subject.format()});
1150 }
1151 std::sort(defenses.begin(), defenses.end(), [](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
1152 return left.key < right.key;
1153 });
1154 std::vector<bool> visited(defenses.size(), false);
1155 for (std::size_t start = 0; start < defenses.size(); ++start) {
1156 if (visited[start]) continue;
1157 std::vector<std::size_t> component{start};
1158 visited[start] = true;
1159 for (std::size_t cursor = 0; cursor < component.size(); ++cursor) {
1160 const auto index = component[cursor];
1161 Building* current = defenses[index].building;
1162 for (std::size_t other = 0; other < defenses.size(); ++other) {
1163 if (visited[other] || !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(defenses[other].building->faction()->link,
1164 current->faction()->link))
1165 continue;
1166 Building* candidate = defenses[other].building;
1167 const float linkRange = std::max(current->combat()->airDefenseNetworkRange,
1168 candidate->combat()->airDefenseNetworkRange);
1169 if (distanceSquared(current->placement()->worldX, current->placement()->worldY,
1170 candidate->placement()->worldX, candidate->placement()->worldY) <=
1171 linkRange * linkRange) {
1172 visited[other] = true;
1173 component.push_back(other);
1174 }
1175 }
1176 }
1177 std::sort(component.begin(), component.end(), [&](auto left, auto right) {
1178 return defenses[left].key < defenses[right].key;
1179 });
1180 const auto root = defenses[component.front()].building->identity()->self;
1181 std::set<std::string> claimed;
1182 for (const auto index : component) {
1183 DefenseNode& defense = defenses[index];
1184 Building* building = defense.building;
1185 building->combat()->airDefenseNetworkRoot = root;
1186 building->combat()->airDefenseNetworkSize = component.size();
1187 auto current = readCurrent(building->orders()->values);
1188 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1189 if (current.value() && current.value()->kind == OrderKind::Attack) continue;
1190 Candidate* best = nullptr;
1191 float bestPreference = -1.0f;
1192 float bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
1193 for (Candidate& candidate : candidates) {
1194 if (!candidate.airborne || candidate.faction == nullptr ||
1195 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*candidate.faction, building->faction()->link) ||
1196 claimed.contains(candidate.key))
1197 continue;
1198 const auto& definition = *defense.weapon;
1199 if (candidate.tags == nullptr ||
1200 std::any_of(definition.requiredTargetTags.begin(), definition.requiredTargetTags.end(),
1201 [&](const auto& tag) { return !candidate.tags->contains(tag); }) ||
1202 std::any_of(definition.excludedTargetTags.begin(), definition.excludedTargetTags.end(),
1203 [&](const auto& tag) { return candidate.tags->contains(tag); })) continue;
1204 const float range = building->combat()->acquisitionRange > 0.0f
1205 ? building->combat()->acquisitionRange : definition.range;
1206 const float distance = distanceSquared(building->placement()->worldX,
1207 building->placement()->worldY, candidate.position.x, candidate.position.y);
1208 if (distance > range * range) continue;
1209 const float preference = weaponTargetPreference(definition, candidate.tags);
1210 if (best == nullptr || preference > bestPreference ||
1211 (preference == bestPreference && (distance < bestDistance ||
1212 (distance == bestDistance && candidate.key < best->key)))) {
1213 best = &candidate;
1214 bestPreference = preference;
1215 bestDistance = distance;
1216 }
1217 }
1218 building->combat()->target = best == nullptr ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : best->handle;
1219 if (best != nullptr) claimed.insert(best->key);
1220 ++processed;
1221 }
1222 }
1223 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
1224 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1225}
1226
1227Result<std::size_t> AISystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const AIProductionRequest& requestProduction) {
1228 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
1229 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS AI step delta must be non-negative",
1230 "step.delta");
1231 std::size_t processed = 0;
1232 auto factions = ecs::View<Faction, Faction::Identity, Faction::Strategy>();
1233 for (auto it = factions.begin(); it != factions.end(); ++it) {
1234 auto [identity, strategy] = *it;
1235 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1236 if (faction == nullptr || !strategy->enabled) continue;
1237 if (!std::isfinite(strategy->thinkInterval) || strategy->thinkInterval <= 0.0f ||
1238 strategy->desiredWorkers < 0 || strategy->attackThreshold <= 0 ||
1239 !std::isfinite(strategy->formationSpacing) || strategy->formationSpacing <= 0.0f)
1240 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS AI policy values are invalid",
1241 "faction.strategy");
1242 strategy->thinkAccumulator += static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
1243 if (strategy->thinkAccumulator + 1e-6f < strategy->thinkInterval) continue;
1244 strategy->thinkAccumulator = std::fmod(strategy->thinkAccumulator, strategy->thinkInterval);
1245
1246 int workerCount = 0;
1247 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> army;
1248 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Definition, Unit::Faction, Unit::Orders,
1249 Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
1250 for (auto unitIt = units.begin(); unitIt != units.end(); ++unitIt) {
1251 auto [unitIdentity, definition, owner, orders, durability, containment] = *unitIt;
1252 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() ||
1253 owner->link.resolve() != faction) continue;
1254 if (strategy->workerDefinition.isValid() && definition->id == strategy->workerDefinition) ++workerCount;
1255 if (strategy->armyDefinition.isValid() && definition->id == strategy->armyDefinition)
1256 army.push_back(unitIdentity->self);
1257 (void)orders;
1258 }
1259
1260 if (requestProduction) {
1261 const LogicalId& wanted = workerCount < strategy->desiredWorkers ? strategy->workerDefinition
1262 : strategy->armyDefinition;
1263 if (wanted.isValid()) {
1264 Building* producer = nullptr;
1265 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Faction,
1266 Building::Construction, Building::Integrity, Building::Production>();
1267 for (auto buildingIt = buildings.begin(); buildingIt != buildings.end(); ++buildingIt) {
1268 auto [buildingIdentity, owner, construction, integrity, production] = *buildingIt;
1269 (void)production;
1270 if (!integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f || owner->link.resolve() != faction)
1271 continue;
1272 auto* candidate = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(buildingIdentity->self));
1273 if (candidate != nullptr && (producer == nullptr ||
1274 candidate->identity()->self.id < producer->identity()->self.id)) producer = candidate;
1275 }
1276 if (producer != nullptr) {
1277 auto requested = requestProduction(*faction, *producer, wanted);
1278 if (!requested) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(requested.status());
1279 ++processed;
1280 }
1281 }
1282 }
1283
1284 if (static_cast<int>(army.size()) < strategy->attackThreshold) continue;
1285 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> idleArmy;
1286 for (const auto& handle : army) {
1287 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1288 if (unit != nullptr && unit->orders()->values.empty()) idleArmy.push_back(handle);
1289 }
1290 if (idleArmy.empty()) continue;
1291 Building* target = nullptr;
1292 auto targets = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Definition, Building::Faction,
1293 Building::Placement, Building::Integrity>();
1294 for (auto targetIt = targets.begin(); targetIt != targets.end(); ++targetIt) {
1295 auto [targetIdentity, definition, owner, placement, integrity] = *targetIt;
1296 (void)placement;
1297 if (!integrity->alive ||
1298 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(owner->link.resolve()), faction) ||
1299 (strategy->targetBuildingDefinition.isValid() && definition->id != strategy->targetBuildingDefinition))
1300 continue;
1301 auto* candidate = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(targetIdentity->self));
1302 if (candidate != nullptr && (target == nullptr ||
1303 candidate->identity()->self.id < target->identity()->self.id)) target = candidate;
1304 }
1305 if (target == nullptr && strategy->targetBuildingDefinition.isValid()) {
1306 for (auto targetIt = targets.begin(); targetIt != targets.end(); ++targetIt) {
1307 auto [targetIdentity, definition, owner, placement, integrity] = *targetIt;
1308 (void)definition; (void)placement;
1309 if (!integrity->alive ||
1310 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(owner->link.resolve()), faction))
1311 continue;
1312 auto* candidate = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(targetIdentity->self));
1313 if (candidate != nullptr && (target == nullptr ||
1314 candidate->identity()->self.id < target->identity()->self.id)) target = candidate;
1315 }
1316 }
1317 if (target == nullptr) continue;
1318 CommandSpec attackMove;
1319 attackMove.kind = OrderKind::AttackMove;
1320 attackMove.target = {target->placement()->worldX, target->placement()->worldY};
1321 FormationSpec formation;
1322 formation.kind = FormationKind::Grid;
1323 formation.spacing = strategy->formationSpacing;
1324 auto issued = CommandFanOutSystem::fanOut(idleArmy, attackMove, formation);
1325 if (!issued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(issued.status());
1326 const std::uint64_t group = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(identity->self.id) + 1u;
1327 for (const auto& handle : idleArmy) {
1328 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1329 if (unit != nullptr) unit->tactics()->combatGroup = group;
1330 }
1331 processed += issued.value().accepted;
1332 }
1333 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
1334 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1335}
1336
1337Result<std::size_t> MotionSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step) {
1338 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
1339 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS motion step delta must be non-negative",
1340 "step.delta");
1341 const double deltaSeconds = step.delta.seconds();
1342 std::size_t processed = 0;
1343 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders, Unit::Combat,
1344 Unit::Containment, Unit::Supply, Unit::Morale, Unit::Tactics, Unit::Command,
1345 Unit::Effects>();
1346 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1347 auto [identity, motion, navigation, orders, combat, containment, supply, morale, tactics, command,
1348 effects] = *it;
1349 Unit* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1350 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
1351 if (unit->crowd()->link.isBound() || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
1352 if (!std::isfinite(motion->x) || !std::isfinite(motion->y) || !std::isfinite(motion->speed) ||
1353 !std::isfinite(motion->arrivalRadius) || motion->speed < 0.0f || motion->arrivalRadius < 0.0f)
1354 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1355 "RTS motion state must contain finite non-negative values", "unit.motion");
1356
1357 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
1358 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1359 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
1360 if (!record) continue;
1361 if (!movementOrder(record->kind)) {
1362 motion->arrived = true;
1363 ++processed;
1364 continue;
1365 }
1366 if (navigation->trafficWaiting || supply->convoyWaiting ||
1367 (morale->retreating && tactics->retreatCovering)) {
1368 motion->arrived = false;
1369 ++processed;
1370 continue;
1371 }
1372 if (record->kind == OrderKind::AttackMove && combat->engagementRange > 0.0f) {
1373 auto engaged = entityPosition(combat->target);
1374 if (engaged && distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, engaged->x, engaged->y) <=
1375 combat->engagementRange * combat->engagementRange) {
1376 motion->arrived = false;
1377 ++processed;
1378 continue;
1379 }
1380 }
1381
1382 WorldPosition target = record->target;
1383 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Attack || record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply ||
1384 record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay) {
1385 auto liveTarget = entityPosition(record->targetEntity);
1386 if (liveTarget) target = *liveTarget;
1387 if (record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay && supply->rendezvousActive)
1388 target = supply->rendezvousPoint;
1389 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Escort && tactics->guardSet) {
1390 target = {tactics->guardX, tactics->guardY};
1391 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Patrol && navigation->patrolInitialized &&
1392 !navigation->patrolTowardTarget) {
1393 target = navigation->patrolOrigin;
1394 }
1395 if (navigation->plannedOrderId == record->id && !navigation->unreachable &&
1396 navigation->waypointIndex < navigation->waypoints.size())
1397 target = navigation->waypoints[navigation->waypointIndex];
1398 const float dx = target.x - motion->x;
1399 const float dy = target.y - motion->y;
1400 const float distance = std::hypot(dx, dy);
1401 if (!std::isfinite(distance))
1402 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation, "RTS motion target distance is non-finite",
1403 "order.target");
1404 float arrivalRadius = motion->arrivalRadius;
1405 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Attack)
1406 arrivalRadius = std::max(arrivalRadius, combat->engagementRange);
1407 else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply || record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay)
1408 arrivalRadius = std::max(arrivalRadius, supply->range * 0.8f);
1409 if (distance <= arrivalRadius) {
1410 if (record->kind != OrderKind::Attack) {
1411 motion->x = target.x;
1412 motion->y = target.y;
1413 }
1414 motion->arrived = true;
1415 } else if (deltaSeconds > 0.0 && motion->speed > 0.0f) {
1416 const float moraleFactor = morale->active ? std::clamp(morale->suppressedSpeedFactor, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 1.0f;
1417 const float commandFactor = command->requiresCommand && !command->inCommand
1418 ? command->outOfCommandSpeedFactor : 1.0f;
1419 const float effectFactor = static_cast<float>(effects->values.multiplier("speedMultiplier"));
1420 const float speedFactor = moraleFactor * commandFactor * effectFactor;
1421 const double travel = static_cast<double>(motion->speed * speedFactor) * deltaSeconds;
1422 if (!std::isfinite(travel))
1423 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS motion travel distance is non-finite",
1424 "unit.motion.speed");
1425 const float amount = static_cast<float>(std::min<double>(travel, distance));
1426 motion->x += dx / distance * amount;
1427 motion->y += dy / distance * amount;
1428 motion->arrived = static_cast<double>(amount) >= distance - arrivalRadius;
1429 if (motion->arrived) {
1430 if (record->kind != OrderKind::Attack) {
1431 motion->x = target.x;
1432 motion->y = target.y;
1433 }
1434 }
1435 } else {
1436 motion->arrived = false;
1437 }
1438 ++processed;
1439 }
1440 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1441}
1442
1443Result<std::size_t> MovementOrderSystem::step() {
1444 std::size_t completedCount = 0;
1445 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders,
1446 Unit::Containment>();
1447 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1448 auto [identity, motion, navigation, orders, containment] = *it;
1449 if (identity == nullptr)
1450 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
1451 "RTS movement order candidate has no identity", "unit.identity");
1452 if (containment->container.isBound() || !motion->arrived || navigation->trafficWaiting) continue;
1453 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
1454 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1455 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
1456 if (!record || (record->kind != OrderKind::Move && record->kind != OrderKind::AttackMove)) continue;
1457 if (record->kind == OrderKind::AttackMove && orders->values.orderCount() <= 1) continue;
1458 const bool hasActivePath = navigation->plannedOrderId == record->id && !navigation->unreachable &&
1459 navigation->waypointIndex < navigation->waypoints.size();
1460 if (hasActivePath && navigation->waypointIndex + 1 < navigation->waypoints.size()) continue;
1461 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
1462 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
1463 navigation->waypoints.clear();
1464 navigation->waypointIndex = 0;
1465 navigation->plannedOrderId.clear();
1466 navigation->trafficWaiting = false;
1467 ++completedCount;
1468 }
1469 return Result<std::size_t>::success(completedCount,
1470 Status::success(completedCount == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1471}
1472
1473Result<std::size_t> CommandStateSystem::step() {
1474 std::size_t processed = 0;
1475 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders,
1476 Unit::Combat, Unit::Containment>();
1477 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1478 auto [identity, motion, navigation, orders, combat, containment] = *it;
1479 if (identity == nullptr)
1480 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
1481 "RTS command-state candidate has no identity", "unit.identity");
1482 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
1483 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1484 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
1485 const bool holding = record && record->kind == OrderKind::HoldPosition;
1486 const bool attackMoving = record && record->kind == OrderKind::AttackMove;
1487 if (holding && !combat->holdPosition) {
1488 combat->guardX = motion->x;
1489 combat->guardY = motion->y;
1490 combat->guardSet = true;
1491 }
1492 combat->holdPosition = holding;
1493 combat->attackMove = attackMoving;
1494 if (!record || record->kind != OrderKind::Stop) continue;
1495 combat->target = {};
1496 combat->guardSet = false;
1497 navigation->waypoints.clear();
1498 navigation->waypointIndex = 0;
1499 navigation->plannedOrderId.clear();
1500 navigation->trafficWaiting = false;
1501 navigation->patrolInitialized = false;
1502 motion->arrived = true;
1503 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
1504 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
1505 ++processed;
1506 (void)containment;
1507 }
1508 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
1509 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1510}
1511
1512Result<std::size_t> NavigationSystem::step(map::Pathfinder& pathfinder, const NavigationGrid& grid,
1513 const NavigationEvent& unreachable) {
1514 if (!std::isfinite(grid.cellSize) || grid.cellSize <= 0.0f || !std::isfinite(grid.originX) ||
1515 !std::isfinite(grid.originY))
1516 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1517 "RTS navigation grid requires finite origin and positive cell size",
1518 "navigation.grid");
1519 const auto worldToCell = [&](float value, float origin) {
1520 return static_cast<int>(std::lround((value - origin) / grid.cellSize));
1521 };
1522 const auto cellToWorld = [&](int value, float origin) {
1523 return origin + static_cast<float>(value) * grid.cellSize;
1524 };
1525 std::size_t processed = 0;
1526 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders,
1527 Unit::Containment, Unit::Tactics, Unit::Supply, Unit::Faction>();
1528 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1529 auto [identity, motion, navigation, orders, containment, tactics, supply, faction] = *it;
1530 auto* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1531 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
1532 if (containment->container.isBound()) continue;
1533 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
1534 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1535 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
1536 if (!record || !movementOrder(record->kind)) {
1537 navigation->waypoints.clear();
1538 navigation->waypointIndex = 0;
1539 navigation->plannedOrderId.clear();
1540 navigation->unreachable = false;
1541 navigation->unreachableReported = false;
1542 navigation->trafficWaiting = false;
1543 navigation->patrolInitialized = false;
1544 navigation->patrolTowardTarget = true;
1545 supply->routeThreat = 0.0f;
1546 supply->routeAvoidedThreat = false;
1547 continue;
1548 }
1549 WorldPosition goal = record->target;
1550 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Attack || record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply ||
1551 record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay) {
1552 if (auto target = entityPosition(record->targetEntity)) goal = *target;
1553 if (record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay && supply->rendezvousActive)
1554 goal = supply->rendezvousPoint;
1555 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Escort && tactics->guardSet) {
1556 goal = {tactics->guardX, tactics->guardY};
1557 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Patrol && navigation->patrolInitialized &&
1558 !navigation->patrolTowardTarget) {
1559 goal = navigation->patrolOrigin;
1560 }
1561 const bool supplyMission = record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply ||
1562 record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay;
1563 auto* viewer = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve());
1564 float currentRouteThreat = 0.0f;
1565 if (supplyMission && viewer != nullptr) {
1566 WorldPosition previous{motion->x, motion->y};
1567 for (std::size_t index = navigation->waypointIndex; index < navigation->waypoints.size(); ++index) {
1568 const WorldPosition point = navigation->waypoints[index];
1569 currentRouteThreat += visibleHostileThreatAt(*viewer, point) *
1570 std::hypot(point.x - previous.x, point.y - previous.y);
1571 previous = point;
1572 }
1573 }
1574 const bool threatChanged = supplyMission && navigation->plannedOrderId == record->id &&
1575 currentRouteThreat > supply->routeThreat + 1e-4f;
1576 const bool changed = navigation->plannedOrderId != record->id || threatChanged ||
1577 distanceSquared(goal.x, goal.y, navigation->plannedGoal.x,
1578 navigation->plannedGoal.y) > grid.cellSize * grid.cellSize * 0.25f;
1579 if (changed) {
1580 navigation->waypoints.clear();
1581 navigation->waypointIndex = 0;
1582 navigation->plannedOrderId = record->id;
1583 navigation->plannedGoal = goal;
1584 navigation->unreachable = false;
1585 navigation->unreachableReported = false;
1586 const int startX = worldToCell(motion->x, grid.originX);
1587 const int startY = worldToCell(motion->y, grid.originY);
1588 const int goalX = worldToCell(goal.x, grid.originX);
1589 const int goalY = worldToCell(goal.y, grid.originY);
1590 std::unique_ptr<map::Path> baseline;
1591 std::unique_ptr<map::Path> path;
1592 if (supplyMission) {
1593 baseline.reset(pathfinder.findPath(startX, startY, goalX, goalY));
1594 path.reset(pathfinder.findPath(startX, startY, goalX, goalY,
1595 [&](int x, int y) {
1596 if (viewer == nullptr) return 0.0f;
1597 const WorldPosition point{cellToWorld(x, grid.originX),
1598 cellToWorld(y, grid.originY)};
1599 return visibleHostileThreatAt(*viewer, point) * 0.5f;
1600 }));
1601 const auto exposure = [&](const map::Path* candidate) {
1602 if (candidate == nullptr || candidate->empty() || viewer == nullptr) return 0.0f;
1603 float total = 0.0f;
1604 WorldPosition previous{motion->x, motion->y};
1605 for (int index = 1; index < candidate->getLength(); ++index) {
1606 const WorldPosition point{cellToWorld(candidate->getX(index), grid.originX),
1607 cellToWorld(candidate->getY(index), grid.originY)};
1608 total += visibleHostileThreatAt(*viewer, point) *
1609 std::hypot(point.x - previous.x, point.y - previous.y);
1610 previous = point;
1611 }
1612 return total;
1613 };
1614 supply->routeThreat = exposure(path.get());
1615 supply->routeAvoidedThreat = baseline != nullptr && !baseline->empty() &&
1616 supply->routeThreat + 1e-4f < exposure(baseline.get());
1617 } else {
1618 path.reset(pathfinder.findPath(startX, startY, goalX, goalY));
1619 supply->routeThreat = 0.0f;
1620 supply->routeAvoidedThreat = false;
1621 }
1622 if (path == nullptr || path->empty()) {
1623 navigation->unreachable = true;
1624 } else {
1625 navigation->waypoints.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(path->getLength()));
1626 for (int index = 1; index < path->getLength(); ++index)
1627 navigation->waypoints.push_back({cellToWorld(path->getX(index), grid.originX),
1628 cellToWorld(path->getY(index), grid.originY)});
1629 }
1630 } else if (supplyMission) {
1631 supply->routeThreat = currentRouteThreat;
1632 }
1633 while (navigation->waypointIndex < navigation->waypoints.size()) {
1634 const auto waypoint = navigation->waypoints[navigation->waypointIndex];
1635 const float radius = std::max(motion->arrivalRadius, grid.cellSize * 0.1f);
1636 if (distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, waypoint.x, waypoint.y) > radius * radius) break;
1637 ++navigation->waypointIndex;
1638 }
1639 if (navigation->unreachable && !navigation->unreachableReported) {
1640 navigation->unreachableReported = true;
1641 if (unreachable) unreachable(*unit, *record);
1642 }
1643 ++processed;
1644 }
1645 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
1646 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1647}
1648
1649Result<std::size_t> PatrolSystem::step() {
1650 std::size_t processed = 0;
1651 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders,
1652 Unit::Containment>();
1653 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1654 auto [identity, motion, navigation, orders, containment] = *it;
1655 if (identity == nullptr)
1656 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
1657 "RTS patrol candidate has no identity", "unit.identity");
1658 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
1659 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1660 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
1661 if (!record || record->kind != OrderKind::Patrol || containment->container.isBound()) {
1662 navigation->patrolInitialized = false;
1663 navigation->patrolTowardTarget = true;
1664 continue;
1665 }
1666 if (!navigation->patrolInitialized) {
1667 navigation->patrolOrigin = {motion->x, motion->y};
1668 navigation->patrolInitialized = true;
1669 navigation->patrolTowardTarget = true;
1670 }
1671 const WorldPosition endpoint = navigation->patrolTowardTarget ? record->target : navigation->patrolOrigin;
1672 const float radius = std::max(motion->arrivalRadius, 0.01f);
1673 if (distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, endpoint.x, endpoint.y) <= radius * radius) {
1674 navigation->patrolTowardTarget = !navigation->patrolTowardTarget;
1675 navigation->plannedOrderId.clear();
1676 navigation->waypoints.clear();
1677 navigation->waypointIndex = 0;
1678 navigation->unreachable = false;
1679 navigation->unreachableReported = false;
1680 motion->arrived = false;
1681 }
1682 ++processed;
1683 }
1684 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
1685 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1686}
1687
1688Result<std::size_t> TrafficReservationSystem::step(const map::Pathfinder& pathfinder,
1689 const NavigationGrid& grid) {
1690 if (!std::isfinite(grid.cellSize) || grid.cellSize <= 0.0f || !std::isfinite(grid.originX) ||
1691 !std::isfinite(grid.originY))
1692 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1693 "RTS traffic grid requires finite origin and positive cell size",
1694 "traffic.grid");
1695 struct Candidate {
1696 Unit::Navigation* navigation = nullptr;
1697 SubjectRef subject;
1698 int priority = 0;
1699 };
1700 std::map<std::pair<int, int>, std::vector<Candidate>> contenders;
1701 std::size_t processed = 0;
1702 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders, Unit::Containment>();
1703 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1704 auto [identity, navigation, orders, containment] = *it;
1705 if (identity == nullptr)
1706 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
1707 "RTS traffic candidate has no identity", "unit.identity");
1708 navigation->trafficWaiting = false;
1709 if (containment->container.isBound()) continue;
1710 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
1711 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
1712 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
1713 if (!record || !movementOrder(record->kind) || navigation->unreachable ||
1714 navigation->plannedOrderId != record->id || navigation->waypointIndex >= navigation->waypoints.size())
1715 continue;
1716 ++processed;
1717 const auto waypoint = navigation->waypoints[navigation->waypointIndex];
1718 const int x = static_cast<int>(std::lround((waypoint.x - grid.originX) / grid.cellSize));
1719 const int y = static_cast<int>(std::lround((waypoint.y - grid.originY) / grid.cellSize));
1720 static constexpr int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
1721 static constexpr int dy[] = {0, 0, 1, -1};
1722 int exits = 0;
1723 for (int direction = 0; direction < 4; ++direction)
1724 if (pathfinder.isWalkable(x + dx[direction], y + dy[direction])) ++exits;
1725 if (exits <= 2)
1726 contenders[{x, y}].push_back({navigation, identity->subject, navigation->movementPriority});
1727 }
1728 for (auto& [cell, values] : contenders) {
1729 (void)cell;
1730 if (values.size() < 2) continue;
1731 std::sort(values.begin(), values.end(), [](const Candidate& left, const Candidate& right) {
1732 if (left.priority != right.priority) return left.priority > right.priority;
1733 return left.subject.format() < right.subject.format();
1734 });
1735 for (std::size_t index = 1; index < values.size(); ++index)
1736 values[index].navigation->trafficWaiting = true;
1737 }
1738 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
1739 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1740}
1741
1742void FogOfWarSystem::clear(State& state) noexcept {
1743 for (const auto& binding : state.bindings)
1744 if (binding.provider != nullptr && binding.revealer >= 0)
1745 binding.provider->removeRevealer(binding.revealer);
1746 state.bindings.clear();
1747}
1748
1749const Faction::Intel::Contact* FogOfWarSystem::contact(const Faction& faction, SubjectRef subject) noexcept {
1750 const auto& contacts = const_cast<Faction&>(faction).intel()->contacts;
1751 const auto it = std::find_if(contacts.begin(), contacts.end(),
1752 [&](const auto& value) { return value.subject == subject; });
1753 return it != contacts.end() && it->subject == subject ? &*it : nullptr;
1754}
1755
1756Result<std::size_t> FogOfWarSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const NavigationGrid& grid, State& state,
1757 const FogProvider& provider) {
1758 if (!provider)
1759 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS fog provider is required", "fog.provider");
1760 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0 || !std::isfinite(grid.cellSize) || grid.cellSize <= 0.0f)
1761 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS fog step/grid is invalid", "fog.grid");
1762 struct Source {
1763 ecs::EntityHandle handle{};
1764 ecs::EntityHandle faction{};
1765 map::Fov* fov = nullptr;
1766 WorldPosition position;
1767 float sight = 0.0f;
1768 float detectionRange = 0.0f;
1769 float detectionStrength = 0.0f;
1770 float radarRange = 0.0f;
1771 float radarResolution = 0.0f;
1772 float jammingRange = 0.0f;
1773 };
1774 std::vector<Source> sources;
1775 auto addSource = [&](ecs::EntityHandle handle, const FactionLink& factionLink, WorldPosition position,
1776 float sight, float detectionRange, float detectionStrength, float radarRange,
1777 float radarResolution, float jammingRange, bool enabled) -> Result<void> {
1778 if (!enabled || (sight <= 0.0f && radarRange <= 0.0f && jammingRange <= 0.0f))
1779 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
1780 if (!finitePosition(position) || !std::isfinite(sight) || !std::isfinite(detectionRange) ||
1781 !std::isfinite(detectionStrength) || !std::isfinite(radarRange) ||
1782 !std::isfinite(radarResolution) || !std::isfinite(jammingRange) || sight < 0.0f ||
1783 detectionRange < 0.0f || detectionStrength < 0.0f || radarRange < 0.0f ||
1784 radarResolution < 0.0f || jammingRange < 0.0f)
1785 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS vision values must be finite and non-negative",
1786 "vision");
1787 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(factionLink.resolve());
1788 if (faction == nullptr) return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
1789 map::Fov* fov = provider(*faction);
1790 if (fov == nullptr) return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
1791 sources.push_back({handle, ecs::handle_of(faction), fov, position, sight, detectionRange,
1792 detectionStrength, radarRange, radarResolution, jammingRange});
1793 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1794 };
1795 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Vision, Unit::Containment>();
1796 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
