1797 auto [identity, motion, faction, vision, containment] = *it;
1798 if (containment->container.isBound()) continue;
1799 auto added = addSource(identity->self, faction->link, {motion->x, motion->y}, vision->sightRange,
1800 vision->detectionRange, vision->detectionStrength, vision->radarRange,
1801 vision->radarResolution, vision->jammingRange, vision->enabled);
1802 if (!added) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(added.status());
1803 }
1804 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
1805 Building::Vision, Building::Construction>();
1806 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
1807 auto [identity, placement, faction, vision, construction] = *it;
1808 if (!placement->placed || construction->progress < 1.0f) continue;
1809 auto added = addSource(identity->self, faction->link, {placement->worldX, placement->worldY},
1810 vision->sightRange, vision->detectionRange, vision->detectionStrength,
1811 vision->radarRange, vision->radarResolution, vision->jammingRange,
1812 vision->enabled);
1813 if (!added) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(added.status());
1814 }
1815 state.bindings.erase(std::remove_if(state.bindings.begin(), state.bindings.end(), [&](const auto& binding) {
1816 const bool retained = std::any_of(sources.begin(), sources.end(), [&](const Source& source) {
1817 return source.sight > 0.0f && sameHandle(source.handle, binding.source) && source.fov == binding.provider;
1818 });
1819 if (!retained && binding.provider != nullptr && binding.revealer >= 0)
1820 binding.provider->removeRevealer(binding.revealer);
1821 return !retained;
1822 }), state.bindings.end());
1823 const auto worldToCell = [&](float value, float origin) {
1824 return static_cast<int>(std::lround((value - origin) / grid.cellSize));
1825 };
1826 std::vector<map::Fov*> providers;
1827 for (const auto& source : sources) {
1828 if (source.sight <= 0.0f) continue;
1829 auto binding = std::find_if(state.bindings.begin(), state.bindings.end(), [&](const auto& value) {
1830 return sameHandle(value.source, source.handle) && value.provider == source.fov;
1831 });
1832 const int x = worldToCell(source.position.x, grid.originX);
1833 const int y = worldToCell(source.position.y, grid.originY);
1834 const int radius = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(source.sight / grid.cellSize)));
1835 if (binding == state.bindings.end()) {
1836 const int revealer = source.fov->addRevealer(x, y, radius);
1837 state.bindings.push_back({source.handle, source.faction, source.fov, revealer});
1838 } else {
1839 source.fov->setRevealerPosition(binding->revealer, x, y);
1840 source.fov->setRevealerRadius(binding->revealer, radius);
1841 binding->faction = source.faction;
1842 }
1843 if (std::find(providers.begin(), providers.end(), source.fov) == providers.end())
1844 providers.push_back(source.fov);
1845 }
1846 for (auto* fov : providers) fov->compute();
1847
1848 auto factions = ecs::View<Faction, Faction::Identity, Faction::Intel>();
1849 for (auto fit = factions.begin(); fit != factions.end(); ++fit) {
1850 auto [identity, intel] = *fit;
1851 auto* viewer = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1852 map::Fov* fov = viewer == nullptr ? nullptr : provider(*viewer);
1853 intel->enabled = fov != nullptr;
1854 for (auto& value : intel->contacts) {
1855 value.ageSeconds += step.delta.seconds();
1856 value.visible = false;
1857 value.detected = false;
1858 }
1859 if (fov == nullptr) continue;
1860 auto observe = [&](SubjectRef subject, std::string_view kind, ecs::EntityHandle targetFaction,
1861 WorldPosition position, bool cloaked, float stealth) {
1862 auto* enemyFaction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(targetFaction));
1863 if (enemyFaction == nullptr || enemyFaction == viewer || provider(*enemyFaction) == fov) return;
1864 const int x = worldToCell(position.x, grid.originX);
1865 const int y = worldToCell(position.y, grid.originY);
1866 bool detected = !cloaked;
1867 if (cloaked && fov->isVisible(x, y)) {
1868 for (const auto& source : sources) {
1869 if (source.fov != fov || source.detectionRange <= 0.0f ||
1870 source.detectionStrength < stealth) continue;
1871 if (distanceSquared(source.position.x, source.position.y, position.x, position.y) <=
1872 source.detectionRange * source.detectionRange) {
1873 detected = true;
1874 break;
1875 }
1876 }
1877 }
1878 const bool visible = fov->isVisible(x, y) && detected;
1879 auto found = std::lower_bound(intel->contacts.begin(), intel->contacts.end(), subject,
1880 [](const auto& value, SubjectRef key) {
1881 return value.subject.format() < key.format();
1882 });
1883 if (!visible) {
1884 const bool jammed = std::any_of(sources.begin(), sources.end(), [&](const Source& jammer) {
1885 if (jammer.jammingRange <= 0.0f || jammer.fov == fov) return false;
1886 return distanceSquared(jammer.position.x, jammer.position.y, position.x, position.y) <=
1887 jammer.jammingRange * jammer.jammingRange;
1888 });
1889 const Source* radar = nullptr;
1890 if (!jammed) {
1891 for (const auto& candidate : sources) {
1892 if (candidate.fov != fov || candidate.radarRange <= 0.0f) continue;
1893 if (distanceSquared(candidate.position.x, candidate.position.y, position.x, position.y) <=
1894 candidate.radarRange * candidate.radarRange) {
1895 radar = &candidate;
1896 break;
1897 }
1898 }
1899 }
1900 if (radar == nullptr) return;
1901 const float resolution = radar->radarResolution > 0.0f ? radar->radarResolution : grid.cellSize;
1902 const WorldPosition quantized{
1903 grid.originX + (std::floor((position.x - grid.originX) / resolution) + 0.5f) * resolution,
1904 grid.originY + (std::floor((position.y - grid.originY) / resolution) + 0.5f) * resolution};
1905 const std::string radarKind = kind == "unit" ? "radar_unit" : "radar_building";
1906 if (found == intel->contacts.end() || found->subject != subject)
1907 intel->contacts.insert(found, {subject, radarKind, quantized, 0.0, false, false});
1908 else {
1909 found->position = quantized;
1910 found->ageSeconds = 0.0;
1911 found->visible = false;
1912 found->detected = false;
1913 found->kind = radarKind;
1914 }
1915 return;
1916 }
1917 if (found == intel->contacts.end() || found->subject != subject)
1918 found = intel->contacts.insert(found, {subject, std::string(kind), position, 0.0, true, detected});
1919 else {
1920 found->position = position;
1921 found->ageSeconds = 0.0;
1922 found->visible = true;
1923 found->detected = detected;
1924 found->kind = kind;
1925 }
1926 };
1927 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
1928 auto [targetIdentity, motion, faction, vision, containment] = *it;
1929 if (!containment->container.isBound())
1930 observe(targetIdentity->subject, "unit", faction->link.handle(), {motion->x, motion->y},
1931 vision->cloaked, vision->stealth);
1932 }
1933 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
1934 auto [targetIdentity, placement, faction, vision, construction] = *it;
1935 if (placement->placed)
1936 observe(targetIdentity->subject, "building", faction->link.handle(),
1937 {placement->worldX, placement->worldY}, false, 0.0f);
1938 }
1939 }
1940 return Result<std::size_t>::success(sources.size(),
1941 Status::success(sources.empty() ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1942}
1943
1944Result<std::size_t> CrowdMotionSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, crowd::Crowd& crowd) {
1945 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
1946 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS crowd step delta must be non-negative",
1947 "step.delta");
1948 struct LinkedUnit {
1949 Unit* unit;
1950 Unit::Motion* motion;
1951 Unit::Navigation* navigation;
1952 Unit::Crowd* settings;
1953 Unit::Combat* combat;
1954 Unit::Supply* supply;
1955 Unit::Morale* morale;
1956 Unit::Tactics* tactics;
1957 Unit::Command* command;
1958 Unit::Effects* effects;
1959 OrderComponent* orders;
1960 };
1961 std::vector<LinkedUnit> linked;
1962 std::vector<std::string> keys;
1963 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Navigation, Unit::Orders, Unit::Crowd, Unit::Combat,
1964 Unit::Containment, Unit::Supply, Unit::Morale, Unit::Tactics, Unit::Command,
1965 Unit::Effects>();
1966 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
1967 auto [identity, motion, navigation, orders, settings, combat, containment, supply, morale, tactics,
1968 command, effects] = *it;
1969 auto* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
1970 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
1971 if (!settings->link.isBound() || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
1972 const std::string& key = settings->link.key();
1973 if (std::find(keys.begin(), keys.end(), key) != keys.end())
1974 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS crowd agent keys must be unique",
1975 "unit.crowd.link");
1976 keys.push_back(key);
1977 linked.push_back({unit, motion, navigation, settings, combat, supply, morale, tactics, command, effects,
1978 &orders->values});
1979 }
1980 if (linked.empty())
1981 return Result<std::size_t>::success(0, Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
1982
1983 for (const auto& entry : linked) {
1984 const std::string& key = entry.settings->link.key();
1985 int agent = crowd.getNamedAgentIndex(key);
1986 if (agent < 0) agent = crowd.addNamedAgent(key, entry.motion->x, entry.motion->y,
1987 entry.settings->heading, entry.settings->radius);
1988 if (agent < 0)
1989 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::Failed, "canonical Crowd rejected an RTS agent",
1990 "unit.crowd.link");
1991 crowd.setAgentPosition(agent, entry.motion->x, entry.motion->y);
1992 crowd.setAgentRadius(agent, entry.settings->radius);
1993 auto priority = crowd.setAgentAvoidancePriority(agent, entry.navigation->movementPriority);
1994 if (!priority) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(priority.status());
1995 const float speedFactor = entry.morale->active
1996 ? std::clamp(entry.morale->suppressedSpeedFactor, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 1.0f;
1997 const float commandFactor = entry.command->requiresCommand && !entry.command->inCommand
1998 ? entry.command->outOfCommandSpeedFactor : 1.0f;
1999 const float effectFactor = static_cast<float>(entry.effects->values.multiplier("speedMultiplier"));
2000 crowd.setAgentSpeed(agent, entry.motion->speed * speedFactor * commandFactor * effectFactor);
2001 auto current = readCurrent(*entry.orders);
2002 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2003 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2004 bool attackMoveEngaged = false;
2005 if (record && record->kind == OrderKind::AttackMove && entry.combat->engagementRange > 0.0f) {
2006 auto engaged = entityPosition(entry.combat->target);
2007 attackMoveEngaged = engaged &&
2008 distanceSquared(entry.motion->x, entry.motion->y, engaged->x, engaged->y) <=
2009 entry.combat->engagementRange * entry.combat->engagementRange;
2010 }
2011 if (record && movementOrder(record->kind) && !entry.navigation->trafficWaiting &&
2012 !(entry.morale->retreating && entry.tactics->retreatCovering) && !attackMoveEngaged) {
2013 WorldPosition target = record->target;
2014 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Attack || record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply ||
2015 record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay) {
2016 auto liveTarget = entityPosition(record->targetEntity);
2017 if (liveTarget) target = *liveTarget;
2018 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Escort && entry.tactics->guardSet) {
2019 target = {entry.tactics->guardX, entry.tactics->guardY};
2020 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Patrol && entry.navigation->patrolInitialized &&
2021 !entry.navigation->patrolTowardTarget) {
2022 target = entry.navigation->patrolOrigin;
2023 }
2024 if (entry.navigation->plannedOrderId == record->id && !entry.navigation->unreachable &&
2025 entry.navigation->waypointIndex < entry.navigation->waypoints.size())
2026 target = entry.navigation->waypoints[entry.navigation->waypointIndex];
2027 crowd.setAgentTarget(agent, target.x, target.y);
2028 crowd.setAgentAction(agent, "seek");
2029 } else {
2030 crowd.clearAgentTarget(agent);
2031 crowd.setAgentAction(agent, "idle");
2032 }
2033 }
2034 crowd.step(static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()));
2035 for (const auto& entry : linked) {
2036 const int agent = crowd.getNamedAgentIndex(entry.settings->link.key());
2037 const auto state = crowd.getAgentState(agent);
2038 if (state.action < 0)
2039 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation, "canonical Crowd lost an RTS agent",
2040 "unit.crowd.link");
2041 entry.motion->x = state.x;
2042 entry.motion->y = state.y;
2043 entry.settings->heading = state.heading;
2044 auto current = readCurrent(*entry.orders);
2045 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2046 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2047 if (!record || !movementOrder(record->kind)) {
2048 entry.motion->arrived = true;
2049 continue;
2050 }
2051 WorldPosition target = record->target;
2052 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Attack || record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply ||
2053 record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay) {
2054 auto liveTarget = entityPosition(record->targetEntity);
2055 if (liveTarget) target = *liveTarget;
2056 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Escort && entry.tactics->guardSet) {
2057 target = {entry.tactics->guardX, entry.tactics->guardY};
2058 }
2059 const float remaining = std::sqrt(distanceSquared(state.x, state.y, target.x, target.y));
2060 float arrivalRadius = entry.motion->arrivalRadius;
2061 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Attack)
2062 arrivalRadius = std::max(arrivalRadius, entry.combat->engagementRange);
2063 else if (record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply || record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay)
2064 arrivalRadius = std::max(arrivalRadius, entry.supply->range * 0.8f);
2065 entry.motion->arrived = remaining <= arrivalRadius;
2066 if (entry.motion->arrived) {
2067 if (record->kind != OrderKind::Attack) {
2068 entry.motion->x = target.x;
2069 entry.motion->y = target.y;
2070 }
2071 crowd.setAgentPosition(agent, entry.motion->x, entry.motion->y);
2072 crowd.setAgentAction(agent, "idle");
2073 }
2074 }
2075 return Result<std::size_t>::success(linked.size(), Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2076}
2077
2078Result<std::size_t> WorkerAssignmentSystem::step() {
2079 struct Candidate {
2080 ResourceNode* node = nullptr;
2081 float distance = 0.0f;
2082 };
2083 std::size_t assigned = 0;
2084 auto workers = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Worker>();
2085 for (auto it = workers.begin(); it != workers.end(); ++it) {
2086 auto [identity, motion, orders, worker] = *it;
2087 auto* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2088 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
2089 if (!worker->autoAssign || worker->capacity <= 0.0f || worker->gatherRate <= 0.0f ||
2090 worker->resourceType.empty() || !orders->values.empty() || !worker->dropoff.isBound() ||
2091 worker->dropoff.isStale())
2092 continue;
2093
2094 std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
2095 auto nodes = ecs::View<ResourceNode, ResourceNode::Identity, ResourceNode::Position, ResourceNode::Stock,
2096 ResourceNode::Harvest>();
2097 for (auto nodeIt = nodes.begin(); nodeIt != nodes.end(); ++nodeIt) {
2098 auto [nodeIdentity, position, stock, harvest] = *nodeIt;
2099 auto* node = nodeIdentity == nullptr
2100 ? nullptr
2101 : dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(ecs::try_get(nodeIdentity->self));
2102 if (node == nullptr || stock->resourceType != worker->resourceType ||
2103 (!stock->infinite && stock->remaining <= 0.0f))
2104 continue;
2105 harvest->workers.erase(
2106 std::remove_if(harvest->workers.begin(), harvest->workers.end(),
2107 [](const ecs::EntityHandle& handle) { return ecs::try_get(handle) == nullptr; }),
2108 harvest->workers.end());
2109 if (harvest->workers.size() >= harvest->capacity) continue;
2110 candidates.push_back({node, distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, position->x, position->y)});
2111 }
2112 std::sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const Candidate& left, const Candidate& right) {
2113 if (left.distance != right.distance) return left.distance < right.distance;
2114 return left.node->identity()->self.id < right.node->identity()->self.id;
2115 });
2116 if (candidates.empty()) continue;
2117 ResourceNode* node = candidates.front().node;
2118 auto link = ResourceNodeLink::bind(ecs::handle_of(node));
2119 if (!link) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(link.status());
2120 worker->resourceNode = std::move(link).takeValue();
2121 node->harvest()->workers.push_back(ecs::handle_of(unit));
2122 CommandSpec command;
2123 command.kind = OrderKind::Gather;
2124 command.target = {node->position()->x, node->position()->y};
2125 command.targetEntity = ecs::handle_of(node);
2126 auto queued = orders->values.enqueue(command);
2127 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
2128 std::move(queued).takeValue();
2129 ++assigned;
2130 }
2131 return Result<std::size_t>::success(assigned,
2132 Status::success(assigned == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2133}
2134
2135Result<std::size_t> MiningSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const ResourceCredit& credit) {
2136 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0 || !credit)
2137 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2138 "RTS mining requires non-negative time and a resource credit callback", "mining");
2139 std::size_t processed = 0;
2140 auto workers = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Worker>();
2141 for (auto it = workers.begin(); it != workers.end(); ++it) {
2142 auto [identity, motion, orders, worker] = *it;
2143 auto* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2144 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
2145 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2146 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2147 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2148 if (!record) continue;
2149
2150 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Gather && motion->arrived) {
2151 auto* node = dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(worker->resourceNode.resolve());
2152 if (node == nullptr) {
2153 auto failed = orders->values.fail(record->id, "resource node is stale");
2154 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
2155 worker->resourceNode.reset();
2156 continue;
2157 }
2158 const float room = std::max(0.0f, worker->capacity - worker->cargo);
2159 float amount = std::min(room, worker->gatherRate * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()));
2160 if (!node->stock()->infinite) amount = std::min(amount, node->stock()->remaining);
2161 worker->cargo += amount;
2162 if (!node->stock()->infinite) node->stock()->remaining -= amount;
2163 if (worker->cargo >= worker->capacity || (!node->stock()->infinite && node->stock()->remaining <= 0.0f)) {
2164 auto* dropoff = dynamic_cast<Building*>(worker->dropoff.resolve());
2165 if (dropoff == nullptr) {
2166 auto failed = orders->values.fail(record->id, "dropoff is stale");
2167 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
2168 continue;
2169 }
2170 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
2171 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
2172 CommandSpec returning;
2173 returning.kind = OrderKind::ReturnCargo;
2174 returning.target = {dropoff->placement()->worldX, dropoff->placement()->worldY};
2175 returning.targetEntity = ecs::handle_of(dropoff);
2176 auto queued = orders->values.enqueue(returning);
2177 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
2178 std::move(queued).takeValue();
2179 }
2180 ++processed;
2181 } else if (record->kind == OrderKind::ReturnCargo && motion->arrived && worker->cargo >= 1.0f) {
2182 const auto whole = static_cast<std::int64_t>(std::floor(worker->cargo));
2183 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(worker->resourceType, whole);
2184 if (!cost) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(cost.status());
2185 auto credited = credit(*unit, cost.value());
2186 if (!credited) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(credited.status());
2187 worker->cargo -= static_cast<float>(whole);
2188 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
2189 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
2190 auto* node = dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(worker->resourceNode.resolve());
2191 if (node != nullptr && (node->stock()->infinite || node->stock()->remaining > 0.0f)) {
2192 CommandSpec gather;
2193 gather.kind = OrderKind::Gather;
2194 gather.target = {node->position()->x, node->position()->y};
2195 gather.targetEntity = ecs::handle_of(node);
2196 auto queued = orders->values.enqueue(gather);
2197 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
2198 std::move(queued).takeValue();
2199 } else {
2200 worker->resourceNode.reset();
2201 }
2202 ++processed;
2203 }
2204 }
2205 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2206 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2207}
2208
2209Result<std::size_t> ConstructionSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
2210 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
2211 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2212 "RTS construction step delta must be non-negative", "step.delta");
2213 std::size_t processed = 0;
2214 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Construction, Building::Faction>();
2215 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
2216 auto [identity, construction, faction] = *it;
2217 auto* building = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2218 if (building == nullptr || &*building->identity() != identity) continue;
2219 if (!std::isfinite(construction->progress) || !std::isfinite(construction->buildTimeSeconds) ||
2220 construction->buildTimeSeconds < 0.0f)
2221 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "invalid RTS construction state",
2222 "building.construction");
2223 if (construction->progress >= 1.0f || construction->paused) continue;
2224
2225 construction->builders.clear();
2226 if (events)
2227 events({LifecycleEventKind::ConstructionCompleted, identity->subject, {},
2228 building->definition()->id.format(), 1.0}, step.tick);
2229 float totalRate = 0.0f;
2230 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Worker, Unit::Faction>();
2231 for (auto unitIt = units.begin(); unitIt != units.end(); ++unitIt) {
2232 auto [unitIdentity, motion, orders, worker, unitFaction] = *unitIt;
2233 auto* unit = unitIdentity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(unitIdentity->self));
2234 if (unit == nullptr || !motion->arrived || worker->buildRate <= 0.0f ||
2235 unitFaction->link.resolve() != faction->link.resolve())
2236 continue;
2237 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2238 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2239 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2240 if (!record || record->kind != OrderKind::Build || !sameHandle(record->targetEntity, identity->self))
2241 continue;
2242 construction->builders.push_back(unitIdentity->self);
2243 totalRate += worker->buildRate;
2244 }
2245 if (totalRate <= 0.0f) continue;
2246 if (construction->buildTimeSeconds == 0.0f) construction->progress = 1.0f;
2247 else construction->progress = std::min(1.0f, construction->progress +
2248 totalRate * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()) / construction->buildTimeSeconds);
2249 ++processed;
2250 if (construction->progress < 1.0f) continue;
2251 for (const auto& builderHandle : construction->builders) {
2252 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(builderHandle));
2253 if (unit == nullptr) continue;
2254 auto current = readCurrent(unit->orders()->values);
2255 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2256 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2257 if (record && record->kind == OrderKind::Build && sameHandle(record->targetEntity, identity->self)) {
2258 auto completed = unit->orders()->values.complete(record->id);
2259 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
2260 }
2261 }
2262 construction->builders.clear();
2263 }
2264 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2265 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2266}
2267
2268Result<std::size_t> WorkforceAssignmentSystem::step() {
2269 struct WorkerCandidate { Unit* unit; };
2270 struct Target { Building* building; OrderKind kind; std::size_t limit; };
2271 std::size_t processed = 0;
2272 auto factions = ecs::View<Faction, Faction::Identity, Faction::Workforce>();
2273 for (auto factionIt = factions.begin(); factionIt != factions.end(); ++factionIt) {
2274 auto [factionIdentity, policy] = *factionIt;
2275 if (!policy->autoConstruction && !policy->autoRepair) continue;
2276 if (policy->maxBuildersPerSite == 0 || policy->maxRepairersPerBuilding == 0)
2277 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2278 "RTS workforce assignment limits must be positive", "faction.workforce");
2279 std::vector<WorkerCandidate> idle;
2280 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Orders, Unit::Worker, Unit::Faction,
2281 Unit::Containment, Unit::Durability>();
2282 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
2283 auto [identity, orders, worker, faction, containment, durability] = *it;
2284 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() || !orders->values.empty() ||
2285 faction->link.resolve() != ecs::try_get(factionIdentity->self) ||
2286 (worker->buildRate <= 0.0f && worker->repairRate <= 0.0f)) continue;
2287 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self))) idle.push_back({unit});
2288 }
2289 std::size_t budget = idle.size() > policy->reserveWorkers ? idle.size() - policy->reserveWorkers : 0;
2290 if (budget == 0) continue;
2291
2292 std::vector<Target> targets;
2293 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Faction, Building::Construction,
2294 Building::Integrity>();
2295 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
2296 auto [identity, faction, construction, integrity] = *it;
2297 if (faction->link.resolve() != ecs::try_get(factionIdentity->self) || !integrity->alive) continue;
2298 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2299 if (building == nullptr) continue;
2300 if (policy->autoConstruction && construction->progress < 1.0f && !construction->paused)
2301 targets.push_back({building, OrderKind::Build, policy->maxBuildersPerSite});
2302 else if (policy->autoRepair && construction->progress >= 1.0f &&
2303 integrity->state.health < integrity->state.maxHealth)
2304 targets.push_back({building, OrderKind::Repair, policy->maxRepairersPerBuilding});
2305 }
2306 std::sort(targets.begin(), targets.end(), [](const Target& left, const Target& right) {
2307 return left.building->identity()->self.id < right.building->identity()->self.id;
2308 });
2309 for (const Target& target : targets) {
2310 if (budget == 0 || idle.empty()) break;
2311 std::size_t assigned = 0;
2312 auto assignedView = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Orders, Unit::Faction>();
2313 for (auto it = assignedView.begin(); it != assignedView.end(); ++it) {
2314 auto [orders, faction] = *it;
2315 if (faction->link.resolve() != ecs::try_get(factionIdentity->self)) continue;
2316 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2317 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2318 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2319 if (record && record->kind == target.kind &&
2320 sameHandle(record->targetEntity, target.building->identity()->self)) ++assigned;
2321 }
2322 while (assigned < target.limit && budget > 0) {
2323 auto best = idle.end();
2324 float bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
2325 for (auto it = idle.begin(); it != idle.end(); ++it) {
2326 auto* worker = it->unit;
2327 if ((target.kind == OrderKind::Build && worker->worker()->buildRate <= 0.0f) ||
2328 (target.kind == OrderKind::Repair && worker->worker()->repairRate <= 0.0f)) continue;
2329 const float distance = distanceSquared(worker->motion()->x, worker->motion()->y,
2330 target.building->placement()->worldX,
2331 target.building->placement()->worldY);
2332 if (best == idle.end() || distance < bestDistance ||
2333 (distance == bestDistance && worker->identity()->self.id < best->unit->identity()->self.id)) {
2334 best = it;
2335 bestDistance = distance;
2336 }
2337 }
2338 if (best == idle.end()) break;
2339 CommandSpec command;
2340 command.kind = target.kind;
2341 command.target = {target.building->placement()->worldX, target.building->placement()->worldY};
2342 command.targetEntity = target.building->identity()->self;
2343 auto queued = best->unit->orders()->values.replace(command);
2344 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
2345 std::move(queued).takeValue();
2346 idle.erase(best);
2347 --budget;
2348 ++assigned;
2349 ++processed;
2350 }
2351 }
2352 }
2353 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2354 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2355}
2356
2357Result<std::size_t> RepairSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const RepairDebit& debit) {
2358 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0 || !debit)
2359 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2360 "RTS repair requires non-negative time and a debit callback", "repair");
2361 std::size_t processed = 0;
2362 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Worker, Unit::Faction>();
2363 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
2364 auto [identity, motion, orders, worker, faction] = *it;
2365 auto* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2366 if (unit == nullptr || !motion->arrived || worker->repairRate <= 0.0f) continue;
2367 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2368 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2369 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2370 if (!record || record->kind != OrderKind::Repair) continue;
2371 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(record->targetEntity));
2372 if (building == nullptr || building->faction()->link.resolve() != faction->link.resolve() ||
2373 building->construction()->progress < 1.0f) {
2374 auto failed = orders->values.fail(record->id, "repair target is invalid");
2375 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
2376 continue;
2377 }
2378 auto integrity = building->integrity();
2379 const float missing = static_cast<float>(std::max(0.0, integrity->state.maxHealth - integrity->state.health));
2380 if (missing <= 0.0f) {
2381 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
2382 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
2383 continue;
2384 }
2385 const float healed = std::min(missing, worker->repairRate * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()));
2386 const float accumulatedCost = integrity->repairCostRemainder + healed * integrity->repairCostPerHealth;
2387 const auto wholeCost = static_cast<std::int64_t>(std::floor(accumulatedCost));
2388 if (wholeCost > 0) {
2389 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(integrity->repairResource, wholeCost);
2390 if (!cost) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(cost.status());
2391 auto paid = debit(*unit, *building, cost.value());
2392 if (!paid) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(paid.status());
2393 }
2394 integrity->repairCostRemainder = accumulatedCost - static_cast<float>(wholeCost);
2395 integrity->state.health += healed;
2396 ++processed;
2397 }
2398 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2399 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2400}
2401
2402Result<std::size_t> CaptureSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
2403 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
2404 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2405 "RTS capture step delta must be non-negative", "step.delta");
2406 struct Force { ecs::EntityHandle faction{}; float strength = 0.0f; std::vector<Unit*> units; };
2407 std::size_t processed = 0;
2408 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Capture, Building::Construction,
2409 Building::Faction, Building::Rally>();
2410 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
2411 auto [identity, capture, construction, owner, rally] = *it;
2412 auto* building = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2413 if (building == nullptr || !capture->capturable || capture->blockedByGarrison ||
2414 construction->progress < 1.0f)
2415 continue;
2416 if (!std::isfinite(capture->durationSeconds) || capture->durationSeconds <= 0.0f)
2417 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "capture duration must be positive",
2418 "building.capture.durationSeconds");
2419 std::vector<Force> forces;
2420 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Capture, Unit::Faction>();
2421 for (auto unitIt = units.begin(); unitIt != units.end(); ++unitIt) {
2422 auto [unitIdentity, motion, orders, contribution, faction] = *unitIt;
2423 auto* unit = unitIdentity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(unitIdentity->self));
2424 if (unit == nullptr || !motion->arrived || contribution->rate <= 0.0f ||
2425 faction->link.resolve() == nullptr || FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(faction->link, owner->link))
2426 continue;
2427 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2428 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2429 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2430 if (!record || record->kind != OrderKind::Capture || !sameHandle(record->targetEntity, identity->self))
2431 continue;
2432 auto found = std::find_if(forces.begin(), forces.end(), [&](const Force& force) {
2433 return sameHandle(force.faction, faction->link.handle());
2434 });
2435 if (found == forces.end()) { forces.push_back({faction->link.handle(), 0.0f, {}}); found = forces.end() - 1; }
2436 found->strength += contribution->rate;
2437 found->units.push_back(unit);
2438 }
2439 const float dt = static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
2440 if (forces.empty()) {
2441 capture->progress = std::max(0.0f, capture->progress - dt / capture->durationSeconds);
2442 if (capture->progress == 0.0f) capture->capturingFaction = {};
2443 continue;
2444 }
2445 if (forces.size() != 1) continue;
2446 Force& force = forces.front();
2447 if (ecs::try_get(capture->capturingFaction) != nullptr &&
2448 !sameHandle(capture->capturingFaction, force.faction)) {
2449 capture->progress = std::max(0.0f, capture->progress - force.strength * dt / capture->durationSeconds);
2450 if (capture->progress == 0.0f) capture->capturingFaction = force.faction;
2451 continue;
2452 }
2453 capture->capturingFaction = force.faction;
2454 capture->progress = std::min(1.0f, capture->progress + force.strength * dt / capture->durationSeconds);
2455 ++processed;
2456 if (capture->progress < 1.0f) continue;
2457 auto linked = FactionLink::bind(force.faction);
2458 if (!linked) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(linked.status());
2459 owner->link = std::move(linked).takeValue();
2460 if (rally->enabled && rally->combatGroup != 0) {
2461 rally->combatGroup = ((static_cast<std::uint64_t>(force.faction.id) + 1u) << 32u) |
2462 (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(identity->self.id) + 1u);
2463 rally->reinforcements.clear();
2464 rally->reinforcementCapped = false;
2465 rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask.clear();
2466 rally->reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
2467 }
2468 capture->progress = 0.0f;
2469 capture->capturingFaction = {};
2470 if (events) {
2471 Unit* capturer = *std::min_element(force.units.begin(), force.units.end(),
2472 [](Unit* left, Unit* right) {
2473 return left->identity()->subject.format() < right->identity()->subject.format();
2474 });
2475 events({LifecycleEventKind::BuildingCaptured, identity->subject,
2476 capturer->identity()->subject, building->definition()->id.format(), 1.0}, step.tick);
2477 }
2478 for (Unit* unit : force.units) {
2479 auto current = readCurrent(unit->orders()->values);
2480 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2481 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2482 if (record) {
2483 auto completed = unit->orders()->values.complete(record->id);
2484 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
2485 }
2486 }
2487 }
2488 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2489 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2490}
2491
2492Result<std::size_t> InfrastructureSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step,
2493 const PassiveIncomeCredit& credit) {
2494 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
2495 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2496 "RTS infrastructure step delta must be non-negative", "step.delta");
2497
2498 struct Group { std::vector<Building*> buildings; };
2499 std::map<std::string, Group> groups;
2500 auto view = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Faction, Building::Construction,
2501 Building::Integrity, Building::Infrastructure>();
2502 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
2503 auto [identity, faction, construction, integrity, infrastructure] = *it;
2504 auto* building = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2505 if (building == nullptr || &*building->identity() != identity) continue;
2506 if (!std::isfinite(infrastructure->powerProduced) || infrastructure->powerProduced < 0.0f ||
2507 !std::isfinite(infrastructure->powerConsumed) || infrastructure->powerConsumed < 0.0f ||
2508 !std::isfinite(infrastructure->incomeRate) || infrastructure->incomeRate < 0.0f ||
2509 !std::isfinite(infrastructure->incomeProgress) || infrastructure->incomeProgress < 0.0f ||
2510 !std::isfinite(infrastructure->buildInfluenceRadius) || infrastructure->buildInfluenceRadius < 0.0f)
2511 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2512 "RTS building infrastructure values must be finite and non-negative",
2513 "building.infrastructure");
2514 if (!integrity->alive || integrity->state.health <= 0.0 || construction->progress < 1.0f) {
2515 infrastructure->powered = false;
2516 continue;
2517 }
2518 auto* owner = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve());
2519 if (owner == nullptr || !owner->identity()->subject.isValid()) {
2520 infrastructure->powered = infrastructure->powerConsumed == 0.0f;
2521 continue;
2522 }
2523 groups[owner->identity()->subject.format()].buildings.push_back(building);
2524 }
2525
2526 std::size_t processed = 0;
2527 const float dt = static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
2528 for (auto& [_, group] : groups) {
2529 float available = 0.0f;
2530 for (Building* building : group.buildings)
2531 available += building->infrastructure()->powerProduced;
2532 std::sort(group.buildings.begin(), group.buildings.end(), [](Building* left, Building* right) {
2533 if (left->infrastructure()->powerPriority != right->infrastructure()->powerPriority)
2534 return left->infrastructure()->powerPriority > right->infrastructure()->powerPriority;
2535 return left->identity()->subject.format() < right->identity()->subject.format();
2536 });
2537 for (Building* building : group.buildings) {
2538 auto infrastructure = building->infrastructure();
2539 infrastructure->powered = infrastructure->powerConsumed <= available + 1e-6f;
2540 if (infrastructure->powered) available -= infrastructure->powerConsumed;
2541 ++processed;
2542 if (!infrastructure->powered || infrastructure->incomeRate == 0.0f ||
2543 infrastructure->incomeResource.empty()) continue;
2544 infrastructure->incomeProgress += infrastructure->incomeRate * dt;
2545 if (!credit) continue;
2546 const auto whole = static_cast<std::int64_t>(std::floor(infrastructure->incomeProgress));
2547 if (whole <= 0) continue;
2548 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(infrastructure->incomeResource, whole);
2549 if (!cost) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(cost.status());
2550 auto receipt = credit(*building, cost.value());
2551 if (!receipt) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(receipt.status());
2552 infrastructure->incomeProgress -= static_cast<float>(whole);
2553 }
2554 }
2555 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2556 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2557}
2558
2559Result<std::size_t> ContainmentSystem::step() {
2560 std::size_t processed = 0;
2561 auto retainedBy = [](const ecs::EntityHandle& occupant, const ecs::EntityHandle& container) {
2562 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(occupant));
2563 return unit != nullptr && unit->containment()->container.isBound() &&
2564 sameHandle(unit->containment()->container.handle(), container);
2565 };
2566 auto transports = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Containment>();
2567 for (auto it = transports.begin(); it != transports.end(); ++it) {
2568 auto [identity, containment] = *it;
2569 std::erase_if(containment->occupants,
2570 [&](const auto& occupant) { return !retainedBy(occupant, identity->self); });
2571 }
2572 auto garrisons = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Garrison, Building::Capture>();
2573 for (auto it = garrisons.begin(); it != garrisons.end(); ++it) {
2574 auto [identity, garrison, capture] = *it;
2575 std::erase_if(garrison->occupants,
2576 [&](const auto& occupant) { return !retainedBy(occupant, identity->self); });
2577 capture->blockedByGarrison = !garrison->occupants.empty();
2578 }
2579 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Faction, Unit::Containment>();
2580 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
2581 auto [identity, motion, orders, faction, containment] = *it;
2582 auto* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2583 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
2584
2585 if (containment->container.isBound()) {
2586 ecs::Entity* container = containment->container.resolve();
2587 if (auto* transport = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(container)) {
2588 if (!transport->durability()->alive) {
2589 containment->container.reset();
2590 unit->durability()->alive = false;
2591 continue;
2592 }
2593 motion->x = transport->motion()->x;
2594 motion->y = transport->motion()->y;
2595 } else if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(container)) {
2596 if (!building->integrity()->alive) {
2597 containment->container.reset();
2598 unit->durability()->alive = false;
2599 continue;
2600 }
2601 motion->x = building->placement()->worldX;
2602 motion->y = building->placement()->worldY;
2603 } else {
2604 containment->container.reset();
2605 }
2606 motion->arrived = true;
2607 ++processed;
2608 continue;
2609 }
2610
2611 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2612 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2613 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
2614 if (!record || (record->kind != OrderKind::Garrison && record->kind != OrderKind::BoardTransport) ||
2615 !motion->arrived)
2616 continue;
2617
2618 ecs::Entity* target = ecs::try_get(record->targetEntity);
2619 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle>* occupants = nullptr;
2620 std::size_t capacity = 0;
2621 FactionLink* owner = nullptr;
2622 WorldPosition position{};
2623 if (record->kind == OrderKind::BoardTransport) {
2624 auto* transport = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(target);
2625 if (transport != nullptr && transport != unit && transport->durability()->alive) {
2626 occupants = &transport->containment()->occupants;
2627 capacity = transport->containment()->capacity;
2628 owner = &transport->faction()->link;
2629 position = {transport->motion()->x, transport->motion()->y};
2630 }
2631 } else {
2632 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(target);
2633 if (building != nullptr && building->integrity()->alive && building->construction()->progress >= 1.0f) {
2634 occupants = &building->garrison()->occupants;
2635 capacity = building->garrison()->capacity;
2636 owner = &building->faction()->link;
2637 position = {building->placement()->worldX, building->placement()->worldY};
2638 }
2639 }
2640 if (occupants == nullptr || owner == nullptr || !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*owner, faction->link) ||
2641 occupants->size() >= capacity) {
2642 auto failed = orders->values.fail(record->id, "container is invalid, hostile, or full");
2643 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
2644 continue;
2645 }
2646 auto link = ContainerLink::bind(record->targetEntity);
2647 if (!link) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(link.status());
2648 containment->container = std::move(link).takeValue();
2649 occupants->push_back(identity->self);
2650 std::sort(occupants->begin(), occupants->end(), [](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
2651 if (left.id != right.id) return left.id < right.id;
2652 return left.generation < right.generation;
2653 });
2654 motion->x = position.x;
2655 motion->y = position.y;
2656 motion->arrived = true;
2657 if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(target)) building->capture()->blockedByGarrison = true;
2658 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
2659 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
2660 ++processed;
2661 }
2662 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
2663 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2664}
2665
2666namespace {
2667Result<std::size_t> releaseOccupants(std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle>& occupants, WorldPosition destination) {
2668 if (!std::isfinite(destination.x) || !std::isfinite(destination.y))
2669 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2670 "RTS unload destination must be finite", "destination");
2671 const auto retained = occupants;
2672 occupants.clear();
2673 std::size_t released = 0;
2674 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < retained.size(); ++index) {
2675 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(retained[index]));
2676 if (unit == nullptr || !unit->durability()->alive) continue;
2677 const float angle = static_cast<float>(index) * 2.39996323f;
2678 const float radius = 0.75f * std::sqrt(static_cast<float>(index + 1));
2679 const WorldPosition slot{destination.x + std::cos(angle) * radius,
2680 destination.y + std::sin(angle) * radius};
2681 unit->containment()->container = {};
2682 unit->motion()->x = slot.x;
2683 unit->motion()->y = slot.y;
2684 unit->motion()->arrived = true;
2685 CommandSpec move;
2686 move.kind = OrderKind::Move;
2687 move.target = slot;
2688 auto ordered = unit->orders()->values.replace(move);
2689 if (!ordered) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(ordered.status());
2690 std::move(ordered).takeValue();
2691 ++released;
2692 }
2693 return Result<std::size_t>::success(released,
2694 Status::success(released == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
2695}
2696} // namespace
2697
2698Result<std::size_t> ContainmentSystem::unload(Unit& transport, WorldPosition destination) {
2699 return releaseOccupants(transport.containment()->occupants, destination);
2700}
2701
2702Result<std::size_t> ContainmentSystem::evacuate(Building& building, WorldPosition destination) {
2703 auto result = releaseOccupants(building.garrison()->occupants, destination);
2704 if (result) building.capture()->blockedByGarrison = false;
2705 return result;
2706}
2707
2708Result<SupplyRendezvousSelection> SupplyRendezvousSystem::select(
2709 Unit& supplier, Unit& relay, WorldPosition predicted,
2710 map::Pathfinder& pathfinder, const NavigationGrid& grid) {
2711 if (!finitePosition(predicted) || !std::isfinite(grid.cellSize) || grid.cellSize <= 0.0f ||
2712 !std::isfinite(grid.originX) || !std::isfinite(grid.originY))
2713 return failure<SupplyRendezvousSelection>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2714 "RTS supply rendezvous requires a finite prediction and grid",
2715 "supply.rendezvous");
2716 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(supplier.faction()->link.resolve());
2717 if (faction == nullptr || !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(relay.faction()->link, supplier.faction()->link))
2718 return failure<SupplyRendezvousSelection>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2719 "RTS supply rendezvous requires a shared live faction",
2720 "supply.faction");
2721 WorldPosition forward{relay.motion()->x - supplier.motion()->x,
2722 relay.motion()->y - supplier.motion()->y};
2723 auto relayOrder = readCurrent(relay.orders()->values);
2724 if (!relayOrder) return failureFrom<SupplyRendezvousSelection>(relayOrder.status());
2725 const auto active = std::move(relayOrder).takeValue();
2726 if (active && movementOrder(active->kind)) {
2727 WorldPosition goal = active->target;
2728 if (relay.navigation()->plannedOrderId == active->id && !relay.navigation()->unreachable)
2729 goal = relay.navigation()->plannedGoal;
2730 forward = {goal.x - relay.motion()->x, goal.y - relay.motion()->y};
2731 }
2732 const float forwardLength = std::hypot(forward.x, forward.y);
2733 if (forwardLength > 1e-5f) {
2734 forward.x /= forwardLength;
2735 forward.y /= forwardLength;
2736 } else {
2737 forward = {1.0f, 0.0f};
2738 }
2739 const WorldPosition side{-forward.y, forward.x};
2740 const float offset = std::max(4.0f, supplier.supply()->range * 1.5f);
2741 const std::array<WorldPosition, 6> candidates{{
2742 predicted,
2743 {predicted.x + side.x * offset, predicted.y + side.y * offset},
2744 {predicted.x - side.x * offset, predicted.y - side.y * offset},
2745 {predicted.x - forward.x * offset, predicted.y - forward.y * offset},
2746 {predicted.x - forward.x * offset * 0.5f + side.x * offset,
2747 predicted.y - forward.y * offset * 0.5f + side.y * offset},
2748 {predicted.x - forward.x * offset * 0.5f - side.x * offset,
2749 predicted.y - forward.y * offset * 0.5f - side.y * offset}}};
2750 const auto worldToCell = [&](float value, float origin) {
2751 return static_cast<int>(std::lround((value - origin) / grid.cellSize));
2752 };
2753 struct Candidate { WorldPosition target; float threat; float deviation; std::size_t index; };
2754 std::optional<Candidate> best;
2755 std::optional<Candidate> baseline;
2756 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < candidates.size(); ++index) {
2757 const auto candidate = candidates[index];
2758 const int x = worldToCell(candidate.x, grid.originX);
2759 const int y = worldToCell(candidate.y, grid.originY);
2760 if (!pathfinder.isWalkable(x, y)) continue;
2761 std::unique_ptr<map::Path> path(pathfinder.findPath(
2762 worldToCell(supplier.motion()->x, grid.originX),
2763 worldToCell(supplier.motion()->y, grid.originY), x, y));
2764 if (path == nullptr || path->empty()) continue;
2765 Candidate evaluated{candidate, visibleHostileThreatAt(*faction, candidate),
2766 distanceSquared(candidate.x, candidate.y, predicted.x, predicted.y), index};
2767 if (index == 0) baseline = evaluated;
2768 if (!best || evaluated.threat < best->threat - 1e-4f ||
2769 (std::abs(evaluated.threat - best->threat) <= 1e-4f &&
2770 (evaluated.deviation < best->deviation - 1e-4f ||
2771 (std::abs(evaluated.deviation - best->deviation) <= 1e-4f && evaluated.index < best->index))))
2772 best = evaluated;
2773 }
2774 if (!best)
2775 return failure<SupplyRendezvousSelection>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2776 "RTS supply rendezvous has no reachable candidate",
2777 "supply.rendezvous");
2778 SupplyRendezvousSelection result{best->target, best->threat, false};
2779 if (baseline) result.avoidedThreat = best->threat < baseline->threat - 1e-4f;
2780 return Result<SupplyRendezvousSelection>::success(result, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2781}
2782
2783Result<std::size_t> SupplySystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const AmmoProductionPurchase& purchase,
2784 map::Pathfinder* pathfinder, const NavigationGrid& grid,
2785 const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
2786 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
2787 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS supply step delta must be non-negative",
2788 "step.delta");
2789 std::size_t processed = 0;
2790 auto producers = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Construction, Building::Integrity,
2791 Building::Infrastructure, Building::Supply>();
2792 for (auto it = producers.begin(); it != producers.end(); ++it) {
2793 auto [identity, construction, integrity, infrastructure, supply] = *it;
2794 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2795 if (building == nullptr || &*building->identity() != identity) continue;
2796 if (!std::isfinite(supply->stock) || !std::isfinite(supply->capacity) ||
2797 !std::isfinite(supply->productionRate) || !std::isfinite(supply->productionProgress) ||
2798 supply->stock < 0.0f || supply->capacity < 0.0f || supply->productionRate < 0.0f ||
2799 supply->productionProgress < 0.0f || supply->productionCostPerRound < 0)
2800 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2801 "RTS building ammunition production values must be finite and non-negative", "building.supply");
2802 const float remaining = std::max(0.0f, supply->capacity - supply->stock);
2803 if (!integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f || !infrastructure->powered ||
2804 supply->productionResource.empty() || supply->productionRate <= 0.0f || remaining < 1.0f) {
2805 if (remaining < 1.0f) supply->productionProgress = std::min(supply->productionProgress, 0.999f);
2806 continue;
2807 }
2808 supply->productionProgress +=
2809 supply->productionRate * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
2810 const double readyValue = std::min<double>(
2811 std::floor(supply->productionProgress), std::floor(remaining));
2812 if (readyValue > static_cast<double>(std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max()))
2813 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2814 "RTS ammunition production batch exceeds addressable size", "building.supply.productionProgress");
2815 const auto ready = static_cast<std::size_t>(readyValue);
2816 if (ready == 0) continue;
2817 std::size_t purchased = ready;
2818 if (supply->productionCostPerRound > 0) {
2819 if (!purchase) continue;
2820 auto paid = purchase(*building, supply->productionResource,
2821 supply->productionCostPerRound, ready);
2822 if (!paid) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(paid.status());
2823 purchased = std::move(paid).takeValue();
2824 if (purchased > ready)
2825 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvariantViolation,
2826 "RTS ammunition purchase returned more rounds than requested", "purchase");
2827 }
2828 supply->stock += static_cast<float>(purchased);
2829 supply->productionProgress -= static_cast<float>(purchased);
2830 if (purchased == 0) supply->productionProgress = std::min(supply->productionProgress, 1.0f);
2831 if (events && purchased > 0)
2832 events({LifecycleEventKind::AmmoProduced, identity->subject, {}, supply->productionResource,
2833 static_cast<double>(purchased)}, step.tick);
2834 processed += purchased;
2835 }
2836
2837 auto ammunition = [](Unit& unit) -> std::pair<int, int> {
2838 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(unit.weapon()->link.resolve());
2839 if (weaponEntity == nullptr || weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr) return {0, 0};
2840 const auto& resource = weaponEntity->state()->resource;
2841 if (resource.kind != weapon::ResourceKind::Ammo || resource.infinite) return {0, 0};
2842 int carried = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(resource.value)));
2843 int capacity = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(resource.max)));
2844 if (auto* pool = weaponEntity->state()->ammoPool) {
2845 carried += std::max(0, pool->state()->count);
2846 capacity += pool->state()->max < 0 ? std::max(0, pool->state()->count) : pool->state()->max;
2847 } else if (resource.reserve >= 0) {
2848 carried += resource.reserve;
2849 capacity += std::max(resource.reserve, weaponEntity->definition()->def->reserveSize);
2850 }
2851 return {carried, capacity};
2852 };
2853 auto transfer = [&](Unit& recipient, int rounds) -> int {
2854 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(recipient.weapon()->link.resolve());
2855 if (weaponEntity == nullptr || rounds <= 0) return 0;
2856 auto& resource = weaponEntity->state()->resource;
2857 if (resource.kind != weapon::ResourceKind::Ammo || resource.infinite) return 0;
2858 int accepted = 0;
2859 const int magazineSpace = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(resource.max - resource.value)));
2860 const int magazineRounds = std::min(rounds, magazineSpace);
2861 resource.value += static_cast<float>(magazineRounds);
2862 accepted += magazineRounds;
2863 rounds -= magazineRounds;
2864 if (magazineRounds > 0) weapon::WeaponSystem::cancelReload(*weaponEntity);
2865 if (rounds <= 0) return accepted;
2866 if (auto* pool = weaponEntity->state()->ammoPool) {
2867 const int space = pool->state()->max < 0 ? rounds : std::max(0, pool->state()->max - pool->state()->count);
2868 const int pooled = std::min(rounds, space);
2869 pool->state()->count += pooled;
2870 return accepted + pooled;
2871 }
2872 if (resource.reserve < 0) return accepted;
2873 const int reserveCapacity = std::max(resource.reserve, weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr
2874 ? resource.reserve
2875 : weaponEntity->definition()->def->reserveSize);
2876 const int reserved = std::min(rounds, std::max(0, reserveCapacity - resource.reserve));
2877 resource.reserve += reserved;
2878 return accepted + reserved;
2879 };
2880
2881 struct Recipient {
2882 Unit* unit = nullptr;
2883 int deficit = 0;
2884 float ratio = 1.0f;
2885 };
2886 std::vector<Recipient> recipients;
2887 auto recipientView = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Weapon, Unit::Faction, Unit::Containment,
2888 Unit::Durability, Unit::Supply>();
2889 for (auto it = recipientView.begin(); it != recipientView.end(); ++it) {
2890 auto [identity, weaponLink, faction, containment, durability, supply] = *it;
2891 (void)weaponLink; (void)faction; (void)supply;
2892 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
2893 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2894 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
2895 const auto [carried, capacity] = ammunition(*unit);
2896 if (capacity > carried) recipients.push_back({unit, capacity - carried, float(carried) / float(capacity)});
2897 }
2898 std::sort(recipients.begin(), recipients.end(), [](const Recipient& left, const Recipient& right) {
2899 const float leftScore = (1.0f - left.ratio) * left.unit->supply()->priority;
2900 const float rightScore = (1.0f - right.ratio) * right.unit->supply()->priority;
2901 if (leftScore != rightScore) return leftScore > rightScore;
2902 return left.unit->identity()->self.id < right.unit->identity()->self.id;
2903 });
2904
2905 std::vector<Unit*> suppliers;
2906 auto supplierView = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Faction, Unit::Supply,
2907 Unit::Containment, Unit::Durability>();
2908 for (auto it = supplierView.begin(); it != supplierView.end(); ++it) {
2909 auto [identity, motion, orders, faction, supply, containment, durability] = *it;
2910 (void)motion; (void)orders; (void)faction; (void)supply; (void)containment; (void)durability;
2911 auto* supplier = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
2912 if (supplier != nullptr) suppliers.push_back(supplier);
2913 }
2914 std::sort(suppliers.begin(), suppliers.end(), [](Unit* left, Unit* right) {
2915 return left->identity()->subject.format() < right->identity()->subject.format();
2916 });
2917 std::map<std::string, float> recipientReservations;
2918 for (Unit* supplier : suppliers) {
2919 if (!supplier->durability()->alive || supplier->containment()->container.isBound()) continue;
2920 auto* target = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(supplier->supply()->assignedTarget));
2921 if (target != nullptr && supplier->supply()->reservedStock > 0.0f)
2922 recipientReservations[target->identity()->subject.format()] += supplier->supply()->reservedStock;
2923 }
2924 for (Unit* supplier : suppliers) {
2925 auto identity = supplier->identity();
2926 auto motion = supplier->motion();
2927 auto orders = supplier->orders();
2928 auto faction = supplier->faction();
2929 auto supply = supplier->supply();
2930 auto containment = supplier->containment();
2931 auto durability = supplier->durability();
2932 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() || supply->range <= 0.0f ||
2933 supply->transferRate <= 0.0f)
2934 continue;
2935 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
2936 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
2937 auto order = std::move(current).takeValue();
2938 if ((!order || (order->kind != OrderKind::Resupply && order->kind != OrderKind::SupplyRelay)) &&
2939 supply->assignedTarget.table != nullptr) {
2940 if (auto* previous = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(supply->assignedTarget))) {
2941 float& reserved = recipientReservations[previous->identity()->subject.format()];
2942 reserved = std::max(0.0f, reserved - supply->reservedStock);
2943 }
2944 supply->assignedTarget = {};
2945 supply->reservedStock = 0.0f;
2946 supply->transferProgress = 0.0f;
2947 supply->returning = false;
2948 supply->rendezvousActive = false;
2949 supply->rendezvousThreat = 0.0f;
2950 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = false;
2951 }
2952 if (!order && supply->returning) {
2953 if (distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, supply->returnPoint.x, supply->returnPoint.y) <= 0.01f) {
2954 supply->returning = false;
2955 if (events)
2956 events({LifecycleEventKind::SupplyReturned, identity->subject, {}, {}, 0.0}, step.tick);
2957 }
2958 continue;
2959 }
2960 if (!order && supply->autoDispatch && supply->stock >= 1.0f) {
2961 for (const Recipient& candidate : recipients) {
2962 if (candidate.unit == supplier ||
2963 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(candidate.unit->faction()->link, faction->link))
2964 continue;
2965 const auto [liveCarried, liveCapacity] = ammunition(*candidate.unit);
2966 const float liveRatio = liveCapacity <= 0 ? 1.0f
2967 : static_cast<float>(liveCarried) / liveCapacity;
2968 if (liveRatio > supply->autoThreshold) continue;
2969 const std::string recipientKey = candidate.unit->identity()->subject.format();
2970 const float remainingDeficit = std::max(
2971 0.0f, static_cast<float>(std::max(0, liveCapacity - liveCarried)) -
2972 recipientReservations[recipientKey]);
2973 if (remainingDeficit < 1.0f) continue;
2974 CommandSpec command;
2975 command.kind = OrderKind::Resupply;
2976 command.target = {candidate.unit->motion()->x, candidate.unit->motion()->y};
2977 command.targetEntity = candidate.unit->identity()->self;
2978 auto queued = orders->values.enqueue(command);
2979 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
2980 std::move(queued).takeValue();
2981 supply->assignedTarget = candidate.unit->identity()->self;
2982 supply->returnPoint = {motion->x, motion->y};
2983 supply->reservedStock = std::min<float>(remainingDeficit, std::floor(supply->stock));
2984 recipientReservations[recipientKey] += supply->reservedStock;
2985 supply->returning = false;
2986 auto assigned = readCurrent(orders->values);
2987 if (!assigned) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(assigned.status());
2988 order = std::move(assigned).takeValue();
2989 if (events)
2990 events({LifecycleEventKind::SupplyDispatched, identity->subject,
2991 candidate.unit->identity()->subject, {}, supply->reservedStock}, step.tick);
2992 ++processed;
2993 break;
2994 }
2995 }
2996 if (!order && supply->autoDispatch && supply->stock >= 1.0f) {
2997 Unit* relayTarget = nullptr;
2998 float relayRatio = 1.0f;
2999 float relayDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
3000 for (Unit* candidate : suppliers) {
3001 if (candidate == supplier || !candidate->durability()->alive ||
3002 candidate->containment()->container.isBound() || !candidate->supply()->relayEnabled ||
3003 candidate->supply()->capacity <= 0.0f || candidate->supply()->capacity >= supply->capacity ||
3004 candidate->supply()->stock >= candidate->supply()->capacity ||
3005 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(candidate->faction()->link, faction->link))
3006 continue;
3007 const float ratio = candidate->supply()->stock / candidate->supply()->capacity;
3008 if (ratio > supply->autoThreshold) continue;
3009 const float distance = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y,
3010 candidate->motion()->x, candidate->motion()->y);
3011 if (relayTarget == nullptr || ratio < relayRatio ||
3012 (ratio == relayRatio && (distance < relayDistance ||
3013 (distance == relayDistance && candidate->identity()->subject.format() <
3014 relayTarget->identity()->subject.format())))) {
3015 relayTarget = candidate;
3016 relayRatio = ratio;
3017 relayDistance = distance;
3018 }
3019 }
3020 if (relayTarget != nullptr) {
3021 const std::string relayKey = relayTarget->identity()->subject.format();
3022 const float remaining = std::max(0.0f, relayTarget->supply()->capacity -
3023 relayTarget->supply()->stock - recipientReservations[relayKey]);
3024 if (remaining >= 1.0f) {
3025 CommandSpec command;
3026 command.kind = OrderKind::SupplyRelay;
3027 command.target = {relayTarget->motion()->x, relayTarget->motion()->y};
3028 command.targetEntity = relayTarget->identity()->self;
3029 auto queued = orders->values.enqueue(command);
3030 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
3031 std::move(queued).takeValue();
3032 supply->assignedTarget = relayTarget->identity()->self;
3033 supply->returnPoint = {motion->x, motion->y};
3034 supply->reservedStock = std::min<float>(remaining, std::floor(supply->stock));
3035 recipientReservations[relayKey] += supply->reservedStock;
3036 supply->returning = false;
3037 auto assigned = readCurrent(orders->values);
3038 if (!assigned) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(assigned.status());
3039 order = std::move(assigned).takeValue();
3040 if (events)
3041 events({LifecycleEventKind::SupplyRelayDispatched, identity->subject,
3042 relayTarget->identity()->subject, {}, supply->reservedStock}, step.tick);
3043 ++processed;
3044 }
3045 }
3046 }
3047 if (!order || (order->kind != OrderKind::Resupply && order->kind != OrderKind::SupplyRelay)) continue;
3048 auto* target = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(order->targetEntity));
3049 if (target == nullptr || !target->durability()->alive || target->containment()->container.isBound() ||
3050 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(target->faction()->link, faction->link)) {
3051 auto failed = orders->values.fail(order->id, "supply target is invalid or hostile");
3052 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
3053 if (target != nullptr) {
3054 float& reserved = recipientReservations[target->identity()->subject.format()];
3055 reserved = std::max(0.0f, reserved - supply->reservedStock);
3056 }
3057 supply->assignedTarget = {};
3058 supply->reservedStock = 0.0f;
3059 supply->rendezvousActive = false;
3060 supply->rendezvousThreat = 0.0f;
3061 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = false;
3062 continue;
3063 }
3064 if (supply->assignedTarget.table == nullptr) {
3065 supply->assignedTarget = target->identity()->self;
3066 supply->returnPoint = {motion->x, motion->y};
3067 const auto [carried, capacity] = ammunition(*target);
3068 const float requested = order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay
3069 ? std::max(0.0f, target->supply()->capacity - target->supply()->stock)
3070 : static_cast<float>(std::max(0, capacity - carried));
3071 supply->reservedStock = std::min(requested, std::floor(supply->stock));
3072 supply->returning = false;
3073 }
3074 if (order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay &&
3075 (!target->supply()->relayEnabled || target->supply()->capacity >= supply->capacity)) {
3076 auto failed = orders->values.fail(order->id, "supply relay requires a smaller-capacity relay target");
3077 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
3078 supply->assignedTarget = {};
3079 supply->reservedStock = 0.0f;
3080 supply->rendezvousActive = false;
3081 supply->rendezvousThreat = 0.0f;
3082 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = false;
3083 continue;
3084 }
3085 if (order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay) {
3086 WorldPosition rendezvous{target->motion()->x, target->motion()->y};
3087 auto targetOrder = readCurrent(target->orders()->values);
3088 if (!targetOrder) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(targetOrder.status());
3089 const auto moving = std::move(targetOrder).takeValue();
3090 if (moving && movementOrder(moving->kind)) {
3091 WorldPosition goal = moving->target;
3092 if (target->navigation()->plannedOrderId == moving->id &&
3093 !target->navigation()->unreachable)
3094 goal = target->navigation()->plannedGoal;
3095 const float dx = goal.x - target->motion()->x;
3096 const float dy = goal.y - target->motion()->y;
3097 const float remaining = std::hypot(dx, dy);
3098 if (remaining > 1e-5f && target->motion()->speed > 0.0f) {
3099 const float travel = std::hypot(target->motion()->x - motion->x,
3100 target->motion()->y - motion->y) /
3101 std::max(0.1f, motion->speed);
3102 const float lead = std::min(remaining,
3103 target->motion()->speed * std::clamp(travel, 0.0f, 4.0f));
3104 rendezvous.x += dx / remaining * lead;
3105 rendezvous.y += dy / remaining * lead;
3106 }
3107 }
3108 supply->rendezvousPoint = rendezvous;
3109 supply->rendezvousActive = true;
3110 supply->rendezvousThreat = 0.0f;
3111 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = false;
3112 if (pathfinder != nullptr) {
3113 auto safe = SupplyRendezvousSystem::select(*supplier, *target, rendezvous, *pathfinder, grid);
3114 if (safe) {
3115 const auto selection = std::move(safe).takeValue();
3116 supply->rendezvousPoint = selection.target;
3117 supply->rendezvousThreat = selection.threat;
3118 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = selection.avoidedThreat;
3119 } else if (safe.code() != StatusCode::NotFound) {
3120 return failureFrom<std::size_t>(safe.status());
3121 } else {
3122 safe.ignore("supply relay falls back when no safe map candidate is reachable");
3123 }
3124 }
3125 } else {
3126 supply->rendezvousActive = false;
3127 supply->rendezvousThreat = 0.0f;
3128 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = false;
3129 }
3130 const float distance = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, target->motion()->x, target->motion()->y);
3131 if (distance > supply->range * supply->range) continue;
3132 supply->transferProgress += supply->transferRate * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
3133 int ready = std::min({static_cast<int>(std::floor(supply->transferProgress)),
3134 static_cast<int>(std::floor(supply->stock)),
3135 static_cast<int>(std::floor(supply->reservedStock))});
3136 int accepted = 0;
3137 if (order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay && target->supply()->relayEnabled) {
3138 ready = std::min(ready, static_cast<int>(std::floor(
3139 std::max(0.0f, target->supply()->capacity - target->supply()->stock))));
3140 target->supply()->stock += static_cast<float>(ready);
3141 accepted = ready;
3142 } else {
3143 accepted = transfer(*target, ready);
3144 }
3145 supply->stock -= static_cast<float>(accepted);
3146 supply->reservedStock -= static_cast<float>(accepted);
3147 supply->transferProgress -= static_cast<float>(accepted);
3148 if (accepted > 0) {
3149 float& reserved = recipientReservations[target->identity()->subject.format()];
3150 reserved = std::max(0.0f, reserved - static_cast<float>(accepted));
3151 if (events)
3152 events({order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay
3153 ? LifecycleEventKind::SupplyRelayTransferred
3154 : LifecycleEventKind::AmmoResupplied,
3155 identity->subject, target->identity()->subject, {}, static_cast<double>(accepted)},
3156 step.tick);
3157 }
3158 if (accepted > 0) ++processed;
3159 const auto [carried, capacity] = ammunition(*target);
3160 if ((order->kind == OrderKind::Resupply && carried >= capacity) ||
3161 (order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay && target->supply()->stock >= target->supply()->capacity) ||
3162 supply->stock < 1.0f) {
3163 auto completed = orders->values.complete(order->id);
3164 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
3165 float& reserved = recipientReservations[target->identity()->subject.format()];
3166 reserved = std::max(0.0f, reserved - supply->reservedStock);
3167 supply->assignedTarget = {};
3168 supply->reservedStock = 0.0f;
3169 supply->rendezvousActive = false;
3170 supply->rendezvousThreat = 0.0f;
3171 supply->rendezvousAvoidedThreat = false;
3172 supply->returning = true;
3173 if (events)
3174 events({LifecycleEventKind::SupplyReturning, identity->subject,
3175 target->identity()->subject, {}, 0.0}, step.tick);
3176 CommandSpec returnCommand;
3177 returnCommand.kind = OrderKind::Move;
3178 returnCommand.target = supply->returnPoint;
3179 auto queued = orders->values.enqueue(returnCommand);
3180 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
3181 std::move(queued).takeValue();
3182 }
3183 }
3184
3185 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction, Building::Construction,
3186 Building::Integrity, Building::Supply>();
3187 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
3188 auto [identity, placement, faction, construction, integrity, supply] = *it;
3189 if (!integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f || supply->stock < 1.0f || supply->range <= 0.0f ||
3190 supply->transferRate <= 0.0f) continue;
3191 for (Recipient& candidate : recipients) {
3192 if (!FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(candidate.unit->faction()->link, faction->link) ||
3193 candidate.deficit <= 0 ||
3194 distanceSquared(placement->worldX, placement->worldY, candidate.unit->motion()->x,
3195 candidate.unit->motion()->y) > supply->range * supply->range)
3196 continue;
3197 supply->transferProgress += supply->transferRate * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
3198 const int ready = std::min({static_cast<int>(std::floor(supply->transferProgress)),
3199 static_cast<int>(std::floor(supply->stock)), candidate.deficit});
3200 const int accepted = transfer(*candidate.unit, ready);
3201 supply->stock -= static_cast<float>(accepted);
3202 supply->transferProgress -= static_cast<float>(accepted);
3203 candidate.deficit -= accepted;
3204 if (accepted > 0) {
3205 if (events)
3206 events({LifecycleEventKind::AmmoResupplied, identity->subject,
3207 candidate.unit->identity()->subject, {}, static_cast<double>(accepted)}, step.tick);
3208 ++processed;
3209 }
3210 break;
3211 }
3212 }
3213 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
3214 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3215}
3216
3217Result<std::size_t> SupplyConvoySystem::step() {
3218 struct Member {
3219 Unit* unit = nullptr;
3220 WorldPosition destination;
3221 };
3222 std::map<std::string, std::vector<Member>> groups;
3223 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Faction, Unit::Supply,
3224 Unit::Containment, Unit::Durability>();
3225 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
3226 auto [identity, motion, orders, faction, supply, containment, durability] = *it;
3227 supply->convoyLeader = {};
3228 supply->convoyIndex = 0;
3229 supply->convoyWaiting = false;
3230 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() || supply->returning) continue;
3231 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
3232 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
3233 const auto order = std::move(current).takeValue();
3234 if (!order || (order->kind != OrderKind::Resupply && order->kind != OrderKind::SupplyRelay)) continue;
3235 auto* target = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(order->targetEntity));
3236 if (target == nullptr) continue;
3237 WorldPosition destination{target->motion()->x, target->motion()->y};
3238 if (order->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay && supply->rendezvousActive)
3239 destination = supply->rendezvousPoint;
3240 const std::string key = factionKey(faction->link) + "\n" +
3241 std::to_string(static_cast<int>(order->kind)) + "\n" +
3242 target->identity()->subject.format();
3243 groups[key].push_back({dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self)), destination});
3244 (void)motion;
3245 }
3246 std::size_t processed = 0;
3247 for (auto& [key, members] : groups) {
3248 (void)key;
3249 members.erase(std::remove_if(members.begin(), members.end(),
3250 [](const Member& member) { return member.unit == nullptr; }), members.end());
3251 if (members.empty()) continue;
3252 std::sort(members.begin(), members.end(), [](const Member& left, const Member& right) {
3253 const float leftDistance = distanceSquared(left.unit->motion()->x, left.unit->motion()->y,
3254 left.destination.x, left.destination.y);
3255 const float rightDistance = distanceSquared(right.unit->motion()->x, right.unit->motion()->y,
3256 right.destination.x, right.destination.y);
3257 if (leftDistance != rightDistance) return leftDistance < rightDistance;
3258 return left.unit->identity()->subject.format() < right.unit->identity()->subject.format();
3259 });
3260 Unit* leader = members.front().unit;
3261 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < members.size(); ++index) {
3262 auto supply = members[index].unit->supply();
3263 supply->convoyLeader = leader->identity()->self;
3264 supply->convoyIndex = index;
3265 ++processed;
3266 }
3267 if (members.size() < 2) continue;
3268 for (std::size_t index = 1; index < members.size(); ++index) {
3269 Unit* follower = members[index].unit;
3270 const float spacing = leader->crowd()->radius + follower->crowd()->radius + 1.0f;
3271 const float allowed = spacing * 2.5f * static_cast<float>(index);
3272 if (distanceSquared(leader->motion()->x, leader->motion()->y,
3273 follower->motion()->x, follower->motion()->y) > allowed * allowed) {
3274 leader->supply()->convoyWaiting = true;
3275 break;
3276 }
3277 }
3278 }
3279 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
3280 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3281}
3282
3283Result<std::size_t> MoraleSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
3284 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
3285 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS morale step delta must be non-negative",
3286 "step.delta");
3287 std::size_t processed = 0;
3288 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Morale, Unit::Containment,
3289 Unit::Durability>();
3290 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3291 auto [identity, motion, faction, morale, containment, durability] = *it;
3292 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() || morale->capacity <= 0.0f) continue;
3293 if (!std::isfinite(morale->suppression) || !std::isfinite(morale->capacity) || morale->capacity < 0.0f ||
3294 !std::isfinite(morale->recoveryRate) || morale->recoveryRate < 0.0f)
3295 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS morale values must be finite",
3296 "unit.morale");
3297 float recoveryBonus = 0.0f;
3298 auto sources = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Morale, Unit::Containment,
3299 Unit::Durability>();
3300 for (auto sourceIt = sources.begin(); sourceIt != sources.end(); ++sourceIt) {
3301 auto [sourceMotion, sourceFaction, aura, sourceContainment, sourceDurability] = *sourceIt;
3302 if (!sourceDurability->alive || sourceContainment->container.isBound() || aura->auraRange <= 0.0f ||
3303 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(sourceFaction->link, faction->link))
3304 continue;
3305 if (distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, sourceMotion->x, sourceMotion->y) <=
3306 aura->auraRange * aura->auraRange)
3307 recoveryBonus = std::max(recoveryBonus, aura->auraRecoveryBonus);
3308 }
3309 const float before = morale->suppression;
3310 morale->suppression = std::max(0.0f, morale->suppression -
3311 (morale->recoveryRate + recoveryBonus) * static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()));
3312 if (morale->active && morale->suppression < morale->capacity * 0.5f) {
3313 morale->active = false;
