3314 morale->retreating = false;
3315 if (events)
3316 events({LifecycleEventKind::SuppressionRecovered, identity->subject, {}, {},
3317 morale->suppression}, step.tick);
3318 }
3319 if (morale->suppression != before) ++processed;
3320 (void)identity;
3321 }
3322 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
3323 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3324}
3325
3326Result<std::size_t> ShieldSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
3327 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
3328 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS shield step delta must be non-negative",
3329 "step.delta");
3330 const float dt = static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
3331 std::size_t processed = 0;
3332 auto advance = [&](auto* shield, bool alive, SubjectRef subject) -> Result<void> {
3333 if (!std::isfinite(shield->value) || !std::isfinite(shield->capacity) ||
3334 !std::isfinite(shield->regenRate) || !std::isfinite(shield->regenDelay) ||
3335 !std::isfinite(shield->cooldown) || shield->capacity < 0.0f || shield->value < 0.0f ||
3336 shield->value > shield->capacity || shield->regenRate < 0.0f || shield->regenDelay < 0.0f ||
3337 shield->cooldown < 0.0f)
3338 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3339 "RTS shield values must be finite and within configured ranges", "shield");
3340 if (!alive || shield->capacity == 0.0f) return Result<void>::success();
3341 const float beforeValue = shield->value;
3342 const float beforeCooldown = shield->cooldown;
3343 shield->cooldown = std::max(0.0f, shield->cooldown - dt);
3344 if (shield->cooldown == 0.0f && shield->value < shield->capacity)
3345 shield->value = std::min(shield->capacity, shield->value + shield->regenRate * dt);
3346 if (beforeValue < shield->capacity && shield->value >= shield->capacity && events)
3347 events({LifecycleEventKind::ShieldRecharged, subject, {}, {}, shield->value}, step.tick);
3348 if (shield->value != beforeValue || shield->cooldown != beforeCooldown) ++processed;
3349 return Result<void>::success();
3350 };
3351 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Shield, Unit::Durability>();
3352 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3353 auto [identity, shield, durability] = *it;
3354 auto result = advance(shield, durability->alive && durability->state.health > 0.0,
3355 identity->subject);
3356 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
3357 }
3358 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Shield, Building::Integrity>();
3359 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
3360 auto [identity, shield, integrity] = *it;
3361 auto result = advance(shield, integrity->alive && integrity->state.health > 0.0,
3362 identity->subject);
3363 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
3364 }
3365 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
3366 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3367}
3368
3369Result<std::size_t> CommandNetworkSystem::step() {
3370 struct Jammer { ecs::Entity* faction = nullptr; WorldPosition position; float range = 0.0f; };
3371 std::vector<Jammer> jammers;
3372 auto unitJammers = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Command, Unit::Durability,
3373 Unit::Containment>();
3374 for (auto it = unitJammers.begin(); it != unitJammers.end(); ++it) {
3375 auto [motion, faction, command, durability, containment] = *it;
3376 if (durability->alive && durability->state.health > 0.0 && !containment->container.isBound() &&
3377 command->jammingRange > 0.0f)
3378 jammers.push_back({faction->link.resolve(), {motion->x, motion->y}, command->jammingRange});
3379 }
3380 auto buildingJammers = ecs::View<Building, Building::Placement, Building::Faction, Building::Command,
3381 Building::Integrity, Building::Construction, Building::Infrastructure>();
3382 for (auto it = buildingJammers.begin(); it != buildingJammers.end(); ++it) {
3383 auto [placement, faction, command, integrity, construction, infrastructure] = *it;
3384 if (integrity->alive && integrity->state.health > 0.0 && construction->progress >= 1.0f &&
3385 infrastructure->powered && command->jammingRange > 0.0f)
3386 jammers.push_back({faction->link.resolve(), {placement->worldX, placement->worldY},
3387 command->jammingRange});
3388 }
3389 auto isJammed = [&](ecs::Entity* faction, WorldPosition position) {
3390 return std::any_of(jammers.begin(), jammers.end(), [&](const Jammer& jammer) {
3391 return jammer.faction != nullptr && faction != nullptr &&
3392 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(jammer.faction),
3393 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction)) &&
3394 distanceSquared(position.x, position.y, jammer.position.x, jammer.position.y) <=
3395 jammer.range * jammer.range;
3396 });
3397 };
3398
3399 struct Source {
3400 ecs::EntityHandle handle{};
3401 ecs::Entity* faction = nullptr;
3402 WorldPosition position;
3403 float range = 0.0f;
3404 int capacity = 0;
3405 int* load = nullptr;
3406 std::string stableId;
3407 };
3408 std::vector<Source> active;
3409 std::vector<Unit*> relays;
3410 std::vector<Unit*> recipients;
3411 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Command, Unit::Durability,
3412 Unit::Containment>();
3413 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3414 auto [identity, motion, faction, command, durability, containment] = *it;
3415 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
3416 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
3417 if (!std::isfinite(command->range) || command->range < 0.0f || command->capacity < 0 ||
3418 command->cost <= 0 || !std::isfinite(command->jammingRange) || command->jammingRange < 0.0f ||
3419 !std::isfinite(command->outOfCommandSpeedFactor) || command->outOfCommandSpeedFactor < 0.0f ||
3420 command->outOfCommandSpeedFactor > 1.0f || !std::isfinite(command->outOfCommandDamageFactor) ||
3421 command->outOfCommandDamageFactor < 0.0f || command->outOfCommandDamageFactor > 1.0f)
3422 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3423 "RTS unit command policy is invalid", "unit.command");
3424 command->load = 0;
3425 command->source = {};
3426 command->uplink = {};
3427 command->relayActive = false;
3428 const bool live = durability->alive && durability->state.health > 0.0 &&
3429 !containment->container.isBound();
3430 command->jammed = live && isJammed(faction->link.resolve(), {motion->x, motion->y});
3431 command->inCommand = !command->requiresCommand;
3432 if (!live || command->jammed) continue;
3433 if (command->range > 0.0f) {
3434 if (command->relayRequiresUplink) relays.push_back(unit);
3435 else {
3436 command->relayActive = true;
3437 active.push_back({identity->self, faction->link.resolve(), {motion->x, motion->y}, command->range,
3438 command->capacity, &command->load, identity->subject.format()});
3439 }
3440 }
3441 if (command->requiresCommand && !(command->range > 0.0f && command->relayRequiresUplink))
3442 recipients.push_back(unit);
3443 }
3444 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
3445 Building::Command, Building::Integrity, Building::Construction,
3446 Building::Infrastructure>();
3447 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
3448 auto [identity, placement, faction, command, integrity, construction, infrastructure] = *it;
3449 command->load = 0;
3450 command->active = false;
3451 if (!std::isfinite(command->range) || command->range < 0.0f || command->capacity < 0 ||
3452 !std::isfinite(command->jammingRange) || command->jammingRange < 0.0f)
3453 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3454 "RTS building command policy is invalid", "building.command");
3455 const bool live = integrity->alive && integrity->state.health > 0.0 && construction->progress >= 1.0f &&
3456 infrastructure->powered;
3457 command->jammed = live && isJammed(faction->link.resolve(), {placement->worldX, placement->worldY});
3458 if (!live || command->jammed || command->range <= 0.0f) continue;
3459 command->active = true;
3460 active.push_back({identity->self, faction->link.resolve(), {placement->worldX, placement->worldY},
3461 command->range, command->capacity, &command->load, identity->subject.format()});
3462 }
3463
3464 auto orderUnits = [](Unit* left, Unit* right) {
3465 if (left->command()->priority != right->command()->priority)
3466 return left->command()->priority > right->command()->priority;
3467 return left->identity()->subject.format() < right->identity()->subject.format();
3468 };
3469 std::sort(relays.begin(), relays.end(), orderUnits);
3470 std::sort(recipients.begin(), recipients.end(), orderUnits);
3471 auto cover = [&](Unit& unit, bool reserve) -> Source* {
3472 Source* best = nullptr;
3473 float bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
3474 for (auto& source : active) {
3475 if (sameHandle(source.handle, unit.identity()->self) ||
3476 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(source.faction),
3477 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit.faction()->link.resolve())) ||
3478 (source.capacity > 0 && *source.load + unit.command()->cost > source.capacity))
3479 continue;
3480 const float candidate = distanceSquared(source.position.x, source.position.y,
3481 unit.motion()->x, unit.motion()->y);
3482 if (candidate > source.range * source.range) continue;
3483 if (best == nullptr || candidate < bestDistance ||
3484 (candidate == bestDistance && source.stableId < best->stableId)) {
3485 best = &source;
3486 bestDistance = candidate;
3487 }
3488 }
3489 if (best != nullptr && reserve) *best->load += unit.command()->cost;
3490 return best;
3491 };
3492 bool changed = true;
3493 while (changed) {
3494 changed = false;
3495 for (Unit* relay : relays) {
3496 if (relay->command()->relayActive) continue;
3497 Source* uplink = cover(*relay, true);
3498 if (uplink == nullptr) continue;
3499 relay->command()->uplink = uplink->handle;
3500 relay->command()->source = uplink->handle;
3501 relay->command()->inCommand = true;
3502 relay->command()->relayActive = true;
3503 active.push_back({relay->identity()->self, relay->faction()->link.resolve(),
3504 {relay->motion()->x, relay->motion()->y}, relay->command()->range,
3505 relay->command()->capacity, &relay->command()->load,
3506 relay->identity()->subject.format()});
3507 changed = true;
3508 }
3509 }
3510 for (Unit* unit : recipients) {
3511 Source* source = cover(*unit, true);
3512 if (source == nullptr) continue;
3513 unit->command()->source = source->handle;
3514 unit->command()->inCommand = true;
3515 }
3516 return Result<std::size_t>::success(active.size() + recipients.size(), Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3517}
3518
3519namespace {
3520
3521Result<void> settleAbility(Unit& caster, const AbilitySpec& spec, ecs::EntityHandle targetHandle,
3522 WorldPosition point, combat::DamageRuntime& damage,
3523 const DamageEventSink& damageEvents, SimulationTick tick,
3524 const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
3525 auto affect = [&](ecs::Entity* entity) -> Result<void> {
3526 if (entity == nullptr) return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "ability target is stale", "target");
3527 combat::CombatState* state = nullptr;
3528 bool* alive = nullptr;
3529 FactionLink* faction = nullptr;
3530 RTSEffectComponent* effects = nullptr;
3531 float* shield = nullptr;
3532 float* shieldCooldown = nullptr;
3533 float shieldDelay = 0.0f;
3534 SubjectRef subject;
3535 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(entity)) {
3536 state = &unit->durability()->state; alive = &unit->durability()->alive;
3537 faction = &unit->faction()->link; effects = &unit->effects()->values;
3538 shield = &unit->shield()->value; shieldCooldown = &unit->shield()->cooldown;
3539 shieldDelay = unit->shield()->regenDelay; subject = unit->identity()->subject;
3540 } else if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(entity)) {
3541 state = &building->integrity()->state; alive = &building->integrity()->alive;
3542 faction = &building->faction()->link; effects = &building->effects()->values;
3543 shield = &building->shield()->value; shieldCooldown = &building->shield()->cooldown;
3544 shieldDelay = building->shield()->regenDelay; subject = building->identity()->subject;
3545 }
3546 if (state == nullptr || alive == nullptr || !*alive || !subject.isValid())
3547 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "ability target is not a live RTS combat subject",
3548 "target");
3549 const bool allied = faction != nullptr && FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*faction, caster.faction()->link);
3550 if ((spec.target == AbilityTarget::Enemy && allied) ||
3551 (spec.target == AbilityTarget::Ally && !allied) ||
3552 (spec.target == AbilityTarget::Self && entity != &caster))
3553 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "ability target relationship is invalid", "target");
3554 if (spec.damage > 0.0f) {
3555 combat::DamageRequest request;
3556 request.source = caster.identity()->subject;
3557 request.target = subject;
3558 request.damageType = spec.damageType;
3559 request.healthDamage = spec.damage * effects->multiplier("incomingDamageMultiplier");
3560 if (shield != nullptr && *shield > 0.0f) {
3561 const float absorbed = std::min(*shield, static_cast<float>(request.healthDamage));
3562 *shield -= absorbed;
3563 request.healthDamage -= absorbed;
3564 if (shieldCooldown != nullptr) *shieldCooldown = shieldDelay;
3565 }
3566 auto outcome = damage.apply(*state, request);
3567 if (!outcome) return Result<void>::failure(outcome.status());
3568 if (damageEvents) damageEvents(request, outcome.value(), tick, DamageChannel::Ability);
3569 if (outcome.value().reaction == combat::HitReaction::Death) {
3570 if (faction != nullptr && hostileTo(caster, *faction)) {
3571 auto awarded = VeterancySystem::award(caster,
3572 static_cast<float>(std::max(1.0, state->maxHealth)));
3573 if (!awarded) return Result<void>::failure(awarded.status());
3574 std::move(awarded).takeValue();
3575 }
3576 *alive = false;
3577 }
3578 }
3579 if (spec.healing > 0.0f) state->health = std::min(state->maxHealth, state->health + spec.healing);
3580 if (spec.appliesEffect && effects != nullptr) {
3581 auto applied = effects->apply(spec.effect);
3582 if (!applied) return Result<void>::failure(applied.status());
3583 std::move(applied).takeValue();
3584 if (events)
3585 events({LifecycleEventKind::StatusApplied, caster.identity()->subject, subject,
3586 spec.effect.id, spec.effect.duration}, tick);
3587 }
3588 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3589 };
3590
3591 if (spec.target == AbilityTarget::Self) return affect(&caster);
3592 if (spec.target != AbilityTarget::Point) return affect(ecs::try_get(targetHandle));
3593 const float radius = std::max(0.0f, spec.radius);
3594 std::vector<ecs::Entity*> targets;
3595 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Durability>();
3596 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3597 auto [identity, motion, durability] = *it;
3598 if (durability->alive && distanceSquared(point.x, point.y, motion->x, motion->y) <= radius * radius)
3599 targets.push_back(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
3600 }
3601 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Integrity>();
3602 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
3603 auto [identity, placement, integrity] = *it;
3604 if (integrity->alive && distanceSquared(point.x, point.y, placement->worldX, placement->worldY) <=
3605 radius * radius)
3606 targets.push_back(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
3607 }
3608 for (ecs::Entity* entity : targets) {
3609 if (entity == nullptr || entity == &caster) continue;
3610 FactionLink* faction = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(entity) ? &dynamic_cast<Unit*>(entity)->faction()->link
3611 : &dynamic_cast<Building*>(entity)->faction()->link;
3612 if (FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(*faction, caster.faction()->link)) continue;
3613 auto result = affect(entity);
3614 if (!result) return result;
3615 }
3616 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(targets.empty() ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3617}
3618
3619Result<void> validateAbility(Unit& caster, const AbilitySpec& spec, ecs::EntityHandle target,
3620 WorldPosition point) {
3621 if (spec.id.empty() || !std::isfinite(spec.range) || spec.range < 0.0f || !std::isfinite(spec.radius) ||
3622 spec.radius < 0.0f || !std::isfinite(spec.cooldown) || spec.cooldown < 0.0f ||
3623 !std::isfinite(spec.damage) || spec.damage < 0.0f || !std::isfinite(spec.healing) || spec.healing < 0.0f ||
3624 !std::isfinite(spec.castTime) || spec.castTime < 0.0f || !std::isfinite(spec.channelTickInterval) ||
3625 spec.channelTickInterval < 0.0f || spec.resourceCost < 0 ||
3626 (spec.resourceCost > 0 && spec.resourceType.empty()) ||
3627 (spec.channelTickInterval > 0.0f && spec.castTime <= 0.0f) ||
3628 !finitePosition(point))
3629 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS ability definition or target point is invalid",
3630 "ability");
3631 if (spec.casterDefinition.isValid() && caster.definition()->id != spec.casterDefinition)
3632 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "unit definition cannot cast this ability", "caster");
3633 WorldPosition destination = point;
3634 if (spec.target == AbilityTarget::Self) destination = {caster.motion()->x, caster.motion()->y};
3635 else if (spec.target != AbilityTarget::Point) {
3636 auto position = entityPosition(target);
3637 if (!position) return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "ability target is stale", "target");
3638 destination = *position;
3639 if (spec.target == AbilityTarget::Enemy &&
3640 !FactionIntelSystem::isTargetable(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(caster.faction()->link.resolve()),
3641 stableSubject(ecs::try_get(target))))
3642 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
3643 "enemy ability target is not currently visible and detected", "target");
3644 }
3645 if (distanceSquared(caster.motion()->x, caster.motion()->y, destination.x, destination.y) >
3646 spec.range * spec.range)
3647 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "ability target is outside cast range", "target");
3648 return Result<void>::success();
3649}
3650
3651} // namespace
3652
3653Result<void> AbilitySystem::cast(Unit& caster, const AbilitySpec& spec, ecs::EntityHandle target,
3654 WorldPosition point, combat::DamageRuntime& damage,
3655 const AbilityResourceDebit& debit,
3656 const DamageEventSink& damageEvents, SimulationTick tick,
3657 const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
3658 auto valid = validateAbility(caster, spec, target, point);
3659 if (!valid) return valid;
3660 if (caster.abilities()->channel)
3661 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "unit is already casting an ability", "ability.channel");
3662 auto found = std::find_if(caster.abilities()->cooldowns.begin(), caster.abilities()->cooldowns.end(),
3663 [&](const auto& cooldown) { return cooldown.id == spec.id; });
3664 if (found != caster.abilities()->cooldowns.end() && found->remaining > 0.0f)
3665 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "ability is on cooldown", "ability.cooldown");
3666 if (spec.resourceCost > 0) {
3667 if (!debit) return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Unsupported, "ability resource debit provider is absent");
3668 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(spec.resourceType, spec.resourceCost);
3669 if (!cost) return Result<void>::failure(cost.status());
3670 auto paid = debit(caster, cost.value());
3671 if (!paid) return Result<void>::failure(paid.status());
3672 }
3673 if (found == caster.abilities()->cooldowns.end())
3674 caster.abilities()->cooldowns.push_back({spec.id, spec.cooldown});
3675 else found->remaining = spec.cooldown;
3676 if (spec.castTime == 0.0f) {
3677 auto settled = settleAbility(caster, spec, target, point, damage, damageEvents, tick, events);
3678 if (settled && events)
3679 events({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityCast, caster.identity()->subject,
3680 stableSubject(ecs::try_get(target)), spec.id, 1.0}, tick);
3681 return settled;
3682 }
3683 caster.abilities()->channel = Unit::Abilities::Channel{spec, target, point,
3684 caster.durability()->state.health, spec.castTime,
3685 spec.channelTickInterval > 0.0f ? spec.channelTickInterval : spec.castTime};
3686 if (events)
3687 events({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelStarted, caster.identity()->subject,
3688 stableSubject(ecs::try_get(target)), spec.id, spec.castTime}, tick);
3689 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3690}
3691
3692Result<std::size_t> AbilitySystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, combat::DamageRuntime& damage,
3693 const DamageEventSink& damageEvents,
3694 const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
3695 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
3696 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS ability delta must be non-negative",
3697 "step.delta");
3698 const float dt = static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
3699 std::size_t processed = 0;
3700 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Abilities, Unit::Durability>();
3701 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3702 auto [identity, abilities, durability] = *it;
3703 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
3704 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
3705 for (auto& cooldown : abilities->cooldowns) cooldown.remaining = std::max(0.0f, cooldown.remaining - dt);
3706 if (!abilities->channel) continue;
3707 auto& channel = *abilities->channel;
3708 if (!durability->alive ||
3709 (channel.spec.interruptOnDamage && durability->state.health < channel.startingHealth)) {
3710 if (events)
3711 events({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityInterrupted, identity->subject,
3712 stableSubject(ecs::try_get(channel.target)), channel.spec.id,
3713 channel.remaining}, step.tick);
3714 abilities->channel.reset();
3715 ++processed;
3716 continue;
3717 }
3718 const float elapsed = std::min(dt, channel.remaining);
3719 channel.remaining = std::max(0.0f, channel.remaining - dt);
3720 channel.tickRemaining -= elapsed;
3721 if (channel.spec.channelTickInterval > 0.0f) {
3722 while (channel.tickRemaining <= 1e-6f) {
3723 auto settled = settleAbility(*unit, channel.spec, channel.target, channel.point,
3724 damage, damageEvents, step.tick, events);
3725 if (!settled) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(settled.status());
3726 if (events)
3727 events({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelTick, identity->subject,
3728 stableSubject(ecs::try_get(channel.target)), channel.spec.id,
3729 channel.remaining}, step.tick);
3730 channel.tickRemaining += channel.spec.channelTickInterval;
3731 ++processed;
3732 }
3733 }
3734 if (channel.remaining == 0.0f) {
3735 const AbilitySpec completedSpec = channel.spec;
3736 const SubjectRef completedTarget = stableSubject(ecs::try_get(channel.target));
3737 if (channel.spec.channelTickInterval == 0.0f) {
3738 auto settled = settleAbility(*unit, channel.spec, channel.target, channel.point,
3739 damage, damageEvents, step.tick, events);
3740 if (!settled) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(settled.status());
3741 if (events)
3742 events({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityCast, identity->subject, completedTarget,
3743 completedSpec.id, 1.0}, step.tick);
3744 }
3745 abilities->channel.reset();
3746 if (events)
3747 events({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelCompleted, identity->subject,
3748 completedTarget, completedSpec.id, 0.0}, step.tick);
3749 ++processed;
3750 }
3751 }
3752 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
3753 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3754}
3755
3756Result<std::size_t> ArtillerySystem::step(const SimulationStep& step) {
3757 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
3758 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS artillery step delta must be non-negative",
3759 "step.delta");
3760 std::size_t processed = 0;
3761 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Motion, Unit::Artillery, Unit::Containment, Unit::Durability,
3762 Unit::Orders>();
3763 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3764 auto [motion, artillery, containment, durability, orders] = *it;
3765 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
3766 if (!std::isfinite(artillery->deployTime) || artillery->deployTime < 0.0f ||
3767 !std::isfinite(artillery->deployRemaining) || artillery->deployRemaining < 0.0f)
3768 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3769 "RTS artillery deployment values must be finite and non-negative",
3770 "unit.artillery");
3771 if (!artillery->positionInitialized) {
3772 artillery->previousX = motion->x;
3773 artillery->previousY = motion->y;
3774 artillery->positionInitialized = true;
3775 artillery->deployRemaining = artillery->deployTime;
3776 ++processed;
3777 continue;
3778 }
3779 const bool moved = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, artillery->previousX, artillery->previousY) > 1e-8f;
3780 artillery->previousX = motion->x;
3781 artillery->previousY = motion->y;
3782 if (artillery->relocating) {
3783 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
3784 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
3785 const auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
3786 if (!record || record->kind != OrderKind::Move) artillery->relocating = false;
3787 }
3788 if (moved) {
3789 artillery->deployRemaining = artillery->deployTime;
3790 ++processed;
3791 } else if (artillery->deployRemaining > 0.0f) {
3792 artillery->deployRemaining = std::max(0.0f, artillery->deployRemaining -
3793 static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()));
3794 ++processed;
3795 }
3796 }
3797 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
3798 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3799}
3800
3801Result<ArtilleryRelocationSelection> ArtilleryRelocationSystem::select(
3802 Unit& unit, WorldPosition target, float distance, float weaponRange,
3803 map::Pathfinder& pathfinder, const NavigationGrid& grid) {
3804 if (!finitePosition(target) || !std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.0f ||
3805 !std::isfinite(weaponRange) || weaponRange < 0.0f || !std::isfinite(grid.cellSize) ||
3806 grid.cellSize <= 0.0f || !std::isfinite(grid.originX) || !std::isfinite(grid.originY))
3807 return failure<ArtilleryRelocationSelection>(
3808 DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3809 "RTS artillery relocation requires finite target, range and navigation grid values",
3810 "artillery.relocation");
3811
3812 auto* ownFaction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit.faction()->link.resolve());
3813 if (ownFaction == nullptr)
3814 return failure<ArtilleryRelocationSelection>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
3815 "RTS artillery faction link is stale",
3816 "unit.faction");
3817 const auto visibleToFaction = [&](SubjectRef subject) {
3818 if (ownFaction->intel()->contacts.empty()) return true;
3819 const auto found = std::find_if(ownFaction->intel()->contacts.begin(), ownFaction->intel()->contacts.end(),
3820 [&](const auto& contact) { return contact.subject == subject; });
3821 return found != ownFaction->intel()->contacts.end() && found->visible && found->detected;
3822 };
3823 const auto hostileThreat = [&](WorldPosition candidate) {
3824 float threat = 0.0f;
3825 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Weapon,
3826 Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
3827 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
3828 auto [identity, motion, faction, weaponLink, durability, containment] = *it;
3829 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() ||
3830 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve()), ownFaction) ||
3831 !visibleToFaction(identity->subject))
3832 continue;
3833 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
3834 const auto* definition = weaponEntity == nullptr ? nullptr : weaponEntity->definition()->def;
3835 if (definition == nullptr || definition->range <= 0.0f) continue;
3836 const float d2 = distanceSquared(candidate.x, candidate.y, motion->x, motion->y);
3837 if (d2 <= definition->range * definition->range)
3838 threat += std::max(0.0f, definition->damage);
3839 }
3840 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
3841 Building::Weapon, Building::Integrity, Building::Construction>();
3842 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
3843 auto [identity, placement, faction, weaponLink, integrity, construction] = *it;
3844 if (!integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f ||
3845 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve()), ownFaction) ||
3846 !visibleToFaction(identity->subject))
3847 continue;
3848 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
3849 const auto* definition = weaponEntity == nullptr ? nullptr : weaponEntity->definition()->def;
3850 if (definition == nullptr || definition->range <= 0.0f) continue;
3851 const float d2 = distanceSquared(candidate.x, candidate.y,
3852 placement->worldX, placement->worldY);
3853 if (d2 <= definition->range * definition->range)
3854 threat += std::max(0.0f, definition->damage);
3855 }
3856 return threat;
3857 };
3858 const float separation = std::max(unit.crowd()->radius * 2.0f, distance * 0.75f);
3859 const auto conflictCount = [&](WorldPosition candidate) {
3860 int conflicts = 0;
3861 auto allies = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Weapon,
3862 Unit::Artillery, Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
3863 for (auto it = allies.begin(); it != allies.end(); ++it) {
3864 auto [identity, motion, faction, weaponLink, artillery, durability, containment] = *it;
3865 if (sameHandle(identity->self, unit.identity()->self) || !durability->alive ||
3866 containment->container.isBound() ||
3867 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve()), ownFaction))
3868 continue;
3869 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
3870 const auto* definition = weaponEntity == nullptr ? nullptr : weaponEntity->definition()->def;
3871 if (definition == nullptr ||
3872 (definition->projectile.gravity <= 0.0f && artillery->deployTime <= 0.0f)) continue;
3873 const WorldPosition position = artillery->relocating ? artillery->relocationTarget
3874 : WorldPosition{motion->x, motion->y};
3875 if (distanceSquared(candidate.x, candidate.y, position.x, position.y) < separation * separation)
3876 ++conflicts;
3877 }
3878 return conflicts;
3879 };
3880
3881 const float dx = target.x - unit.motion()->x;
3882 const float dy = target.y - unit.motion()->y;
3883 const float length = std::hypot(dx, dy);
3884 const float forwardX = length > 1e-5f ? dx / length : 1.0f;
3885 const float forwardY = length > 1e-5f ? dy / length : 0.0f;
3886 const float sideX = -forwardY;
3887 const float sideY = forwardX;
3888 const float preferred = deterministicShotRandom(unit.identity()->subject, 0, 17) >= 0.5f ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
3889 const std::array<WorldPosition, 8> directions{{
3890 {sideX * preferred - forwardX * 0.25f, sideY * preferred - forwardY * 0.25f},
3891 {-sideX * preferred - forwardX * 0.25f, -sideY * preferred - forwardY * 0.25f},
3892 {-forwardX + sideX * 0.5f * preferred, -forwardY + sideY * 0.5f * preferred},
3893 {-forwardX - sideX * 0.5f * preferred, -forwardY - sideY * 0.5f * preferred},
3894 {sideX * preferred + forwardX * 0.35f, sideY * preferred + forwardY * 0.35f},
3895 {-sideX * preferred + forwardX * 0.35f, -sideY * preferred + forwardY * 0.35f},
3896 {-forwardX, -forwardY}, {forwardX, forwardY}}};
3897 const auto worldToCell = [&](float value, float origin) {
3898 return static_cast<int>(std::lround((value - origin) / grid.cellSize));
3899 };
3900 struct Candidate {
3901 WorldPosition target;
3902 float threat;
3903 float rangePenalty;
3904 int conflicts;
3905 bool revisit;
3906 std::size_t index;
3907 };
3908 std::optional<Candidate> best;
3909 std::optional<Candidate> legacy;
3910 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < directions.size(); ++index) {
3911 const float directionLength = std::hypot(directions[index].x, directions[index].y);
3912 const WorldPosition candidate{unit.motion()->x + directions[index].x / directionLength * distance,
3913 unit.motion()->y + directions[index].y / directionLength * distance};
3914 const int goalX = worldToCell(candidate.x, grid.originX);
3915 const int goalY = worldToCell(candidate.y, grid.originY);
3916 if (!pathfinder.isWalkable(goalX, goalY)) continue;
3917 std::unique_ptr<map::Path> path(pathfinder.findPath(worldToCell(unit.motion()->x, grid.originX),
3918 worldToCell(unit.motion()->y, grid.originY),
3919 goalX, goalY));
3920 if (path == nullptr || path->empty()) continue;
3921 Candidate evaluated{candidate, hostileThreat(candidate),
3922 std::max(0.0f, std::hypot(candidate.x - target.x, candidate.y - target.y) - weaponRange),
3923 conflictCount(candidate),
3924 unit.artillery()->hasDepartedPosition &&
3925 distanceSquared(candidate.x, candidate.y,
3926 unit.artillery()->departedPosition.x,
3927 unit.artillery()->departedPosition.y) < distance * distance * 0.5625f,
3928 index};
3929 if (index == 0) legacy = evaluated;
3930 const bool better = !best || evaluated.threat < best->threat - 1e-4f ||
3931 (std::abs(evaluated.threat - best->threat) <= 1e-4f &&
3932 (evaluated.rangePenalty < best->rangePenalty - 1e-4f ||
3933 (std::abs(evaluated.rangePenalty - best->rangePenalty) <= 1e-4f &&
3934 (evaluated.conflicts < best->conflicts ||
3935 (evaluated.conflicts == best->conflicts &&
3936 ((best->revisit && !evaluated.revisit) ||
3937 (best->revisit == evaluated.revisit && evaluated.index < best->index)))))));
3938 if (better) best = evaluated;
3939 }
3940 if (!best)
3941 return failure<ArtilleryRelocationSelection>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
3942 "RTS artillery has no reachable relocation candidate",
3943 "artillery.relocation");
3944 ArtilleryRelocationSelection selection;
3945 selection.target = best->target;
3946 selection.threat = best->threat;
3947 selection.conflicts = best->conflicts;
3948 selection.avoidedDepartedPosition = unit.artillery()->hasDepartedPosition && !best->revisit;
3949 if (legacy) {
3950 selection.avoidedThreat = best->threat < legacy->threat - 1e-4f;
3951 selection.deconflicted = best->conflicts < legacy->conflicts;
3952 }
3953 return Result<ArtilleryRelocationSelection>::success(selection,
3954 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3955}
3956
3957Result<std::size_t> FireSupportSystem::request(Unit& requester, WorldPosition center, float radius,
3958 int shotsPerResponder, std::size_t maxResponders) {
3959 if (!finitePosition(center) || !std::isfinite(radius) || radius <= 0.0f || shotsPerResponder <= 0 ||
3960 !requester.durability()->alive || requester.containment()->container.isBound() ||
3961 requester.faction()->link.resolve() == nullptr)
3962 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3963 "RTS fire support request is invalid", "fireSupport");
3964 struct Candidate { Unit* unit = nullptr; float distance = 0.0f; std::string id; };
3965 std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
3966 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Orders, Unit::Weapon,
3967 Unit::Artillery, Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment, Unit::Morale>();
3968 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
3969 auto [identity, motion, faction, orders, weaponLink, artillery, durability, containment, morale] = *it;
3970 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
3971 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
3972 if (unit == nullptr || unit == &requester || !durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() ||
3973 morale->retreating || !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(faction->link, requester.faction()->link) ||
3974 weaponEntity == nullptr || weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr)
3975 continue;
3976 const auto& definition = *weaponEntity->definition()->def;
3977 if (definition.projectile.speed <= 0.0f ||
3978 (definition.projectile.gravity <= 0.0f && artillery->deployTime <= 0.0f)) continue;
3979 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
3980 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
3981 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
3982 if (record && record->kind != OrderKind::HoldPosition && record->kind != OrderKind::AttackMove &&
3983 record->kind != OrderKind::Patrol) continue;
3984 const float distance = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, center.x, center.y);
3985 if (distance > definition.range * definition.range) continue;
3986 candidates.push_back({unit, distance, identity->subject.format()});
3987 }
3988 std::sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const Candidate& left, const Candidate& right) {
3989 return left.distance != right.distance ? left.distance < right.distance : left.id < right.id;
3990 });
3991 if (maxResponders > 0 && candidates.size() > maxResponders) candidates.resize(maxResponders);
3992 float dx = center.x - requester.motion()->x, dy = center.y - requester.motion()->y;
3993 const float length = std::hypot(dx, dy);
3994 if (length <= 1e-5f) { dx = 1.0f; dy = 0.0f; }
3995 else { dx /= length; dy /= length; }
3996 const WorldPosition lateral{-dy * radius, dx * radius};
3997 for (const Candidate& candidate : candidates) {
3998 CommandSpec command;
3999 command.kind = OrderKind::SuppressArea;
4000 command.target = {center.x - lateral.x, center.y - lateral.y};
4001 command.secondaryTarget = {center.x + lateral.x, center.y + lateral.y};
4002 command.radius = radius;
4003 auto assigned = candidate.unit->orders()->values.replace(command);
4004 if (!assigned) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(assigned.status());
4005 std::move(assigned).takeValue();
4006 candidate.unit->artillery()->suppressionShotsRemaining = shotsPerResponder;
4007 candidate.unit->artillery()->fireSupportRequester = requester.identity()->self;
4008 }
4009 return Result<std::size_t>::success(candidates.size(),
4010 Status::success(candidates.empty() ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
4011}
4012
4013Result<std::size_t> FireSupportSystem::cancel(Unit& requester) {
4014 std::size_t cancelled = 0;
4015 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Orders, Unit::Artillery>();
4016 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
4017 auto [identity, orders, artillery] = *it;
4018 if (!sameHandle(artillery->fireSupportRequester, requester.identity()->self)) continue;
4019 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
4020 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
4021 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
4022 if (record && record->kind == OrderKind::SuppressArea) {
4023 auto stopped = orders->values.cancel(record->id, "fire support cancelled");
4024 if (!stopped) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(stopped.status());
4025 ++cancelled;
4026 }
4027 artillery->fireSupportRequester = {};
4028 artillery->suppressionShotsRemaining = 0;
4029 (void)identity;
4030 }
4031 return Result<std::size_t>::success(cancelled,
4032 Status::success(cancelled == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
4033}
4034
4035Result<std::size_t> FireSupportSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step) {
4036 struct Exposure { ecs::EntityHandle handle{}; ecs::Entity* faction = nullptr; WorldPosition position; };
4037 std::vector<Exposure> exposures;
4038 auto exposedUnits = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Faction, Unit::Artillery, Unit::Durability>();
4039 for (auto it = exposedUnits.begin(); it != exposedUnits.end(); ++it) {
4040 auto [identity, faction, artillery, durability] = *it;
4041 if (durability->alive && artillery->lastFireTick.value() > 0 &&
4042 step.tick.value() >= artillery->lastFireTick.value())
4043 exposures.push_back({identity->self, faction->link.resolve(), artillery->lastFirePosition});
4044 }
4045 auto exposedBuildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Faction, Building::IndirectFire,
4046 Building::Integrity>();
4047 for (auto it = exposedBuildings.begin(); it != exposedBuildings.end(); ++it) {
4048 auto [identity, faction, indirect, integrity] = *it;
4049 if (integrity->alive && indirect->lastFireTick.value() > 0 &&
4050 step.tick.value() >= indirect->lastFireTick.value())
4051 exposures.push_back({identity->self, faction->link.resolve(), indirect->lastFirePosition});
4052 }
4053 std::size_t processed = 0;
4054 auto responders = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Orders, Unit::Weapon,
4055 Unit::Artillery, Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
4056 for (auto it = responders.begin(); it != responders.end(); ++it) {
4057 auto [identity, motion, faction, orders, weaponLink, artillery, durability, containment] = *it;
4058 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
4059 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
4060 if (artillery->fireSupportRequester.table != nullptr &&
4061 ecs::try_get(artillery->fireSupportRequester) == nullptr) {
4062 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
4063 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
4064 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
4065 if (record && record->kind == OrderKind::SuppressArea) {
4066 auto stopped = orders->values.cancel(record->id, "fire support requester lost");
4067 if (!stopped) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(stopped.status());
4068 }
4069 artillery->fireSupportRequester = {};
4070 ++processed;
4071 }
4072 if (!artillery->autoCounterBattery || artillery->counterBatteryWindowTicks == 0 ||
4073 !durability->alive || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
4074 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
4075 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
4076 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
4077 if (record && record->kind != OrderKind::HoldPosition) continue;
4078 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
4079 if (weaponEntity == nullptr || weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr) continue;
4080 const auto& definition = *weaponEntity->definition()->def;
4081 const Exposure* best = nullptr;
4082 float bestDistance = std::numeric_limits<float>::max();
4083 for (const Exposure& exposure : exposures) {
4084 if (exposure.faction == nullptr ||
4085 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(exposure.faction),
4086 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->link.resolve())))
4087 continue;
4088 auto* hostileUnit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(exposure.handle));
4089 auto* hostileBuilding = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(exposure.handle));
4090 const auto firedTick = hostileUnit != nullptr ? hostileUnit->artillery()->lastFireTick.value()
4091 : hostileBuilding != nullptr ? hostileBuilding->indirectFire()->lastFireTick.value() : 0;
4092 if (step.tick.value() - firedTick > artillery->counterBatteryWindowTicks) continue;
4093 const float distance = distanceSquared(motion->x, motion->y, exposure.position.x, exposure.position.y);
4094 if (distance > definition.range * definition.range || distance >= bestDistance) continue;
4095 best = &exposure; bestDistance = distance;
4096 }
4097 if (best == nullptr) continue;
4098 CommandSpec counter;
4099 counter.kind = OrderKind::AttackGround;
4100 counter.target = best->position;
4101 auto assigned = orders->values.replace(counter);
4102 if (!assigned) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(assigned.status());
4103 std::move(assigned).takeValue();
4104 ++processed;
4105 }
4106 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
4107 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
4108}

4110std::uint64_t RTSProjectileSystem::key(weapon::ProjectileHandle handle) noexcept {
4111 return (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(handle.generation) << 32u) | handle.slot;
4112}
4113
4114RTSProjectileSystemSnapshot RTSProjectileSystem::snapshot() const {
4115 RTSProjectileSystemSnapshot result;
4116 result.runtime = runtime_.snapshot();
4117 for (auto& slot : result.runtime.slots)
4118 if (slot.state) slot.state->target.reset();
4119 result.payloads.reserve(payloads_.size());
4120 for (const auto& [payloadKey, payload] : payloads_) {
4121 result.payloads.push_back({payloadKey, payload.source, stableSubject(ecs::try_get(payload.faction)),
4122 stableSubject(ecs::try_get(payload.target)), stableSubject(ecs::try_get(payload.observer)),
4123 payload.targetPoint, payload.targetHeight, payload.damageType, payload.damage,
4124 payload.radius, payload.splashMinimumDamageFactor, payload.targetsGround, payload.targetsAir,
4125 payload.friendlyFire, payload.blockedByObstacles, payload.requiredTargetTags,
4126 payload.excludedTargetTags});
4127 }
4128 return result;
4129}
4130
4131Result<void> RTSProjectileSystem::restore(const RTSProjectileSystemSnapshot& snapshot,
4132 const ProjectileSubjectResolver& resolver) {
4133 if (!resolver)
4134 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4135 "RTS projectile restore requires a stable subject resolver", "projectiles.resolver");
4136 weapon::ProjectileRuntime stagedRuntime;
4137 auto runtimeRestored = stagedRuntime.restore(snapshot.runtime);
4138 if (!runtimeRestored) return runtimeRestored;
4139 std::set<std::uint64_t> liveKeys;
4140 for (const auto& state : stagedRuntime.states()) liveKeys.insert(key(state.handle));
4141 if (liveKeys.size() != snapshot.payloads.size())
4142 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4143 "RTS projectile snapshot payload count does not match live trajectories",
4144 "projectiles.payloads");
4145 std::map<std::uint64_t, Payload> stagedPayloads;
4146 for (const auto& value : snapshot.payloads) {
4147 if (!liveKeys.contains(value.key) || stagedPayloads.contains(value.key) || !value.source.isValid() ||
4148 !value.faction.isValid() || !finitePosition(value.targetPoint) || !std::isfinite(value.targetHeight) ||
4149 value.damageType.empty() ||
4150 !std::isfinite(value.damage) || value.damage < 0.0 || !std::isfinite(value.radius) || value.radius < 0.0f ||
4151 !std::isfinite(value.splashMinimumDamageFactor) || value.splashMinimumDamageFactor < 0.0f ||
4152 value.splashMinimumDamageFactor > 1.0f || (!value.targetsGround && !value.targetsAir))
4153 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4154 "RTS projectile snapshot contains an invalid payload", "projectiles.payloads");
4155 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(resolver(value.faction));
4156 ecs::Entity* target = value.target.isValid() ? resolver(value.target) : nullptr;
4157 ecs::Entity* observer = value.observer.isValid() ? resolver(value.observer) : nullptr;
4158 if (faction == nullptr || (value.target.isValid() && dynamic_cast<Unit*>(target) == nullptr &&
4159 dynamic_cast<Building*>(target) == nullptr) ||
4160 (value.observer.isValid() && dynamic_cast<Unit*>(observer) == nullptr &&
4161 dynamic_cast<Building*>(observer) == nullptr))
4162 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
4163 "RTS projectile snapshot relationship cannot be resolved", "projectiles.payloads");
4164 Payload payload;
4165 payload.source = value.source;
4166 payload.faction = ecs::handle_of(faction);
4167 payload.target = target == nullptr ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : ecs::handle_of(target);
4168 payload.observer = observer == nullptr ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : ecs::handle_of(observer);
4169 payload.targetPoint = value.targetPoint;
4170 payload.targetHeight = value.targetHeight;
4171 payload.damageType = value.damageType;
4172 payload.damage = value.damage;
4173 payload.radius = value.radius;
4174 payload.splashMinimumDamageFactor = value.splashMinimumDamageFactor;
4175 payload.targetsGround = value.targetsGround;
4176 payload.targetsAir = value.targetsAir;
4177 payload.friendlyFire = value.friendlyFire;
4178 payload.blockedByObstacles = value.blockedByObstacles;
4179 payload.requiredTargetTags = value.requiredTargetTags;
4180 payload.excludedTargetTags = value.excludedTargetTags;
4181 stagedPayloads.emplace(value.key, std::move(payload));
4182 }
4183 runtime_ = std::move(stagedRuntime);
4184 payloads_ = std::move(stagedPayloads);
4185 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
4186}

4188Result<weapon::ProjectilePoint> RTSProjectileSystem::position(ecs::EntityHandle target) const {
4189 auto value = entityPosition(target);
4190 if (!value)

4195
4196Result<void> RTSProjectileSystem::launch(SubjectRef source, ecs::EntityHandle faction, WorldPosition origin,
4197 ecs::EntityHandle target, WorldPosition targetPoint,
4198 const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition, double damageFactor,
4199 ecs::EntityHandle observer, float originHeight, float targetHeight) {
4200 if (!source.isValid() || definition.projectile.speed <= 0.0f || !std::isfinite(damageFactor) ||
4201 damageFactor < 0.0)
4202 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4203 "RTS projectile requires a source and positive canonical weapon speed", "projectile");
4204 auto id = LogicalId::fromParts("projectile", definition.id.empty() ? "weapon" : definition.id);
4205 if (!id) return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "weapon id cannot identify a projectile");
4206 weapon::ProjectileDefinition projectile;
4207 projectile.id = *id;
4208 projectile.speed = definition.projectile.speed;
4209 projectile.gravity = std::max(0.0f, definition.projectile.gravity);
4210 projectile.mode = projectile.gravity > 0.0 ? weapon::ProjectileMode::Ballistic
4211 : weapon::ProjectileMode::Linear;
4212 const double flight = std::max(1.0, static_cast<double>(std::max(1.0f, definition.range)) /
4213 static_cast<double>(definition.projectile.speed) * 2.0);
4214 auto lifetime = Duration::fromSeconds(flight);
4215 if (!lifetime) return Result<void>::failure(lifetime.status());
4216 projectile.lifetime = lifetime.value();
4217 WorldPosition destination = targetPoint;
4218 if (auto live = entityPosition(target)) destination = *live;
4219 weapon::ProjectileSpawnRequest request;
4220 request.position = {origin.x, originHeight, origin.y};
4221 const double dx = destination.x - origin.x;
4222 const double dz = destination.y - origin.y;
4223 double dy = static_cast<double>(targetHeight - originHeight);
4224 if (projectile.mode == weapon::ProjectileMode::Ballistic) {
4225 const double horizontal = std::hypot(dx, dz);
4226 const double speed2 = static_cast<double>(definition.projectile.speed) *
4227 static_cast<double>(definition.projectile.speed);
4228 const double gravity = static_cast<double>(definition.projectile.gravity);
4229 const double discriminant = speed2 * speed2 - gravity *
4230 (gravity * horizontal * horizontal + 2.0 * dy * speed2);
4231 if (horizontal > 1e-6 && discriminant >= 0.0)
4232 dy = horizontal * (speed2 - std::sqrt(discriminant)) / (gravity * horizontal);
4233 }
4234 request.direction = {dx, dy, dz};
4235 auto spawned = runtime_.spawn(projectile, request);
4236 if (!spawned) return Result<void>::failure(spawned.status());
4237 Payload payload;
4238 payload.source = source;
4239 payload.faction = faction;
4240 payload.target = target;
4241 payload.observer = observer;
4242 payload.targetPoint = destination;
4243 payload.targetHeight = targetHeight;
4244 payload.damageType = definition.damageType.empty() ? "damage.physical" : definition.damageType;
4245 const float launchDistance = std::hypot(destination.x - origin.x, destination.y - origin.y);
4246 payload.damage = static_cast<double>(definition.damage) * std::max(1, definition.projectile.pelletCount) *
4247 damageFactor * weaponRangeDamageFactor(definition, launchDistance);
4248 payload.radius = std::max(0.0f, definition.projectile.aoe);
4249 payload.splashMinimumDamageFactor = definition.splashMinimumDamageFactor;
4250 payload.targetsGround = definition.targetsGround;
4251 payload.targetsAir = definition.targetsAir;
4252 payload.friendlyFire = definition.friendlyFire;
4253 payload.blockedByObstacles = definition.blockedByObstacles;
4254 payload.requiredTargetTags = definition.requiredTargetTags;
4255 payload.excludedTargetTags = definition.excludedTargetTags;
4256 payloads_[key(spawned.value())] = std::move(payload);
4257 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
4258}
4259
4260Result<std::size_t> RTSProjectileSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, combat::DamageRuntime& damage,
4261 const ProjectileCollisionQuery& collision,
4262 const DamageEventSink& damageEvents) {
4263 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
4264 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS projectile delta must be non-negative",
4265 "step.delta");
4266 auto observerSees = [](ecs::EntityHandle observerHandle, ecs::EntityHandle targetHandle) {
4267 const auto targetPosition = entityPosition(targetHandle);
4268 if (!targetPosition) return false;
4269 bool cloaked = false;
4270 if (auto* targetUnit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(targetHandle)))
4271 cloaked = targetUnit->vision()->cloaked;
4272 if (auto* observer = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(observerHandle))) {
4273 if (!observer->durability()->alive || observer->containment()->container.isBound() ||
4274 !observer->vision()->enabled) return false;
4275 const float range = cloaked ? observer->vision()->detectionRange : observer->vision()->sightRange;
4276 return range > 0.0f && distanceSquared(observer->motion()->x, observer->motion()->y,
4277 targetPosition->x, targetPosition->y) <= range * range;
4278 }
4279 if (auto* observer = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(observerHandle))) {
4280 if (!observer->integrity()->alive || observer->construction()->progress < 1.0f ||
4281 !observer->infrastructure()->powered || !observer->vision()->enabled || cloaked) return false;
4282 const float range = observer->vision()->sightRange;
4283 return range > 0.0f && distanceSquared(observer->placement()->worldX, observer->placement()->worldY,
4284 targetPosition->x, targetPosition->y) <= range * range;
4285 }
4286 return false;
4287 };
4288 for (auto& [payloadKey, payload] : payloads_) {
4289 (void)payloadKey;
4290 if (payload.observer.table == nullptr) continue;
4291 if (observerSees(payload.observer, payload.target)) {
4292 if (const auto live = entityPosition(payload.target)) payload.targetPoint = *live;
4293 } else {
4294 payload.target = {};
4295 payload.observer = {};
4296 }
4297 }
4298 std::map<std::uint64_t, weapon::ProjectileState> before;
4299 for (const auto& state : runtime_.states()) before.emplace(key(state.handle), state);
4300 auto updated = runtime_.update(step.delta, this);
4301 if (!updated) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(updated.status());
4302 for (const auto& released : updated.value().released) payloads_.erase(key(released));
4303 std::size_t impacts = 0;
4304 for (const auto& handle : updated.value().advanced) {
4305 const auto old = before.find(key(handle));
4306 const auto current = runtime_.find(handle);
4307 const auto payloadIt = payloads_.find(key(handle));
4308 if (old == before.end() || !current || payloadIt == payloads_.end()) continue;
4309 Payload& payload = payloadIt->second;
4310 WorldPosition destination = payload.targetPoint;
4311 if (auto live = entityPosition(payload.target)) destination = *live;
4312 const double ax = old->second.position.x, ay = old->second.position.z;
4313 const double bx = current->position.x, by = current->position.z;
4314 ecs::EntityHandle impactEntity = payload.target;
4315 bool collided = false;
4316 if (payload.blockedByObstacles && collision) {
4317 auto queried = collision({static_cast<float>(ax), static_cast<float>(ay)},
4318 static_cast<float>(old->second.position.y),
4319 {static_cast<float>(bx), static_cast<float>(by)},
4320 static_cast<float>(current->position.y),
4321 payload.source, payload.target);
4322 if (!queried) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queried.status());
4323 if (queried.value()) {
4324 destination = queried.value()->position;
4325 impactEntity = queried.value()->entity;
4326 collided = true;
4327 }
4328 }
4329 const double az = old->second.position.y, bz = current->position.y;
4330 const double vx = bx - ax, vy = by - ay, vz = bz - az;
4331 const double wx = destination.x - ax, wy = destination.y - ay, wz = payload.targetHeight - az;
4332 const double length2 = vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz;
4333 const double t = length2 <= 1e-12 ? 0.0 :
4334 std::clamp((wx * vx + wy * vy + wz * vz) / length2, 0.0, 1.0);
4335 const double dx = ax + vx * t - destination.x;
4336 const double dy = ay + vy * t - destination.y;
4337 const double dz = az + vz * t - payload.targetHeight;
4338 if (!collided && dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > 0.25) continue;
4339
4340 auto apply = [&](ecs::Entity* entity, double scale) -> Result<void> {
4341 combat::CombatState* state = nullptr; bool* alive = nullptr; FactionLink* faction = nullptr;
4342 RTSEffectComponent* effects = nullptr;
4343 float* shield = nullptr; float* cooldown = nullptr; float delay = 0.0f; SubjectRef subject;
4344 TagSet* tags = nullptr; bool airborne = false;
4345 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(entity)) {
4346 state = &unit->durability()->state; alive = &unit->durability()->alive;
4347 faction = &unit->faction()->link; shield = &unit->shield()->value;
4348 effects = &unit->effects()->values;
4349 cooldown = &unit->shield()->cooldown; delay = unit->shield()->regenDelay;
4350 subject = unit->identity()->subject; tags = &unit->tags()->values;
4351 airborne = unit->motion()->airborne;
4352 } else if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(entity)) {
4353 state = &building->integrity()->state; alive = &building->integrity()->alive;
4354 faction = &building->faction()->link; shield = &building->shield()->value;
4355 effects = &building->effects()->values;
4356 cooldown = &building->shield()->cooldown; delay = building->shield()->regenDelay;
4357 subject = building->identity()->subject; tags = &building->tags()->values;
4358 }
4359 if (state == nullptr || alive == nullptr || !*alive || faction == nullptr ||
4360 (!payload.friendlyFire &&
4361 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(faction->resolve()),
4362 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(payload.faction)))) ||
4363 !subject.isValid() || (airborne && !payload.targetsAir) || (!airborne && !payload.targetsGround) ||
4364 tags == nullptr ||
4365 std::any_of(payload.requiredTargetTags.begin(), payload.requiredTargetTags.end(),
4366 [&](const auto& tag) { return !tags->contains(tag); }) ||
4367 std::any_of(payload.excludedTargetTags.begin(), payload.excludedTargetTags.end(),
4368 [&](const auto& tag) { return tags->contains(tag); }))
4369 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
4370 combat::DamageRequest request;
4371 request.source = payload.source; request.target = subject; request.damageType = payload.damageType;
4372 request.healthDamage = payload.damage * scale * effects->multiplier("incomingDamageMultiplier");
4373 if (shield != nullptr && *shield > 0.0f) {
4374 const float absorbed = std::min(*shield, static_cast<float>(request.healthDamage));
4375 *shield -= absorbed; request.healthDamage -= absorbed;
4376 if (cooldown != nullptr) *cooldown = delay;
4377 }
4378 auto outcome = damage.apply(*state, request);
4379 if (!outcome) return Result<void>::failure(outcome.status());
4380 if (damageEvents) damageEvents(request, outcome.value(), step.tick, DamageChannel::Projectile);
4381 if (outcome.value().reaction == combat::HitReaction::Death) {
4382 if (Unit* source = unitBySubject(payload.source);
4383 source != nullptr && hostileTo(*source, *faction)) {
4384 auto awarded = VeterancySystem::award(*source,
4385 static_cast<float>(std::max(1.0, state->maxHealth)));
4386 if (!awarded) return Result<void>::failure(awarded.status());
4387 std::move(awarded).takeValue();
4388 }
4389 *alive = false;
4390 }
4391 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
4392 };
4393 if (payload.radius <= 0.0f) {
4394 auto result = apply(ecs::try_get(impactEntity), 1.0);
4395 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
4396 } else {
4397 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion>();
4398 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
4399 auto [identity, motion] = *it;
4400 const float distance = std::hypot(motion->x - destination.x, motion->y - destination.y);
4401 if (distance > payload.radius) continue;
4402 const double radial = 1.0 - distance / payload.radius;
4403 auto result = apply(ecs::try_get(identity->self),
4404 std::max<double>(payload.splashMinimumDamageFactor, radial));
4405 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
4406 }
4407 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement>();
4408 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
4409 auto [identity, placement] = *it;
4410 const float distance = std::hypot(placement->worldX - destination.x,
4411 placement->worldY - destination.y);
4412 if (distance > payload.radius) continue;
4413 const double radial = 1.0 - distance / payload.radius;
4414 auto result = apply(ecs::try_get(identity->self),
4415 std::max<double>(payload.splashMinimumDamageFactor, radial));
4416 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
4417 }
4418 }
4419 auto released = runtime_.release(handle);
4420 if (!released) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(released.status());
4421 payloads_.erase(key(handle));
4422 ++impacts;
4423 }
4424 return Result<std::size_t>::success(impacts,
4425 Status::success(impacts == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
4426}

4428Result<std::size_t> CombatFireSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, State& state,
4429 sensing::SensingWorld& sensing, combat::DamageRuntime& damage,
4430 RTSProjectileSystem* projectiles, const FireLineQuery& fireLine,
4431 map::Pathfinder* pathfinder, const NavigationGrid& navigationGrid,
4432 const CombatHeightQuery& heightQuery,
4433 const DamageEventSink& damageEvents,
4434 const CombatFireEventSink& fireEvents) {
4435 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
4436 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS combat step delta must be non-negative",
4437 "step.delta");
4438 const auto launchHeights = [&](WorldPosition origin, WorldPosition target,
4439 ecs::EntityHandle source, ecs::EntityHandle targetEntity) {
4440 return heightQuery ? heightQuery(origin, target, source, targetEntity) : CombatHeightProfile{};
4441 };
4442 const auto publishShot = [&](weapon::WeaponEntity& weaponEntity, SubjectRef source,
4443 SubjectRef target, WorldPosition point, bool projectile, bool missed) {
4444 if (!fireEvents) return;
4445 fireEvents({projectile ? CombatFireEventKind::ProjectileFired
4446 : CombatFireEventKind::WeaponFired,
4447 source, target, point}, step.tick);
4448 if (missed)
4449 fireEvents({CombatFireEventKind::ShotMissed, source, target, point}, step.tick);
4450 const auto& resource = weaponEntity.state()->resource;
4451 if (resource.kind == weapon::ResourceKind::Ammo && !resource.infinite && resource.value <= 0.0f)
4452 fireEvents({CombatFireEventKind::WeaponDry, source, target, point}, step.tick);
4453 };
4454 std::set<std::string> blockedThisStep;
4455 const auto publishBlocked = [&](SubjectRef source, SubjectRef target, WorldPosition point) {
4456 const std::string key = source.format();
4457 blockedThisStep.insert(key);
4458 if (fireEvents && !state.blockedSubjects.contains(key))
4459 fireEvents({CombatFireEventKind::FireBlocked, source, target, point}, step.tick);
4460 };
4461 const auto updateWeapon = [&](weapon::WeaponEntity& weaponEntity, SubjectRef source,
4462 WorldPosition position) {
4463 const auto* definition = weaponEntity.definition()->def;
4464 auto weaponState = weaponEntity.state();
4465 const auto& resource = weaponState->resource;
4466 const float dt = static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
4467 const bool hasReserve = weaponState->ammoPool != nullptr
4468 ? weaponState->ammoPool->state()->count > 0
4469 : definition->reserveSize != 0 && resource.reserve > 0;
4470 const bool startsReload = definition->kind == weapon::WeaponKind::Ranged &&
4471 !resource.reloading && resource.value <= 0.0f &&
4472 weaponState->cooldown <= dt && !weaponState->jammed && hasReserve;
4473 const bool completesReload = definition->kind == weapon::WeaponKind::Ranged &&
4474 resource.reloading &&
4475 resource.reloadProgress + dt >= definition->reloadTime;
4476 weapon::WeaponSystem::update(weaponEntity, dt);
4477 if (startsReload && fireEvents)
4478 fireEvents({CombatFireEventKind::ReloadStarted, source, {}, position}, step.tick);
4479 if (completesReload && fireEvents)
4480 fireEvents({CombatFireEventKind::ReloadCompleted, source, {}, position}, step.tick);
4481 };
4482 struct Target {
4483 ecs::EntityHandle handle{};
4484 SubjectRef subject;
4485 FactionLink* faction = nullptr;
4486 WorldPosition position{};
4487 combat::CombatState* durability = nullptr;
4488 bool* alive = nullptr;
4489 Unit::Morale* morale = nullptr;
4490 float* shield = nullptr;
4491 float* shieldCooldown = nullptr;
4492 float shieldDelay = 0.0f;
4493 RTSEffectComponent* effects = nullptr;
4494 TagSet* tags = nullptr;
4495 bool airborne = false;
4496 std::string definition;
4497 bool cloaked = false;
4498 };
4499 std::map<std::string, Target> targets;
4500 for (const auto& id : state.mirroredSubjects) {
4501 auto removed = sensing.remove(id);
4502 if (!removed && removed.code() != StatusCode::NotFound) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(removed.status());
4503 if (!removed) removed.ignore("RTS sensing mirror was already absent");
4504 }
4505 state.mirroredSubjects.clear();
4506 auto mirror = [&](std::string id, Target target, std::string_view tags) -> Result<void> {
4507 const std::string faction = target.faction == nullptr ? std::string{} : factionKey(*target.faction);
4508 auto inserted = sensing.upsert(id, target.position.x, target.position.y, faction, tags, "");
4509 if (!inserted) return Result<void>::failure(inserted.status());
4510 state.mirroredSubjects.insert(id);
4511 targets.emplace(std::move(id), target);
4512 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
4513 };
4514 {
4515 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Definition, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Durability,
4516 Unit::Containment, Unit::Morale, Unit::Shield, Unit::Effects, Unit::Tags, Unit::Vision>();
4517 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
4518 auto [identity, unitDefinition, motion, faction, durability, containment, morale, shield, effects, tags,
4519 vision] = *it;
4520 if (!identity->subject.isValid() || !durability->alive || durability->state.health <= 0.0 ||
4521 containment->container.isBound()) continue;
4522 auto result = mirror(identity->subject.format(),
4523 {identity->self, identity->subject, &faction->link, {motion->x, motion->y},
4524 &durability->state, &durability->alive, morale, &shield->value,
4525 &shield->cooldown, shield->regenDelay, &effects->values, &tags->values, motion->airborne,
4526 unitDefinition->id.format(), vision->cloaked},
4527 "combat-target,unit");
4528 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
4529 }
4530 }
4531 {
4532 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Definition, Building::Placement,
4533 Building::Faction, Building::Integrity, Building::Shield, Building::Effects,
4534 Building::Tags>();
4535 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
4536 auto [identity, buildingDefinition, placement, faction, integrity, shield, effects, tags] = *it;
4537 if (!identity->subject.isValid() || !integrity->alive || integrity->state.health <= 0.0) continue;
4538 auto result = mirror(identity->subject.format(),
4539 {identity->self, identity->subject, &faction->link,
4540 {placement->worldX, placement->worldY}, &integrity->state, &integrity->alive,
4541 nullptr, &shield->value, &shield->cooldown, shield->regenDelay,
4542 &effects->values, &tags->values, false, buildingDefinition->id.format(), false},
4543 "building,combat-target");
4544 if (!result) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(result.status());
4545 }
4546 }
4547
4548 std::size_t fired = 0;
4549 auto observedFireSpotter = [&](ecs::Entity* ownFaction, const Target& target) -> ecs::EntityHandle {
4550 ecs::EntityHandle best{};
4551 std::string bestKey;
4552 auto consider = [&](ecs::EntityHandle handle, ecs::Entity* observerFaction, WorldPosition position,
4553 float sightRange, float detectionRange, bool enabled) {
4554 const float range = target.cloaked ? detectionRange : sightRange;
4555 const SubjectRef subject = stableSubject(ecs::try_get(handle));
4556 if (!enabled ||
4557 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(observerFaction),
4558 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ownFaction)) ||
4559 range <= 0.0f || !subject.isValid() ||
4560 distanceSquared(position.x, position.y, target.position.x, target.position.y) > range * range)
4561 return;
4562 const std::string key = subject.format();
4563 if (best.table == nullptr || key < bestKey) { best = handle; bestKey = key; }
4564 };
4565 auto unitObservers = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Faction, Unit::Vision,
4566 Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
4567 for (auto it = unitObservers.begin(); it != unitObservers.end(); ++it) {
4568 auto [identity, motion, faction, vision, durability, containment] = *it;
4569 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
4570 consider(identity->self, faction->link.resolve(), {motion->x, motion->y}, vision->sightRange,
4571 vision->detectionRange, vision->enabled);
4572 }
4573 auto buildingObservers = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Placement, Building::Faction,
4574 Building::Vision, Building::Integrity, Building::Construction,
4575 Building::Infrastructure>();
4576 for (auto it = buildingObservers.begin(); it != buildingObservers.end(); ++it) {
4577 auto [identity, placement, faction, vision, integrity, construction, infrastructure] = *it;
4578 if (!integrity->alive || construction->progress < 1.0f || !infrastructure->powered) continue;
4579 consider(identity->self, faction->link.resolve(), {placement->worldX, placement->worldY},
4580 vision->sightRange, target.cloaked ? 0.0f : vision->detectionRange, vision->enabled);
4581 }
4582 return best;
4583 };
4584 auto attackers = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Motion, Unit::Orders, Unit::Faction, Unit::Weapon,
4585 Unit::Combat, Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment, Unit::Morale, Unit::Artillery,
4586 Unit::Veterancy, Unit::Command, Unit::Tactics, Unit::Vision, Unit::Effects>();
4587 for (auto it = attackers.begin(); it != attackers.end(); ++it) {
4588 auto [identity, motion, orders, faction, weaponLink, policy, durability, containment, morale, artillery,
4589 veterancy, command, tactics, vision, effects] = *it;
4590 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
4591 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
4592 if (!durability->alive || durability->state.health <= 0.0 || containment->container.isBound()) continue;
4593 if (!std::isfinite(veterancy->experience) || veterancy->experience < 0.0f ||
4594 !std::isfinite(veterancy->veteranThreshold) || !std::isfinite(veterancy->eliteThreshold) ||
4595 veterancy->veteranThreshold < 0.0f || veterancy->eliteThreshold < 0.0f ||
4596 (veterancy->veteranThreshold > 0.0f && veterancy->eliteThreshold <= veterancy->veteranThreshold) ||
4597 !std::isfinite(veterancy->veteranDamageFactor) || !std::isfinite(veterancy->eliteDamageFactor) ||
4598 !std::isfinite(veterancy->veteranHealthFactor) || !std::isfinite(veterancy->eliteHealthFactor) ||
4599 veterancy->veteranDamageFactor < 1.0f ||
4600 veterancy->eliteDamageFactor < veterancy->veteranDamageFactor ||
4601 veterancy->veteranHealthFactor < 1.0f ||
4602 veterancy->eliteHealthFactor < veterancy->veteranHealthFactor || veterancy->level < 0 ||
4603 veterancy->level > 2)
4604 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4605 "RTS veterancy thresholds and factors are inconsistent",
4606 "unit.veterancy");
4607 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(weaponLink->link.resolve());
4608 if (weaponEntity == nullptr || weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr) continue;
4609 updateWeapon(*weaponEntity, identity->subject, {motion->x, motion->y});
4610 const weapon::WeaponDefinition& definition = *weaponEntity->definition()->def;
4611 if (!std::isfinite(definition.preferredTargetBonus) || definition.preferredTargetBonus < 1.0f)
4612 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4613 "RTS weapon preferred target bonus must be finite and at least one",
4614 "weapon.preferredTargetBonus");
4615 policy->engagementRange = std::max(0.0f, definition.range);
4616 if (std::any_of(policy->targetPriorities.begin(), policy->targetPriorities.end(), [](const auto& entry) {
4617 return entry.first.empty() || !std::isfinite(entry.second) || entry.second < 0.0f;
4618 }))
4619 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4620 "RTS target priority entries require non-empty ids and finite weights",
4621 "unit.combat.targetPriorities");
4622 if (!std::isfinite(policy->turnRateDegrees) || policy->turnRateDegrees < 0.0f ||
4623 !std::isfinite(policy->aimToleranceDegrees) || policy->aimToleranceDegrees < 0.0f)
4624 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4625 "RTS turret turn rate and aim tolerance must be finite and non-negative",
4626 "unit.combat.aim");
4627
4628 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
4629 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
4630 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
4631 const bool explicitAttack = record && record->kind == OrderKind::Attack;
4632 if (explicitAttack) policy->target = record->targetEntity;
4633
4634 if (!std::isfinite(tactics->coordinatedVolleyInterval) ||
4635 tactics->coordinatedVolleyInterval < 0.0f ||
4636 !std::isfinite(tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining) || tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining < 0.0f)
4637 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
4638 "RTS coordinated volley timing must be finite and non-negative",
4639 "unit.tactics.coordinatedVolley");
4640 bool volleyReleased = true;
4641 if (!explicitAttack && tactics->combatGroup != 0 && tactics->coordinatedVolleyInterval > 0.0f) {
4642 if (tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining <= 1e-5f)
4643 tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining = tactics->coordinatedVolleyInterval;
4644 tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining = std::max(
4645 0.0f, tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining - static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds()));
4646 volleyReleased = tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining <= 1e-5f;
4647 tactics->volleyHolding = !volleyReleased;
4648 if (volleyReleased) tactics->volleyReleaseRemaining = tactics->coordinatedVolleyInterval;
4649 } else {
4650 tactics->volleyHolding = false;
4651 }
4652
4653 const bool groundFire = record && (record->kind == OrderKind::AttackGround ||
4654 record->kind == OrderKind::SuppressArea);
4655 if (groundFire) {
4656 if (artillery->deployRemaining > 0.0f) continue;
4657 WorldPosition aimPoint = record->target;
4658 if (record->kind == OrderKind::SuppressArea) {
4659 const float lineX = record->secondaryTarget.x - record->target.x;
4660 const float lineY = record->secondaryTarget.y - record->target.y;
4661 const float lineLength = std::hypot(lineX, lineY);
4662 if (lineLength <= 1e-5f) {
4663 auto failed = orders->values.fail(record->id, "suppression line must have non-zero length");
4664 if (!failed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(failed.status());
4665 continue;
4666 }

5118 if (firingBuilding != nullptr) {
5119 firingBuilding->indirectFire()->lastFireTick = step.tick;
5120 firingBuilding->indirectFire()->lastFirePosition = {placement->worldX, placement->worldY};
5121 }
5122 }
5123 if (definition.projectile.speed > 0.0f && projectiles != nullptr) {
5124 const auto heights = launchHeights({placement->worldX, placement->worldY}, shot.point,
5125 identity->self, target->handle);
5126 const float garrisonFactor = 1.0f + garrison->damageBonusPerOccupant *
5127 static_cast<float>(garrison->occupants.size());
5128 auto launched = projectiles->launch(identity->subject, faction->link.handle(),
5129 {placement->worldX, placement->worldY},
5130 shot.missed ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : target->handle,
5131 shot.point, definition, garrisonFactor, {},
5132 heights.source, heights.target);
5133 if (!launched) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(launched.status());
5134 }
5135 publishShot(*weaponEntity, identity->subject, target->subject, shot.point,
5136 definition.projectile.speed > 0.0f, shot.missed);
5137 ++fired;
5138 if (definition.projectile.speed <= 0.0f && !shot.missed && target->durability != nullptr) {
5139 combat::DamageRequest request;
5140 request.source = identity->subject;
5141 request.target = target->subject;
5142 request.damageType = definition.damageType.empty() ? "damage.physical" : definition.damageType;
5143 const float garrisonFactor = 1.0f + garrison->damageBonusPerOccupant *
5144 static_cast<float>(garrison->occupants.size());
5145 const float rangeFactor = weaponRangeDamageFactor(definition,
5146 std::hypot(target->position.x - placement->worldX,
5147 target->position.y - placement->worldY));
5148 request.healthDamage = static_cast<double>(definition.damage * garrisonFactor * rangeFactor) *
5149 static_cast<double>(std::max(1, definition.projectile.pelletCount));
5150 request.healthDamage *= target->effects->multiplier("incomingDamageMultiplier");
5151 if (target->shield != nullptr && *target->shield > 0.0f && request.healthDamage > 0.0) {
5152 const float absorbed = std::min(*target->shield, static_cast<float>(request.healthDamage));
5153 *target->shield -= absorbed;
5154 request.healthDamage -= absorbed;
5155 if (target->shieldCooldown != nullptr) *target->shieldCooldown = target->shieldDelay;
5156 }
5157 auto outcome = damage.apply(*target->durability, request);
5158 if (!outcome) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(outcome.status());
5159 if (damageEvents) damageEvents(request, outcome.value(), step.tick, DamageChannel::Weapon);
5160 if (outcome.value().reaction == combat::HitReaction::Death) {
5161 *target->alive = false;
5162 policy->target = {};
5163 if (explicitAttack) {
5164 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
5165 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
5166 }
5167 }
5168 }
5169 }
5170 state.blockedSubjects = std::move(blockedThisStep);
5171 return Result<std::size_t>::success(fired,
5172 Status::success(fired == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
5173}
