5175Result<std::size_t> OrderActionSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, IRTSActionExecutor& executor) {
5176 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
5177 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS action step delta must be non-negative",
5178 "step.delta");
5179 std::size_t processed = 0;
5180 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Orders, Unit::Action>();
5181 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
5182 auto [identity, orders, action] = *it;
5183 (void)action;
5184 Unit* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
5185 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity) continue;
5186 auto current = readCurrent(orders->values);
5187 if (!current) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(current.status());
5188 auto record = std::move(current).takeValue();
5189 if (!record) continue;
5190 if (record->kind == OrderKind::Gather || record->kind == OrderKind::ReturnCargo ||
5191 record->kind == OrderKind::Build || record->kind == OrderKind::Repair ||
5192 record->kind == OrderKind::Capture || record->kind == OrderKind::Attack ||
5193 record->kind == OrderKind::Move || record->kind == OrderKind::AttackMove ||
5194 record->kind == OrderKind::Patrol || record->kind == OrderKind::HoldPosition ||
5195 record->kind == OrderKind::Stop ||
5196 record->kind == OrderKind::Garrison || record->kind == OrderKind::BoardTransport ||
5197 record->kind == OrderKind::AttackGround || record->kind == OrderKind::SuppressArea ||
5198 record->kind == OrderKind::Resupply || record->kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay ||
5199 record->kind == OrderKind::Escort)
5200 continue;
5201
5202 auto executed = executor.execute(*unit, *record, step);
5203 if (!executed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(executed.status());
5204 const auto outcome = std::move(executed).takeValue();
5205 if (outcome.disposition == ActionDisposition::Completed) {
5206 auto completed = orders->values.complete(record->id);
5207 if (!completed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(completed.status());
5208 }
5209 ++processed;
5210 }
5211 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
5212}

5214Result<ReinforcementRequestReceipt> ReinforcementProductionPolicySystem::request(
5215 Building& building, std::string preferredProduct, const ReinforcementEnqueue& enqueue) {
5216 if (preferredProduct.empty() || !enqueue)
5217 return failure<ReinforcementRequestReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
5218 "RTS reinforcement request requires a preferred product and enqueue boundary", "reinforcement");
5219 std::set<std::string> visited;
5220 std::string candidate = preferredProduct;
5221 Status lastFailure = Status::success(StatusCode::NotFound);
5222 while (visited.insert(candidate).second) {
5223 auto queued = enqueue(building, candidate);
5224 if (queued) return Result<ReinforcementRequestReceipt>::success(
5225 {std::move(preferredProduct), candidate, std::move(queued).takeValue()},
5226 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
5227 lastFailure = queued.status();
5228 queued.ignore("reinforcement fallback continues after rejected candidate");
5229 const auto fallback = building.rally()->reinforcementFallbacks.find(candidate);
5230 if (fallback == building.rally()->reinforcementFallbacks.end() || fallback->second.empty())
5231 return Result<ReinforcementRequestReceipt>::failure(lastFailure);
5232 candidate = fallback->second;
5233 }
5234 return failure<ReinforcementRequestReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
5235 "RTS reinforcement fallback chain contains a cycle", "building.rally.reinforcementFallbacks");
5236}
5237
5238Result<std::size_t> ReinforcementProductionPolicySystem::step(
5239 const SimulationStep& step, const ReinforcementCancel& cancel) {
5240 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
5241 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
5242 "RTS reinforcement policy delta must be non-negative", "step.delta");
5243 struct Demand {
5244 Building* building = nullptr;
5245 production::ProductionTask* task = nullptr;
5246 std::string product;
5247 int priority = 0;
5248 };
5249 struct Group {
5250 std::vector<Demand> demands;
5251 std::map<std::string, std::size_t> livingByType;
5252 std::size_t living = 0;
5253 std::size_t limit = 0;
5254 std::map<std::string, std::size_t> typeLimits;
5255 };
5256 std::map<std::string, Group> groups;
5257 auto units = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Definition, Unit::Faction, Unit::Tactics,
5258 Unit::Durability, Unit::Containment>();
5259 for (auto it = units.begin(); it != units.end(); ++it) {
5260 auto [definition, faction, tactics, durability, containment] = *it;
5261 if (!durability->alive || containment->container.isBound() || tactics->combatGroup == 0) continue;
5262 auto& group = groups[factionKey(faction->link) + "\n" + std::to_string(tactics->combatGroup)];
5263 ++group.living;
5264 ++group.livingByType[definition->id.format()];
5265 }
5266 auto buildings = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Faction, Building::Production,
5267 Building::Rally, Building::Integrity>();
5268 for (auto it = buildings.begin(); it != buildings.end(); ++it) {
5269 auto [identity, faction, production, rally, integrity] = *it;
5270 if (!integrity->alive || !rally->enabled || rally->combatGroup == 0) continue;
5271 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
5272 if (building == nullptr || &*building->identity() != identity) continue;
5273 production::ProductionTask* active = nullptr;
5274 for (int index = 0; index < production->values.taskCount(); ++index) {
5275 auto task = production->values.taskAt(index);
5276 if (!task || task->get().kind != "unit") continue;
5277 const auto state = task->get().state;
5278 if (state == production::TaskState::Queued || state == production::TaskState::Running ||
5279 task->get().id == rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask) {
5280 active = &task->get();
5281 break;
5282 }
5283 }
5284 if (active == nullptr) {
5285 rally->reinforcementCapped = false;
5286 rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask.clear();
5287 continue;
5288 }
5289 auto& group = groups[factionKey(faction->link) + "\n" + std::to_string(rally->combatGroup)];
5290 if (group.limit == 0 || (rally->reinforcementLimit > 0 && rally->reinforcementLimit < group.limit))
5291 group.limit = rally->reinforcementLimit;
5292 for (const auto& [product, limit] : rally->reinforcementTypeLimits) {
5293 auto found = group.typeLimits.find(product);
5294 if (found == group.typeLimits.end() || limit < found->second) group.typeLimits[product] = limit;
5295 }
5296 const auto priority = rally->reinforcementTypePriorities.find(active->product);
5297 group.demands.push_back({building, active, active->product,
5298 priority == rally->reinforcementTypePriorities.end() ? 0 : priority->second});
5299 }
5300
5301 std::size_t processed = 0;
5302 for (auto& [key, group] : groups) {
5303 (void)key;
5304 std::sort(group.demands.begin(), group.demands.end(), [](const Demand& left, const Demand& right) {
5305 if (left.priority != right.priority) return left.priority > right.priority;
5306 return left.building->identity()->subject.format() < right.building->identity()->subject.format();
5307 });
5308 std::size_t reserved = 0;
5309 std::map<std::string, std::size_t> reservedByType;
5310 for (Demand& demand : group.demands) {
5311 auto rally = demand.building->rally();
5312 const auto typeLimit = group.typeLimits.find(demand.product);
5313 const bool totalCapped = group.limit > 0 && group.living + reserved >= group.limit;
5314 const bool typeCapped = typeLimit != group.typeLimits.end() &&
5315 group.livingByType[demand.product] + reservedByType[demand.product] >= typeLimit->second;
5316 const bool capped = totalCapped || typeCapped;
5317 if (capped && demand.task->state != production::TaskState::Paused) {
5318 auto paused = demand.building->production()->values.pause(demand.task->id);
5319 if (!paused) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(paused.status());
5320 rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask = demand.task->id;
5321 ++processed;
5322 } else if (!capped && demand.task->state == production::TaskState::Paused &&
5323 rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask == demand.task->id) {
5324 auto resumed = demand.building->production()->values.resume(demand.task->id);
5325 if (!resumed) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(resumed.status());
5326 rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask.clear();
5327 ++processed;
5328 }
5329 rally->reinforcementCapped = capped;
5330 if (capped) {
5331 rally->reinforcementCappedSeconds += static_cast<float>(step.delta.seconds());
5332 if (rally->reinforcementAutoCancelDelay > 0.0f &&
5333 rally->reinforcementCappedSeconds + 1e-5f >= rally->reinforcementAutoCancelDelay && cancel) {
5334 const std::string taskId = demand.task->id;
5335 auto cancelled = cancel(*demand.building, taskId);
5336 if (!cancelled) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(cancelled.status());
5337 rally->reinforcementPolicyPausedTask.clear();
5338 rally->reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
5339 rally->reinforcementCapped = false;
5340 ++processed;
5341 continue;
5342 }
5343 } else {
5344 rally->reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
5345 }
5346 if (!capped) {
5347 ++reserved;
5348 ++reservedByType[demand.product];
5349 }
5350 }
5351 }
5352 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
5353 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
5354}
5355
5356Result<std::size_t> BuildingProductionSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const ProductionSpawn& spawn,
5357 const ProductionSpawnPosition& position,
5358 const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
5359 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
5360 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS production step delta must be non-negative",
5361 "step.delta");
5362 std::size_t processed = 0;
5363 struct Settlement { ecs::EntityHandle building; production::ProductionTask task; };
5364 std::vector<Settlement> settlements;
5365 auto view = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Production>();
5366 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
5367 auto [identity, production] = *it;
5368 Building* building = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
5369 if (building == nullptr || &*building->identity() != identity) continue;
5370 auto advanced = production->values.advance(step);
5371 if (!advanced) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(advanced.status());
5372 advanced.value();
5373 ++processed;
5374 if (!spawn) continue;
5375 const auto completed = production->values.completed("unit");
5376 if (building->rally()->productionSpawnBlocked &&
5377 std::none_of(completed.begin(), completed.end(), [&](const auto& task) {
5378 return task.id == building->rally()->blockedProductionTask;
5379 })) {
5380 building->rally()->productionSpawnBlocked = false;
5381 building->rally()->blockedProductionTask.clear();
5382 if (events)
5383 events({LifecycleEventKind::ProductionSpawnCleared, identity->subject, {}, {}, 0.0}, step.tick);
5384 }
5385 for (const auto& task : completed) {
5386 auto& settled = building->rally()->settledProductionTasks;
5387 if (std::find(settled.begin(), settled.end(), task.id) != settled.end()) continue;
5388 settlements.push_back({identity->self, task});
5389 }
5390 }
5391 for (const auto& settlement : settlements) {
5392 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(settlement.building));
5393 if (building == nullptr)
5394 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
5395 "RTS producer disappeared during production settlement", "production");
5396 auto& settled = building->rally()->settledProductionTasks;
5397 if (std::find(settled.begin(), settled.end(), settlement.task.id) != settled.end()) continue;
5398 std::optional<WorldPosition> spawnPosition;
5399 if (position) {
5400 auto available = position(*building, settlement.task);
5401 if (!available) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(available.status());
5402 spawnPosition = std::move(available).takeValue();
5403 if (!spawnPosition) {
5404 const bool newlyBlocked = !building->rally()->productionSpawnBlocked;
5405 building->rally()->productionSpawnBlocked = true;
5406 building->rally()->blockedProductionTask = settlement.task.id;
5407 if (newlyBlocked && events)
5408 events({LifecycleEventKind::ProductionSpawnBlocked,
5409 building->identity()->subject, {}, settlement.task.product, 0.0}, step.tick);
5410 continue;
5411 }
5412 }
5413 auto created = spawn(*building, settlement.task);
5414 if (!created) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(created.status());
5415 Unit* unit = std::move(created).takeValue();
5416 if (unit == nullptr)
5417 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::Failed,
5418 "RTS production factory returned a null unit", "production.spawn");
5419 unit->motion()->x = spawnPosition ? spawnPosition->x : building->placement()->worldX;
5420 unit->motion()->y = spawnPosition ? spawnPosition->y : building->placement()->worldY;
5421 const bool wasBlocked = building->rally()->productionSpawnBlocked;
5422 building->rally()->productionSpawnBlocked = false;
5423 building->rally()->blockedProductionTask.clear();
5424 if (wasBlocked && events)
5425 events({LifecycleEventKind::ProductionSpawnCleared,
5426 building->identity()->subject, unit->identity()->subject,
5427 settlement.task.product, 0.0}, step.tick);
5428 unit->tactics()->combatGroup = building->rally()->combatGroup;
5429 building->rally()->reinforcements.push_back(unit->identity()->self);
5430
5431 bool boarded = false;
5432 auto* transport = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(building->rally()->transport));
5433 if (transport != nullptr && transport->durability()->alive && transport->containment()->capacity > 0 &&
5434 transport->containment()->occupants.size() < transport->containment()->capacity &&
5435 FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(transport->faction()->link, building->faction()->link)) {
5436 auto link = ContainerLink::bind(transport->identity()->self);
5437 if (!link) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(link.status());
5438 unit->containment()->container = std::move(link).takeValue();
5439 transport->containment()->occupants.push_back(unit->identity()->self);
5440 boarded = true;
5441 }
5442 if (!boarded && building->rally()->enabled) {
5443 auto queued = unit->orders()->values.replace(building->rally()->command);
5444 if (!queued) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(queued.status());
5445 std::move(queued).takeValue();
5446 }
5447 settled.push_back(settlement.task.id);
5448 if (events)
5449 events({LifecycleEventKind::UnitProduced, building->identity()->subject,
5450 unit->identity()->subject, settlement.task.product, 1.0}, step.tick);
5451 ++processed;
5452 }
5453 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
5454}
5455
5456Result<std::size_t> ReinforcementSystem::step() {
5457 std::size_t processed = 0;
5458 auto view = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Faction, Building::Rally>();
5459 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
5460 auto [identity, faction, rally] = *it;
5461 (void)identity;
5462 if (!rally->enabled || rally->transport.table == nullptr) continue;
5463 auto* transport = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(rally->transport));
5464 if (transport == nullptr || !transport->durability()->alive ||
5465 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(transport->faction()->link, faction->link)) {
5466 rally->transport = {};
5467 rally->transportActive = false;
5468 continue;
5469 }
5470 auto& occupants = transport->containment()->occupants;
5471 occupants.erase(std::remove_if(occupants.begin(), occupants.end(), [](const auto& handle) {
5472 return dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle)) == nullptr;
5473 }), occupants.end());
5474 if (!rally->transportActive) {
5475 if (occupants.size() < std::max<std::size_t>(1, rally->minimumTransportLoad)) continue;
5476 auto dispatched = transport->orders()->values.replace(rally->command);
5477 if (!dispatched) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(dispatched.status());
5478 std::move(dispatched).takeValue();
5479 transport->tactics()->combatGroup = rally->combatGroup;
5480 rally->transportActive = true;
5481 ++processed;
5482 continue;
5483 }
5484 if (!transport->motion()->arrived) continue;
5485 const auto passengers = occupants;
5486 occupants.clear();
5487 for (const auto& handle : passengers) {
5488 auto* passenger = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
5489 if (passenger == nullptr) continue;
5490 passenger->containment()->container = {};
5491 passenger->motion()->x = transport->motion()->x;
5492 passenger->motion()->y = transport->motion()->y;
5493 passenger->tactics()->combatGroup = rally->combatGroup;
5494 auto ordered = passenger->orders()->values.replace(rally->command);
5495 if (!ordered) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(ordered.status());
5496 std::move(ordered).takeValue();
5497 ++processed;
5498 }
5499 rally->transportActive = false;
5500 }
5501 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed,
5502 Status::success(processed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
5503}

5505Result<std::size_t> EffectSystem::step(const SimulationStep& step, const LifecycleEventSink& events) {
5506 if (step.delta.nanoseconds() < 0)
5507 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS effects step delta must be non-negative",
5508 "step.delta");
5509 std::size_t processed = 0;
5510 {
5511 auto view = ecs::View<Unit, Unit::Identity, Unit::Effects, Unit::Durability>();
5512 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
5513 auto [identity, effects, durability] = *it;
5514 Unit* unit = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
5515 if (unit == nullptr || &*unit->identity() != identity || &*unit->effects() != effects) continue;
5516 const double healing = effects->values.additive("healingPerSecond") * step.delta.seconds();
5517 if (durability->alive && healing > 0.0)
5518 durability->state.health = std::min(durability->state.maxHealth,
5519 durability->state.health + healing);
5520 const auto before = effects->values.snapshot();
5521 auto advanced = advanceEffects(effects->values, step);
5522 if (!advanced) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(advanced.status());
5523 if (events && advanced.value() > 0) {
5524 const auto after = effects->values.snapshot();
5525 for (int index = 0; index < before.effects.effectCount(); ++index) {
5526 const auto* instance = before.effects.effectAt(index);
5527 if (instance != nullptr && after.effects.find(instance->id) == nullptr)
5528 events({LifecycleEventKind::StatusExpired, identity->subject, {},
5529 instance->type, 0.0}, step.tick);
5530 }
5531 }
5532 processed += std::move(advanced).takeValue();
5533 }
5534 }
5535 {
5536 auto view = ecs::View<Building, Building::Identity, Building::Effects>();
5537 for (auto it = view.begin(); it != view.end(); ++it) {
5538 auto [identity, effects] = *it;
5539 Building* building = identity == nullptr ? nullptr : dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(identity->self));
5540 if (building == nullptr || &*building->identity() != identity || &*building->effects() != effects) continue;
5541 const auto before = effects->values.snapshot();
5542 auto advanced = advanceEffects(effects->values, step);
5543 if (!advanced) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(advanced.status());
5544 if (events && advanced.value() > 0) {
5545 const auto after = effects->values.snapshot();
5546 for (int index = 0; index < before.effects.effectCount(); ++index) {
5547 const auto* instance = before.effects.effectAt(index);
5548 if (instance != nullptr && after.effects.find(instance->id) == nullptr)
5549 events({LifecycleEventKind::StatusExpired, identity->subject, {},
5550 instance->type, 0.0}, step.tick);
5551 }
5552 }
5553 processed += std::move(advanced).takeValue();
5554 }
5555 }
5556 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
5557}
